Celestial Transformation – Deals light damage to all enemies. Grants the Binder regeneration and light add to all attacks for the rest of battle. Requires max Eros. Does not change scale position. (Binder)
Conjure Hellhound – Summons a dark-based hellhound companion. Requires Thanatos side of scale. (Binder)
Conjure Mephit – Summons an unaligned mephit companion. Consumes the higher of Eros or Thanatos resource. Does not affect scale position. Binder exclusive. (Binder)
Conjure Unicorn – Summons a light-based unicorn companion. Requires Eros side of scale. (Binder)
Creative Thrust – Light magic attack that heals the Binder. Healing increases with Eros scale position. Cost increases with Eros scale position. (Binder)
Destructive Thrust – Dark magic attack that deals increased damage. Damage increases with Thanatos scale position. Cost increases with Thanatos scale position. (Binder)
Ephemeral Illusion – Dark illusion magic attack enhanced by Thanatos scale position. (Binder)

Ephemeral Surge – Dark magic attack against single target that generates Thanatos and moves the scale one step toward Thanatos. If the scale is at or beyond Thanatos 3/4 when this ability resolves, deals corrupt damage to all enemies and snaps the scale to Balanced. Does not affect pool values on snap. (Binder)
Eternal Corruption – Light corrupt magic attack enhanced by Eros scale position. (Binder)

Eternal Surge – Light magic attack against single target that generates Eros and moves the scale one step toward Eros. If the scale is at or beyond Eros 3/4 when this ability resolves, raises and heals all allies and snaps the scale to Balanced. Does not affect pool values on snap. (Binder)

Infernal Transformation – Deals dark damage to all enemies. Grants the Binder dark retaliation and dark add to all attacks for the rest of battle. Requires max Thanatos. Does not change scale position. (Binder)
Inspiration, Group – Heals and quickens all allies. (Binder)
Return from the Brink – Raises one ally to 1 health. Consumes Eros resource. Does not require Eros scale position. (Binder)
Shell Heal – Heals target. Any overheal is applied as a damage shield. (Binder)
Weapon Bolt – Magic fire attack that enhances own damage if Eros-aligned and lowers target defense if Thanatos-aligned. Enhanced by alignment. (Binder)
Astral Construct – Summons an Eros-enhanced astral construct companion. (Conjurer)
Companion Flame – Companion casts a fire spell targeting an enemy row. Uses companion's stats and mana from the companion. (Conjurer)
Companion Lightning – Companion casts an air storm spell. Uses companion's stats and mana from the companion. (Conjurer)
Dedicated Offensive – Magic attack against a single target. The companion targets the same enemy until this ability is used again or the enemy dies. (Conjurer)

Eros Guardian – Magic attack versus all enemies that minimizes the damage of their next attacks. More powerful with a companion present. Spends mana from companion if available. Requires Eros. (Conjurer)
Ethereal Delay – Magic attack that delays the target. If companion mana is available, delays all enemies instead. (Conjurer)
Floating Skull – Summons a Thanatos-enhanced floating skull companion. (Conjurer)
Guide Conjuration – Magic attack that heals the companion, grants it mana, and quickens it. (Conjurer)
Thanatos Champion – Melee attack against three random enemies with heartstrike. Gains an extra attack when companion mana is available. Requires Thanatos. (Conjurer)
Titanic Growth – All enemies are compelled to attack the companion. The companion's next attack targets all enemies. (Conjurer)
Bleak Frost Spirit – Single-target water magic attack. Grants the Occultist water retaliation. Consumes Thanatos resource. (Occultist)
Corruptive Sleep – Corrupt water damage and incapacitate versus one target. (Occultist)
Drown – Water bleed against target. (Occultist)
Falling Icicles – Piercing water magic storm. (Occultist)
Frost Corruption – Water attack that applies corruption against all enemies. Consumes Thanatos resource. Power enhanced by Thanatos scale position. (Occultist)
Frozen Eternity – Water magic attack that incapacitates the target. Consumes Eros resource. Duration scales with Eros scale position. (Occultist)
Pandemonium Wind – Air attack versus all with delay and piercing. Costs mana. Power enhanced by Thanatos scale position. (Occultist)
Phantom Ritual – Summons a phantom companion. (Occultist)
Potential of Ephemera – Magic attack with increased maximum damage. Costs mana. Maximum scales with Thanatos scale position. (Occultist)
Seeping Cold – Water attack and bleed with piercing against single target. (Occultist)
Spike Lure – Taunts one enemy to attack the Occultist. The retaliation triggered by that attack is then dealt to all enemies. (Occultist)
Wall of Frost – Water magic attack against a row. (Occultist)
Attendant Apocalypse – Prepared ability. When the companion scores a critical hit, triggers a high-damage magic attack against all enemies. Reserves mana while held. (Shaman)
Attendant Resurrection – Prepared ability. When the companion scores a critical hit, raises the Shaman if she is currently dead. Reserves mana while held. (Shaman)
Consistency of Eternity – Magic attack with increased minimum damage. Minimum scales with Eros scale position. Costs mana. (Shaman)
Cultivate Alraune – Summons an alraune companion. (Shaman)
Cultivate Leshy – Summons a leshy companion. (Shaman)

Pure Transformation – Requires that the Shaman is unaffected by any afflictions and at max Eros. On activation, purges all afflictions from all allies and companions. Grants the Shaman and her companion enhanced purge power and high affliction resistance for the rest of battle. (Shaman)
Spirit Assault – Channeled ability that applies untyped hex to multiple enemies over the channel duration. (Shaman)
Stone Crusher – Magic piercing earth attack that enhances the companion's critical chance. (Shaman)

Thanatos Madness – Channeled ability with duration that enhances companion power based on Thanatos scale position, then causes the companion to make attacks against three random enemies. Attacks are considered storm. Spends Thanatos resource. (Shaman)
Threatening Shot – Ranged attack. If the Shaman scores a critical hit, the companion also attacks the same target. (Shaman)
Wrath of Winter – Magic water attack that delays the target and quickens the companion. (Shaman)
Betrayal in Darkness – Dark magic attack versus all enemies. Possesses enemies on critical hit. (Medium)
Blended Shadow – Magic attack enhanced by both light power and dark power simultaneously. (Medium)
Chant of Eros – Channeled light magic attack that generates Eros resource each tick. (Medium)
Chant of Thanatos – Channeled dark magic attack that generates Thanatos resource each tick. (Medium)
Chiaroscuro – Deals light or dark damage to all enemies based on the Medium's current scale position. (Medium)
Dark Sunlight – Dark magic attack that lowers the target's light resistance and generates Eros resource. (Medium)

Harmony Blast – Magic attack versus all enemies that deals increased damage the closer the Medium is to Balanced. Moves the scale one step away from Balanced on use. Requires Balanced scale position. (Medium)

Harmony Bolt – Single-target magic attack that deals increased damage the closer the Medium is to Balanced. Moves the scale one step away from Balanced on use. Requires Balanced scale position. (Medium)
Radiant Night – Light magic attack that lowers the target's dark resistance and generates Thanatos resource. (Medium)
Shadow Storm – Magic storm attack that makes two light strikes and two dark strikes. (Medium)
Summon Wayang – Summons a wayang companion. (Medium)
Sun and Moon – Magic light and dark attack versus all enemies simultaneously. (Medium)
Blunting Charge– Mounted attack that causes the entire column's next attack to be minimized. (Animist)
Dark Anima – Dark magic damage versus all enemies. Consumes Thanatos resource. Requires Thanatos. (Animist)
Doubling Animation – Buffs the companion so it takes two turns in a row for its next turn. (Animist)
Light Anima – Light magic damage versus all enemies. Consumes Eros resource. Requires Eros. (Animist)
Mounted Arcana – Arcane magic attack against a single enemy. Requires mounted. Grants mount action. (Animist)
Phantom Animation – Buffs the companion so its next attack deals damage to all enemies. (Animist)
Possessing Animation – Buffs the companion so its next attack deals additional illusory damage with a possession effect. (Animist)
Purge Spirit – Magic attack that also makes the target intangible. (Animist)
Spirit Beast – Summons a spirit beast mount. (Animist)
Spirit Charge – Melee attack requiring mounted that also damages all enemies. Bonus damage scales with Thanatos scale position. (Animist)
Spirit Onslaught – Mounted attack that repeats additional times. Number of repeats scales with Eros scale position. (Animist)
Withstand the Onslaught – Grants the enduring condition to the Animist and all allies. (Animist)
Foreboding Spirit – Untyped countdown placed on a target with mana damage. (Spiritualist)
Hollow Armor – Conjures a hollow armor companion that uses improved defensive and reaction abilities. Power scales with Eros scale position. (Spiritualist)
Lightning Spirits – Air hex against a single target with amplification. (Spiritualist)
Mass Hex – Afflicts all enemies with untyped hex. (Spiritualist)
Partnered Cast – Magic attack versus a single enemy. Magic power is enhanced by the companion's presence. (Spiritualist)
Phoenix Destiny – Fire magic attack against all enemies. Grants the Spiritualist a countdown revive. Requires preparation. Costs mana. Consumes Eros resource. (Spiritualist)

Precarious Companion – The companion makes multiple attacks against enemies. Requires that the companion is endangered. Attacks are more powerful if the Spiritualist is also endangered. (Spiritualist)

Precarious Destiny – Light magic attack versus an endangered enemy. If the Spiritualist is also endangered and this attack kills the target, the life of all remaining enemies is averaged with the target's life before the ability fired. (Spiritualist)
Precarious End – Magic attack versus all endangered enemies. Deals extra damage if the Spiritualist is also endangered. (Spiritualist)

Precarious Transformation – Requires the Spiritualist to be endangered and at max Eros. Power level is locked to the Spiritualist's health percentage at activation. On activation, grants Enduring. For the rest of battle: the Spiritualist counts as endangered regardless of actual health; a pulsing light burst targets all enemies each turn with damage that increases per hit taken during that turn; all Precarious abilities function at their enhanced tier automatically. (Spiritualist)
Spirit of Self – On death, summons a Spirit of Self companion based on the Spiritualist's own stats. The companion is shielded and empowered on summoning. (Spiritualist)
Sympathetic Hex – Light hex against a single enemy. If the target is endangered when the hex triggers, it deals damage to all other enemies instead. (Spiritualist)
Constellation – Light countdown placed on all enemies. Requires Eros side of scale. (Astrologer)
Dark Stars – Dark magic attack versus all enemies. Drains life on critical hit. Requires endangered. (Astrologer)
Fanning Flame – Fire countdown placed on target. Increases in value each time any critical hit occurs. (Astrologer)
Frost Storm – Water magic storm. Incapacitates each enemy struck based on the number of critical hits scored against it. (Astrologer)
Star Crystal – Summons a star crystal companion. Enhances light power. Requires Eros side of scale. (Astrologer)
Starfall – Magic light attack against three random enemies. Also applies a light countdown to each target struck. (Astrologer)
Starlight Blast – Light magic attack versus all enemies with lucky damage. Requires Eros side of scale. Generates Eros resource. (Astrologer)

Stellar Burst – Light magic storm with four attacks. After resolving, fires an additional light magic attack versus all enemies based on total critical hits scored. Requires preparation. Costs mana. Generates Eros resource. (Astrologer)
Stellar Cascade – Light magic attack versus a single enemy. Damages all other enemies on critical hit. Can cascade repeatedly. (Astrologer)
Stellar Purge – Light magic attack versus all enemies. Purges one affliction per enemy critically hit. Requires preparation. Requires Eros side of scale. (Astrologer)
Stellar Speed – Light magic attack versus all enemies. Quickens the Astrologer for each enemy critically hit. Requires preparation. Costs mana. (Astrologer)

Stellar Surge – Light magic storm with three attacks. Generates mana based on total critical hits scored. Each critical hit generates mana equal to the spell's cost. Requires preparation. Costs mana. Consumes Eros resource. (Astrologer)

Zenith Transformation – Magic arcane attack versus all enemies. For the rest of battle, prepared magic abilities cost half mana but the Astrologer takes damage when disrupted. Requires preparation. Requires max Eros. Spends Eros resource to augment damage. (Astrologer)
Bound Efreet – Summons a bound efreet companion. Requires Thanatos side of scale. (Vizier)

Corrupt Transformation – Requires the Vizier to be on the Thanatos side of scale and to be suffering corrupt damage equal to at least 20% of her total health. On activation, deals corrupt damage to all enemies. For the rest of battle, grants magic power that scales with corrupt damage currently on the Vizier and grants the companion a corrupt damage add to all attacks. (Vizier)
Corruption Aura – Deals corrupt bleed to all enemies. Requires Thanatos Full scale position. Costs Thanatos resource each turn to maintain. Grows in power up to four times. Toggled. (Vizier)
Corruptive Touch – Close dark magic attack with a chance to proc all damage as corrupt. (Vizier)
Forbidden Command – The companion makes an attack against the target with a chance to proc full corrupt damage. (Vizier)
Oblivion Hex – Dark hex placed on target. Hex value is based on Thanatos scale position at time of casting. (Vizier)
Omnipresent Corruption – Dark magic attack versus all enemies, enhanced by all corruption currently on the battlefield. Spends Thanatos resource. (Vizier)
Treacherous Blast – Fire magic attack against all enemies. Also deals corrupt damage to a random ally. Enhanced by the corrupt damage currently on that ally. (Vizier)
Treacherous Blood – Afflicts target with a dark bleed. Also deals corrupt damage to a random ally. (Vizier)

Treacherous Oblivion – Corrupt heartstrike magic attack against a single enemy. Also deals corrupt damage to all allies. Both effects are increased by Thanatos scale position. Spends Thanatos resource. (Vizier)
Treacherous Storm – Magic air storm that can also damage allies, but not the Vizier herself. (Vizier)
Alien Impact – Chaos damage versus all enemies. The Alienist takes illusory damage on use. (Alienist)
Alien Influence Bolt – Chaos damage versus a single enemy. Damage is enhanced by the illusory damage currently on the Alienist. (Alienist)
Alien Presence – Magic illusory attack enhanced by the companion. Uses mana from the companion. (Alienist)
Alien Tentacles – Four random magic attacks, each dealing a different elemental damage type. (Alienist)

Alien Transformation – Requires max Thanatos scale position and sufficient illusory damage on the Alienist. On activation, places a low-value, long-duration illusory damage effect on all enemies. For the rest of battle, a pulse of illusory damage hits all enemies on each of the Alienist's turns, and the Alienist gains illusory retaliation — enemies that strike her take illusory damage. (Alienist)
Chaos Wall, Greater – Chaos magic damage versus an enemy row. (Alienist)
Eldritch Abomination – Summons an eldritch abomination companion. (Alienist)

Illusion of Time – Afflicts all enemies with illusory damage. The balance between damage value and duration is based on alignment — Thanatos-leaning increases damage, Eros-leaning increases duration. (Alienist)
Impossible Horror – Illusory magic attack that uses ruthless with all illusory damage on the target. Requires Thanatos side of scale. (Alienist)
Insane Resurrection – Raises target ally. Both the target and the Alienist are afflicted with illusory damage. (Alienist)
Lesser Chaos Channel – Channeled chaos magic damage against a single target. Maintains the same element over the full channel duration. (Alienist)
Terrible Presence – Grants the companion an ongoing bleed effect. Afflicts all enemies with an illusory bleed. (Alienist)
Act of Creation – Raises all allies and grants them regeneration. Requires high Eros scale position. (Pact Master)
Act of Destruction – Deals corrupt heartstrike damage to all enemies. Requires high Thanatos scale position. (Pact Master)
Action Binding – For a period, the Pact Master makes an attack whenever her companion makes an attack. (Pact Master)
Corruption Blast – Corrupt damage and delay versus all enemies. (Pact Master)
Corruption Storm – Corrupt dark magic storm. (Pact Master)
Death's Door – Culls target enemy and revives a random dead ally. The revived ally's health is based on the culled target's current health at time of use. (Pact Master)
Gleam of Life – Magic light attack against all enemies. Generates Eros resource. (Pact Master)
Inspiring Bolt – Arcane magic attack that quickens the companion. (Pact Master)
Maddening Blast – Fire magic attack versus all enemies that enhances companion damage. (Pact Master)
Shadow of Death – Magic dark attack against all enemies. Generates Thanatos resource. (Pact Master)

Terminal Reversal – Magic attack against all enemies dealing high damage based on current alignment. Lowers the related elemental power and enhances the opposite elemental power. Reverses the scale position to its mirror extreme. Requires maximum alignment on either side. (Pact Master)
Brute Strike – Melee attack with increased damage and lower accuracy. (Fighter)
Expert Blow – Melee attack with increased damage requiring 15 expertise. (Fighter)
Flanking Maneuver – Melee attack that causes flanked status to the target. (Fighter)
Precise Strike – Melee attack with increased accuracy that delays user. (Fighter)
Shattering Strike – Melee attack with the shattering modification. (Fighter)
Brutal Reliability – Melee attack that consumes 10 expertise and gains increased critical damage based on expertise. Consumes no expertise on a miss. (Fighter)
Darting Strike – Unblockable melee attack (can still be parried and dodged). (Fighter)
Defense Breaker – Melee attack that causes defense weakness in the target. (Fighter)
Disorienting Blow – Melee attack that lowers active defenses (block, dodge, parry) for a period. Requires 50 expertise, costs 20. (Fighter)
Expert Blow, Improved – Melee attack with increased damage requiring 45 expertise. (Fighter)
Expert Blow, Greater – Melee attack with increased damage requiring 75 expertise. (Fighter)
Intervention Strike – Melee attack that allows fighter to intercept the next attack against an ally. Costs 10 expertise. (Fighter)
Martial Comeback – Melee attack that consumes 20 expertise, healing self based on expertise. (Fighter)
Massive Expertise – Melee attack with high damage consuming 30 expertise. Has massive damage, with a chance to kill if it deals more than a percentage of the target's total health. (Fighter)
Practice Strike – Melee attack that increases expertise. (Fighter)
Prepared Strike – Melee attack requiring preparation for increased damage. (Fighter)
Provocation Wrath – Melee attack that taunts target on critical. (Fighter)
Recurrent Strike – Attack that stays prepared if it kills. (Fighter)
Vicious Cleave – Melee attack that attacks an adjacent enemy on kill. (Fighter)
Wave of Expertise – Melee attack targeting all enemies. Consumes 20 expertise. Deals increased damage based on total expertise at time of use. (Fighter)

All Out Advantage, Standard – Melee attack that uses all advantage up to 10, ranging from 105% to 600%, also increases critical chance (Multiplier: Advantage^2 *5%, Critical Chance: Advantage*1%) (Rogue)
Backstab – High damage melee attack that uses 2 combat advantage and requires hidden (Rogue)
Flanking Assault – Melee attack that against flanked target (Rogue)
Hundred Needles – Melee attack that causes stacking bleed at the cost of advantage (Rogue)
Venom Stab – Melee attack that has increased effect from poisons. Consumes advantage (Rogue)
Accelerated Strike – Melee attack with lower critical chance that quickens rogue (Rogue)
Advantageous Strike – Prepared melee attack that generates advantage (Rogue)
All Out Advantage, Reaping – Melee attack that uses all advantage up to 7, also deals reaping damage (Rogue)
All Out Advantage, Improved – Melee attack that uses all advantage up to 5, ranging from 110% to 350% (Multiplier: Advantage^2 * 10%) (Rogue)
Artful Dodger – Melee attack that enhances dodge and causes advantage gain (Rogue)
Distracting Strike – Melee attack that causes aversion with target (Rogue)
Hidden Bloodlust – Melee attack with bloodlust requiring hidden (Rogue)
Needling Rend – Dualwield melee attack. Each attack causes stack of stacking bleed, with an extra stack if both attacks hit. (Rogue)
Penetrating Stab – Melee attack with penetrating (Rogue)
Potent Poisoning Strike – Prepared melee attack that has greater effect from poison (Rogue)
Shadow Pierce – Melee attack against flanked enemy with penetration (Rogue)
Sniper Shot 5 – Ranged attack that consumes all advantage for extra damage, up to 10 combat advantage. Requires at least 5 advantage (Rogue)
Tendon Rip – Melee attack that causes speed weakness (Rogue)
Force Ward – Gain a damage shield based on total influence over enemies. (Psychic)
Inhibition Influence – Lowers the target's mana based on influence. (Psychic)
Deflect Attention – Grants the psychic avert against each attack before end of turn. (Psychic)
Flood the Mind – Flat mana cost. Doubles current influence on target. Requires existing influence. (Psychic)
Fiery Possession – Possesses ally target but deals fire damage to them as well. (Psychic)
Mental Clarity – Grants any unit focus for a mana cost. Passive mana generation lasts until that unit's next turn. (Psychic)
Focus Mind – Consume focus to generate mana. (Psychic)
Influence Revenge – Damage enemies that attack you based on influence on them. (Psychic)
Intellect Barrier – Channeled ability that prevents possession effects and illusory damage while ongoing. (Psychic)
Psychic Overflow – Gain mana based on total influence. (Psychic)
Psychic Susceptibility – Weakens dodge and defense of influenced enemies. (Psychic)
Mental Interference – Area attack lowering control resistance of all enemies for the turn. Generates influence on enemies. (Psychic)
Blood Shield – Grants a damage shield at the cost of health, generating extra Anguish. (Barbarian)
Rage Cleave – Single target melee attack useable during Wrath forms. (Barbarian)
Escape Fate – Purges countdowns from the Barbarian with a weak heal. Requires countdown. Generates Anguish based on countdown value. (Barbarian)
Erupting Earth – Earth melee damage following a critical. Consumes Anguish. (Barbarian)
Flaming Life – Fire melee damage following a critical. Backbiting. (Barbarian)
Goading Shout – Provokes an enemy, forcing the next active enemy to attack the Barbarian. Generates Anguish on the enemy's attack. (Barbarian)
Mystic Stormcrow – Air melee damage following a critical. Costs mana. (Barbarian)
Painted Weapon – Grants the next attack a bonus based on current Warpaint. (Barbarian)
Sea Swallow – Water melee damage following a critical. Requires Berserk. (Barbarian)
Careful Aim – Increases aim but archer has lowered dodge until next turn (Archer)
Solid Screen – Grants the archer damage shield and aim. Must be used as final action (Archer)
Aimed Arrow – Ranged attack consuming aim (Archer)
Critical Eye – Gain enhanced critical chance and critical damage with next attack. Amplified. Resets with attack (Archer)
Generate Distance – Prepared ability. Next attack is treated as if it had distance (Archer)
Return Fire – If archer is attacked before next turn with ranged, counter attack and reset timer (Archer)
Second Vow – Prepared ranged attack that determines its target on preparation (Archer)
Claw Binding – Increases companion damage. Bonus scales with current Thanatos scale position. (Binder)
Scale Binding – Increases companion defense. Bonus scales with current Eros scale position. (Binder)
Balanced Force – Generates mana, Eros, and Thanatos. Requires Balanced scale position. Does not change scale position. (Binder)

Bound Retaliation – Magic attack against the last enemy to attack the Binder's companion. Targets the attacker automatically. Available on the turn after the companion is attacked. Untyped damage, no alignment interaction. (Binder)
Compelling Companion – Compels target to attack the Binder's companion. (Binder)

Eros Evolution – Grants the companion a damage shield that refreshes at the start of the Binder's turn. Shield value scales with current Eros scale position. Reserves mana. Requires Eros scale position at 1/2 or greater. Permanent until deactivated. (Binder)
Mystical Infusion – Grants the mana surge condition to any target. (Binder)
Overwhelming Health – Heals the Binder. Any overheal is transferred to the companion as healing. (Binder)
Paragon Endowment – The next creature summoned is generated as if it were one tier higher. No alignment interaction. (Binder)

Thanatos Evolution – The companion's attacks have a chance to proc damage weakness on the target. Weakness strength scales with current Thanatos scale position. Reserves mana. Requires Thanatos scale position at 1/2 or greater. Permanent until deactivated. (Binder)
Energize Damage – Heals the companion and enhances its damage. Bonus based on Eros scale position. (Conjurer)
Ethereal Guidance– Conjured spirits enhance the accuracy of all allies. Spends Eros resource. (Conjurer)
Ethereal Shroud – Conjured shadows enhance the dodge of all allies. Spends Thanatos resource. (Conjurer)
Flashing Companion – Companion makes a low-power attack. (Conjurer)
Growth Evolution – Enhances the current and maximum health of the companion. Reserves mana. (Conjurer)
Mystic Evolution – Companion gains enhanced mana generation and magic power. Reserves mana. (Conjurer)
Stunned Break – Companion attacks a stunned enemy. (Conjurer)
Blood Evolution – Enhances the damage of the companion but causes damage to the Occultist on use. Reserves mana. (Occultist)
Dark Thorns – Grants dark retaliation to any unit. Requires Thanatos side of scale. (Occultist)
Frost Evolution – Grants the companion water add to attacks. Reserves mana. (Occultist)
Frost Shielding – Grants water shielding to one ally. (Occultist)
Sun Thorns – Grants light retaliation to any unit. Requires Eros side of scale. (Occultist)
Thorns Evolution – Grants untyped retaliation to the companion. Reserves mana. (Occultist)
Attendant Health – Prepared ability. When the companion scores a critical hit, heals both the Shaman and the companion. Reserves mana while held. (Shaman)
Attendant Misfortune – Prepared ability. When the companion scores a critical hit, applies untyped hex to the companion's target. Reserves mana while held. (Shaman)
Attendant Storm – Prepared ability. When the companion scores a critical hit, triggers a three-strike magic storm. Reserves mana while held. (Shaman)
Lethal Evolution – Companion gains enhanced critical damage and can kill enemies with massive damage. Reserves mana. (Shaman)
Spiritual Restoration – Purges the Shaman and her companion of afflictions. Consumes Eros resource. (Shaman)
Sudden Evolution – The companion's attacks gain the sudden modifier and do not trigger retaliation. Reserves mana. (Shaman)
Balance Guard – Enhances both dark and light resistance of target. (Medium)
Balanced Mana – Restores the Medium's mana if her companion currently has a higher mana percentage than she does. (Medium)
Balanced Protection – Enhances both defense and dodge of the Medium. Requires mana and Balanced scale position. (Medium)

Dynamic Balance – If the Medium is attacked before her next turn, she heals on her next turn and gains Eros. Otherwise she gains a damage add and gains Thanatos. Requires Balanced scale position. (Medium)
Lightning Evolution – Grants the companion air damage add. Reserves mana. (Medium)
Resistance Evolution – Grants the companion enhanced elemental and affliction resistance. Reserves mana. (Medium)
Agility Evolution – Companion gains enhanced speed and dodge. Reserves mana. (Animist)
Companion Resurrection – Raises any companion that has died in battle. Requires preparation and costs mana. (Animist)
Enduring Companion – Grants the companion the enduring condition. (Animist)
Eros Animation – Buffs the companion so it has greatly increased heal and enchant power with its next turn. Requires Eros side of scale. (Animist)
Fierce Loyalty – The next time an enemy scores a critical hit against the Animist, her companion immediately scores a critical attack against that enemy. (Animist)
Robust Evolution – Companion gains regeneration and the fortified condition. Reserves mana. (Animist)
Thanatos Animation – Buffs the companion so it has greatly increased affliction power with its next turn. Requires Thanatos side of scale. (Animist)
Light Empower – Grants the Spiritualist light empowered. Generates Thanatos resource. (Spiritualist)
Light Shield – Grants the Spiritualist light shielded. Generates Eros resource. (Spiritualist)
Precarious Defense – Grants target enhanced defense. Requires the Spiritualist or target to be endangered. Increased effect if both are endangered. (Spiritualist)
Precarious Speed – Grants target haste. Requires the Spiritualist or target to be endangered. Increased effect if both are endangered. (Spiritualist)
Precarious Strength – Grants target enhanced damage. Requires the Spiritualist or target to be endangered. Increased effect if both are endangered. (Spiritualist)
Protecting Spirits – Grants untyped retaliation to one ally. Requires Eros side of scale. (Spiritualist)
Shield Evolution – Companion gains shielded against the last element to damage it. Reserves mana. (Spiritualist)
Armor of Radiance – Target ally deals light damage whenever attacked before their next turn. This damage increases each time it triggers. (Astrologer)
Fortunate Evolution – Companion gains lucky damage and lucky accuracy. Reserves mana. (Astrologer)
Fortunate Healing – Grants target ally lucky healing for a period. (Astrologer)
Fortune's Endowment – The companion's first attack after being summoned is a guaranteed critical hit. (Astrologer)
Lucky Stars – The Astrologer gains lucky accuracy and enhanced critical chance for each critical hit scored during her current turn. (Astrologer)
Spur Towards Hell – Deals light damage to target enemy for each critical hit the Astrologer has scored this turn. (Astrologer)
Corrupt Evolution – Companion deals additional corruption damage with its attacks. Reserves mana. (Vizier)
Corrupt Heal, Ally – Fully heals one ally. A portion of the missing life recovered becomes corrupt damage on that ally. (Vizier)
Ferocious Endowment – Maximizes the first attack of the next summoned companion. (Vizier)
Mammoth Evolution – Companion has a chance to damage all enemies with each attack. Reserves mana. (Vizier)
Protective Endowment – Grants the next summoned companion a damage shield. (Vizier)
Stoic Evolution – Companion has a chance to proc a delay with attacks and a chance to ignore delays applied to it. Reserves mana. (Vizier)

Thanatos Command – Possesses the companion to attack target enemy. Deals additional corruption to the target and delays the Vizier. Delay and corruption scale with Thanatos scale position. Consumes and requires Thanatos resource. (Vizier)
Alien Attraction – The companion attacks the target with damage based on illusory damage currently on the target. (Alienist)
Alien Heal – Heals target ally and afflicts that ally with illusory damage. (Alienist)
Alien Possession – Possesses the companion to attack target. Requires Thanatos and costs mana. Deals illusory damage to the Alienist on use. (Alienist)
Protection of Insanity – Enhances the Alienist's defense based on her current illusory damage. Requires Eros side of scale. (Alienist)
Strength of Madness – Enhances the Alienist's damage based on her current illusory damage. Requires Thanatos side of scale. (Alienist)
Tentacle Evolution – Grants the companion extended range with melee attacks. Reserves mana. (Alienist)

Beast Pact – Pact. Creates a pain link and heal siphon between the Pact Master and her companion. Both the Pact Master and companion quicken each other whenever either takes an action. Reserves mana. One Pact active at a time. (Pact Master)

Devil Skin – Pact. Grants the Pact Master dark retaliation and enhanced magic defense. Drawback: the Pact Master gains the wounded condition while active. Requires Thanatos side of scale. Reserves mana. One Pact active at a time. (Pact Master)

Goliath Pact – Pact. Grants the Pact Master enhanced area damage, enhanced area accuracy, and fortification. Drawback: the Pact Master provokes all enemies at the start of her turn and has reduced dodge. Reserves mana. One Pact active at a time. (Pact Master)

Pact of Aggression – Pact. Grants the Pact Master air retaliation and quickens her whenever any enemy acts. Drawback: applies earth hex to the Pact Master. Requires max Thanatos scale position. Reserves mana. One Pact active at a time. (Pact Master)

Pact of Protection – Pact. Grants the Pact Master earth retaliation and delays all enemies whenever she acts. Drawback: applies slow to the Pact Master. Requires max Eros scale position. Reserves mana. One Pact active at a time. (Pact Master)
Revival Evolution – The companion is automatically raised at the beginning of the Pact Master's turn if it is dead, consuming mana. Reserves mana. Does not need to be recast. (Pact Master)

Shining Aura – Pact. Grants the Pact Master light retaliation, enhanced defense, and illumination. Drawback: the Pact Master gains the illuminated condition, reducing dodge and preventing hidden. Requires Eros side of scale. Reserves mana. One Pact active at a time. (Pact Master)
Compel All – Compels all enemies to attack the fighter. (Fighter)
Establish Defense – Enhances defense until the fighter's next turn. (Fighter)
Accuracy Stratagem – Spend expertise on the next attack to turn a miss into a hit. (Fighter)
Bandage – Purges a bleed effect and provides a weak heal. Requires bleeding. (Fighter)
Critical Stratagem – Spend expertise on the next attack to turn it into a critical hit. (Fighter)
Damage Stratagem – Spend expertise on the next attack to turn a glancing blow into a regular hit. (Fighter)
Double Taunt – Taunts a single enemy with a taunt that lasts for two attacks. (Fighter)
Expert Damage – Enhances damage of the target. Requires expertise. (Fighter)
Expert Defense – Enhances defense of the target. Requires expertise. (Fighter)
Opportunity Attack – Attacks the next enemy in melee range who makes a ranged attack. (Fighter)
Apply Poison – Consumes a poison item to add the effect to attacks (Rogue)
Hide – Grants the hidden status to the rogue (Rogue)
Caltrops – Trap that causes untyped bleed and slow (Rogue)
Concentrate Poison – Consumes one poison usage to double the value of remaining poisons (Rogue)
Defense Weakness Poison – Provides Rogue with a poison that causes defense weakness (Rogue)
Ghost Form – Uses one combat advantage to make the rogue intangible for a period (Rogue)
Mind Reading – Grants influence over the target. (Psychic)
Scan – Provides information on target based on influence. (Psychic)
Autohypnosis – Psychic has a chance to conserve focus until next turn. (Psychic)
Basic Wildsurge – Randomizes the damage of abilities used by the Psychic, using Wild Surge mechanics. (Psychic)
Hostile Redirect – Forces target enemy to attack its own ally on next turn. (Psychic)
Disperse Mana – Target enemy loses mana. (Psychic)
Cornered Mind – Enhances magic resistance while endangered. Lasts while the psychic remains endangered. (Psychic)
Gathered Power – Causes next ability to cost more mana but also deal more damage. (Psychic)
Mitigate Feedback – Reduce damage of feedback until next turn. (Psychic)
Mote of Envy – Negative. Weakens damage of enemies and disrupts a random enemy on Psychic's turn based on total influence. (Psychic)
Mote of Passion – Positive. Enhances magic power and the psychic gains mana on her turn based on total influence. (Psychic)
Weaken Resilience – Follows affliction. Lowers status resistance and generates influence. (Psychic)
Basic Wrath – The Barbarian gains increased damage while in this Wrath. When this Wrath ends, the Barbarian is tired. (Barbarian)
Berserk Self – Spend Anguish to gain the Berserk condition. (Barbarian)
Aid Critical Damage – Enhances critical damage of one ally for their next turn. (Barbarian)
Battle Lust – Generates Anguish and enhances damage. Requires the Barbarian to be endangered. (Barbarian)
Deadly Intimidation – Follows a kill by causing frightened on a single enemy. (Barbarian)
Embrace of the Wild – Raises maximum damage while lowering minimum damage. Toggled. (Barbarian)
End Wrath – Ends Wrath form, conserving any remaining Anguish. Reduces duration of post-Wrath consequences. (Barbarian)
Greater Wrath – The Barbarian gains further increased damage and critical damage while in this Wrath. When this Wrath ends, the Barbarian is exhausted. (Barbarian)
Paint Ally – Applies the next Warpaint to a chosen ally as well. (Barbarian)
Power from Pain – Increased damage until end of turn at cost of health. Generates Anguish. (Barbarian)
White Warpaint – Grants immunity to frightened and enhanced affliction resistance. (Barbarian)
Aid Accuracy – Enhances one ally’s accuracy until archer’s next turn (Archer)
Gain Aim – Generates aim for the archer (Archer)
Disruption Vow – Prepared disruption that determines its target on preparation (Archer)
Frantic Avoidance – If targeted by area attack before next turn, reduce damage and delay self (Archer)
Fulfill Vow – Quicken self for each prepared vow ability (Archer)
Paint the Mark – Prepared ability that generates aim and lowers target dodge (Archer)
Prepare Dodge – Enhances unit’s dodge until its next turn (Archer)
Unerring Focus – Sacrifice focus to make next attack unerring (Archer)
Eros Shift – Moves the scale one position toward Eros. If the scale ends on the Eros side, also generates Eros resource. (Binder)
Thanatos Shift – Moves the scale one position toward Thanatos. If the scale ends on the Thanatos side, also generates Thanatos resource. (Binder)

Aligned Power – Enhances light and dark power until the Binder's next turn. At Balanced: +5% to both. At each Eros or Thanatos position, enhances only the active alignment: 1/4 = +7.5%, 1/2 = +10%, 3/4 = +12.5%, Full = +15%. (Binder)

Aligned Resistance – Enhances light and dark resistance until the Binder's next turn. At Balanced: +5% to both. At each Eros or Thanatos position, enhances only the active alignment: 1/4 = +7.5%, 1/2 = +10%, 3/4 = +12.5%, Full = +15%. (Binder)
Cleanse Companion – Purges afflictions from the companion. (Binder)
Companion Reactive Heal – Prepared reaction. Heals the companion in response to it taking damage. (Binder)
Quicken Companion – Quickens the companion. (Binder)
Share Health – Heals the companion at the cost of the Binder's own health. (Binder)

Stored Eros – Requires Eros scale position of 1/2 or greater. Reduces the scale by two positions and consumes Eros resource. Can later be activated to restore the same amount of Eros resource and move the scale back up by two positions. (Binder)

Stored Thanatos – Requires Thanatos scale position of 1/2 or greater. Reduces the scale by two positions and consumes Thanatos resource. Can later be activated to restore the same amount of Thanatos resource and move the scale back up by two positions. (Binder)
Companion Link – Lowers own magic power and mana generation to increase the magic power and mana generation of the companion. Toggled. (Conjurer)
Conjured Bow – Manifests a conjured bow for target unit, enhancing ranged damage and accuracy. Reserves mana. Toggled. (Conjurer)
Conjured Staff – Manifests a conjured staff for target unit, enhancing magic power and mana generation. Reserves mana. Toggled. (Conjurer)
Conjured Sword – Manifests a conjured sword for target unit, enhancing melee damage and granting an untyped damage add. Reserves mana. Toggled. (Conjurer)
Elucidate – Quickens the companion and grants it mana. (Conjurer)
Massive Endowment – The next companion summoned appears with extra health and provokes all enemies. (Conjurer)
Mystic Endowment – The next companion summoned appears with extra mana. (Conjurer)
Return to the Ritual – Reduces the cast time and mana cost of a summon. Requires that the Conjurer was disrupted since her previous turn. (Conjurer)
Damaging Ephemera – Whenever the Occultist takes damage, she generates Thanatos resource. Toggled. (Occultist)
Enhance Shielding – Increases the value of shielding on target. (Occultist)
Ephemeral Form – Consumes all Thanatos resource to grant the Occultist the intangible condition. Duration scales with the amount of Thanatos consumed. (Occultist)
Extend Shielding – Increases the duration of any shielding on target. (Occultist)
Retaliation Endowment – Grants the companion retaliation on summoning. (Occultist)
Restoring Eternity – Whenever the Occultist is healed, she generates Eros resource. Toggled. (Occultist)
Sharpen Thorns – Increases the current retaliation value while reducing its duration. (Occultist)
Attendant Power – Prepared ability. When the companion scores a critical hit, restores mana to both the Shaman and the companion. Reserves mana while held. (Shaman)
Attendant Purge – Prepared ability. When the companion scores a critical hit, purges an affliction from the Shaman. Reserves mana while held. (Shaman)
Attendant Speed – Prepared ability. When the companion scores a critical hit, quickens both the Shaman and the companion. Reserves mana while held. (Shaman)
Borrow from Reserve – Restores mana to the Shaman based on her total reserved mana. (Shaman)
Critical Channel – Channeled ability that greatly increases the companion's critical chance and critical damage while the channel is maintained. (Shaman)
Empowered by Reserve – Enhances the Shaman's magic power based on her total reserved mana. (Shaman)
Eternal Form – Consumes all Eros resource to grant the Shaman the fortified condition. Duration scales with the amount of Eros consumed. (Shaman)
Primal Pheromones – The companion compels all enemies at the beginning of its turn. Toggled. (Shaman)
Balanced Heal – Heals the companion if the companion currently has lower health than the Medium. (Medium)
Chant of the Guarded Mind – Channeled ability. While the channel is maintained, the Medium cannot be affected by possession. (Medium)
Guided by Destruction – Enhances spell dodge following a spell critical hit. (Medium)
Mana Thrift – The Medium's next spell refunds its mana cost if it scores a critical hit. (Medium)
Opposite Alignment – Enhances dark power if the Medium is Eros-aligned; enhances light power if Thanatos-aligned. (Medium)
Slippery Spell – Enhances spell critical chance following a spell dodge. (Medium)
Twilight Balance – Averages both light power and dark power, and both light resistance and dark resistance. (Medium)
Guiding Animation – The companion's next attack deals extra damage based on the Animist's own damage value. (Animist)
Immortality Endowment – Prevents the companion from being damaged by the first attack it receives after being summoned. (Animist)
One Mind – While active, the mount always and only acts on the Animist's turns. Toggled. (Animist)
Purify Anima – Purges the companion of corrupt damage and heals it. (Animist)
Shared Mind – The companion cannot be possessed. Lowers the Animist's speed while active. Toggled. (Animist)
Spectral Animation – Buffs the companion so its next attack has the phasing and ghost touch modifiers. (Animist)
Ghost Endowment – The next companion summoned has the intangible condition until its first turn. Its first attack has ghost touch. (Spiritualist)
Precarious Damage Shield – Grants target a damage shield. Requires the Spiritualist or target to be endangered. Increased effect if both are endangered. (Spiritualist)
Precarious Purity – Grants target enhanced affliction resistance. Requires the Spiritualist or target to be endangered. Increased effect if both are endangered. (Spiritualist)
Precarious Retaliation – Grants target untyped retaliation. Requires the Spiritualist or target to be endangered. Increased effect if both are endangered. (Spiritualist)
Share the Power – Grants the companion the same elemental empowered currently affecting the Spiritualist. Requires Thanatos resource. (Spiritualist)
Share the Shield – Grants the companion the same elemental shielded currently affecting the Spiritualist. Requires Eros resource. (Spiritualist)
Dangerous Gambit – Enhances critical chance and critical damage until end of turn, but the Astrologer takes damage for each critical hit made. (Astrologer)
Fortunate Companion – Attacks against the companion have unlucky accuracy until the Astrologer's next turn. (Astrologer)
Greater Luck – Grants lucky damage if the Astrologer is already benefiting from lucky accuracy. (Astrologer)
Spur Towards Heaven – Quickens the companion for each critical hit scored during the Astrologer's current turn. (Astrologer)
Star Mana – The companion's next ability does not consume mana. (Astrologer)
Stellar Infusion – Restores mana to the Astrologer for each critical hit scored during her current turn. (Astrologer)
Act for Me – The companion gains the Vizier's procs until the end of its next turn. (Vizier)
Devastation Deadline – Places a corrupt bleed on the companion that cannot be removed. The bleed deals increased damage based on total corruption present on the battlefield. (Vizier)
Magic of Corruption – Restores mana to the Vizier based on her current corrupt damage. Generates Thanatos resource. (Vizier)
Restored by Corruption – Heals the companion based on the corrupt damage currently on the Vizier. (Vizier)
Speed Endowment – Quickens the next summoned companion. (Vizier)
Treacherous Magic – Deals corrupt damage to the companion to enhance the Vizier's own magic power. (Vizier)
Treacherous Power – Grants the Vizier a corrupt damage add. Also deals dark damage to a random ally. Effect is increased by Thanatos scale position. (Vizier)
Alien Anatomy – Prevents critical hits and glancing hits against the Alienist until her next turn. Requires sufficient illusory damage on the Alienist. (Alienist)
Alien Impulse – Quickens all allies. Deals illusory damage to all allies including the Alienist. (Alienist)
Alien Speed – Quickens the companion and afflicts it with illusory damage. (Alienist)
Chaotic Alignment – Changes the Alienist's scale position randomly. Generates Eros and Thanatos resource based on the distance traveled on the scale. (Alienist)
Return to Sanity – Consumes Eros resource to reduce illusory damage currently on the Alienist. (Alienist)
Share in Insanity – Reduces illusory damage on all allies and transfers it to the Alienist. (Alienist)
Unspeakable Mana – The Alienist takes illusory damage and restores mana. (Alienist)

Aligned Endowment – The companion's first attack after being summoned deals additional damage based on the Pact Master's current alignment. Exception to the standard endowment class-agnostic rule. (Pact Master)
Follow My Command – Prepared ability. Target ally or companion cannot be possessed. If the target would be affected by possession, it is quickened instead. (Pact Master)
Promise of Destruction – Whenever either the Pact Master or companion is killed, the survivor gains an immediate turn and deals double damage with its action. Reserves mana. (Pact Master)
Promise of Restoration – Whenever either the Pact Master or companion is killed, the survivor is fully healed. Reserves mana. (Pact Master)
Summoning Focus – Reduces the mana cost and cast time of the Pact Master's next summon. Consumes focus. (Pact Master)
Tend towards Destruction – Enhances magic power when targeting an enemy with a lower health percentage than the Pact Master. (Pact Master)
Tend towards Endurance – Enhances magic resistance when targeting an enemy with a higher health percentage than the Pact Master. (Pact Master)
Damage Stance – Stance providing increased damage. Fighter generates expertise through dealing damage. (Fighter)
Defense Stance – Stance providing increased defense. Fighter generates expertise through taking damage. (Fighter)
Aid Damage – Enhances the damage of an ally for their next turn. (Fighter)
Backbiter Stance – Stance that increases backbiting value. Fighter generates expertise through backbiting abilities. Advanced: bonus damage while endangered. (Fighter)
Compel Foe – Compels a single target to attack the user. (Fighter)
Dual Style – Follows a dual-wield attack. Increases parry chance. (Fighter)
Momentum Shatter – When using a large weapon and possessing 5 momentum, grants a small shatter effect to the next attack. (Fighter)
Prepare Parry – Enhances unit's parry until its next turn. (Fighter)
Provoke Stratagem – Prepared reaction. When an ally becomes endangered, provokes an enemy and generates expertise. Minor action. (Fighter)
Reinforce Shield – Next block blocks an increased amount. (Fighter)
Sustain Expert Training – Refreshes all expert enchantments on all targets, updating values to the new expertise level if higher than original. (Fighter)
Aid Critical Chance – Enhances the critical chance of an ally until the end of their next turn (Rogue)
Hidden Advantage – Generates advantage while hidden (Rogue)
Aid Dodge – Enhances the dodge of an ally (Rogue)
Consistent Lack – Enhance minimum damage based on missing advantage (Rogue)
Douse the Lights – Purges illumination from the rogue (Rogue)
First Blood – If next attack targets an enemy at full health, it consumes half advantage (Rogue)
Killer’s Advantage – Gain 3 advantage. Lose 5 advantage at end of turn. For each advantage the rogue cannot lose, it takes 10% of health as damage. (Rogue)
Roll with Blow – Next enemy damage is minimized (Rogue)
Share Darkness – Grants hidden to an ally. Requires hidden (Rogue)
Spell Sabotage – Lower target’s magic power. Requires hidden (Rogue)

Ranged Persistence: Whenever the Archer misses with a ranged attack, they have increased accuracy with the next ranged attack they make. This accuracy bonus stacks until the archer hits with an attack.

Berserk Fortitude: While the Barbarian is berserk, a percentage of all damage taken is delayed until the end of the berserk condition. When the Barbarian loses the berserk condition, all of this damage is taken at once with no method to reduce or ignore it.
Resounding Performance — When the Bard applies an enhancement condition, it has a chance to critical based on spell critical chance. A critical enhancement has a greater effect than normal.
Preemptive Summon: The first summon ability the Binder uses in battle has reduced mana cost and cast time.
Compelled Dedication: The fighter has improved damage versus any enemy that she has compelled.
Improved Intercessions – Whenever the knight intercedes on an attack against an ally, he takes less damage.
Deflect Arrows: The monk has a chance to parry ranged attacks.
Trap Sense: Whenever a unit would trigger a trap, they have a chance to ignore the effects. This skill applies to the Rogue at a greater value.
Spell Parry: The spellsword has a chance to parry magic attacks.

Flittering Elements — If the current ability's element differs from the previous ability's element, it has increased power. Only abilities with one of the six core elements count for this comparison. Chaos and non-elemental abilities do not update the recorded element.

Ambush Critical – Guarantee critical with next attack. Requires all enemies at full health (Burglar)
Chosen Victim – Gain advantage whenever striking target enemy. Requires target is at full health, can only be used on one enemy at a time, and lasts until death. (Burglar)
Maintain the Ambush – Become hidden, quicken, and gain advantage. Omega. Requires all enemies to have full health (Burglar)
Quicken Ambush – Quicken self for each enemy at full health (Burglar)
Salt the Wound – Delay and disrupt enemy suffering from a bleed (Burglar)
Unerring Ambush – Next attack against enemy at full health can’t miss (Burglar)
Ambush Jab – Melee attack against enemy at full health (Burglar)
Ambush Reaction – Melee attack against enemy that gains full health (Burglar)
Ambush Wound – Afflicts target at full health with wound (Burglar)
Burn Exposure Toxin – Provides Burglar with poison that causes fire exposure (Burglar)
Corrupt Wound – Single target. Costs mana. Reduces the target's maximum health by up to its missing health, potentially creating a new full-health window. (Burglar)
Planned Ambush – Prepared melee attack that requires target have full health on preparation and beginning of next round. Makes attack at beginning of next round (Burglar)
Purge Punisher – Attack enemy following it purging. Prepared (Burglar)
Advantageous Ambush – Melee attack against full health that generates advantage (Burglar)
Ambush Decimation – Melee attack with decimate against enemy at full health (Burglar)
Disenchanting Ambush – Melee attack against full health that disenchants (Burglar)
Draining Slash – Melee attack from hidden that drains life. Consumes advantage (Burglar)
Enchanting Advantage – Melee attack against enchanted enemy that disenchants and generates advantage (Burglar)
Flame Backstab – Fire melee attack requiring hidden that causes fire exposure (Burglar)
Hidden Ambush – Melee attack against full health that grants Burglar hidden before attack (typically lost after attack) (Burglar)
Lightning Ambush – Melee attack against full health that also deals damage to two random enemies (Burglar)
Phasing Darkness – Melee attack from hidden with phasing (Burglar)
Protective Ambush – Melee attack against full health that grants Burglar enhanced defense. Consumes advantage (Burglar)
Quick Sidestrike – Melee attack that cannot be countered that causes flanking (Burglar)
Stupefying Ambush – Melee attack against enemy at full health that damages mana and prevents mana gain (Burglar)
Confidence – Gain lucky (Thief)
Enhancement Theft – Steals an enhancement from the target (Thief)
Hallucination Toxin – Provides Thief with poison that causes illusory exposure (Thief)
Steal Shield – Prevent target from blocking and gain block chance and amount of target if block chance is higher than own (Thief)
Steal Stamina – Tire enemy and lower own tired value, quicken self (Thief)
Stolen Focus – Target loses focus and thief gains it (Thief)
Twist the Knife – Follows a critical hit with a bleed based on the damage dealt by the critical hit (Thief)
Enhance Theft – Enhance life drain, mana drain, and any stat drains until end of turn (Thief)
Hidden Speed – Quicken self. Requires hidden. Omega (Thief)
Spread the Wealth – Until the Thief's next turn, healing received (including life drain) and mana gained (excluding mana regeneration) is also shared with all allies at a reduced percentage. (Thief)
Steal Darkness – Steals the hidden enchantment from one enemy (Thief)
Steal Mana – Drain mana from target. Requires hidden (Thief)
Vindictive Advantage – Gain advantage whenever thief counters until next turn (Thief)
Accuracy Theft – Lowers target accuracy and raises the Thief's own accuracy. (Thief)
Advantageous Leech – Melee attack with life drain that generates advantage based on life drained (Thief)
Afterthought Strike – Melee attack that also attacks another random enemy, requires dualwielding (Thief)
All Out Advantage, Superior – Melee attack that consumes all advantage to deal extra damage. Deals between 108% to 492% damage. (Thief)
Speed Theft – Lowers target speed and raises the Thief's own speed. (Thief)
Defense Theft – Melee attack that lowers target defense and raises own (Thief)
Dissuading Strike – Melee attack that averts and delays target (Thief)
Lucky Rend – Dualwield melee attack that grants lucky if both attacks hit (Thief)
Penetration Advantage – Melee attack that consumes all advantage to gain penetration based on advantage used (Thief)
Trip and Stab – Melee attack with chance for prone, second attack if target made prone, requires dual wield (Thief)
Steal Senses – Melee attack that afflicts the target with blind and distracted. (Thief)
Unseelie Theft – Melee attack that steals an enchantment and mana from target. Costs advantage (Thief)

Single-target precision and sustained aim buildup. Dexterity-focused ranged damage that rewards committing to one target turn after turn, with penetration, pinpoint, and aim-spending payoffs that grow stronger the longer focus is maintained.

High-risk melee burst powered by taking damage. Strength-focused raw output that deliberately weaponizes self-harm to generate rage, with berserk states that amplify damage at the cost of control and a deferred-damage capstone that turns invulnerability into a ticking clock.

Team-wide buffing and debuffing through sustained song. Wisdom-focused support that maintains audience-based chord and dischord effects across multiple characters simultaneously, rewarding careful composition of who is listening and what condition is most valuable at any moment.

Companion summoning and alignment management. Wisdom-focused control that pushes along an Eros/Thanatos scale to unlock and empower summoned allies, with threshold-crossing bursts that reset alignment and punish enemies when commitment to one side runs too deep.

Divinity-fueled support and elemental offense. Wisdom-focused healer who generates a resource by helping allies and spends it on fixed-cost elemental control attacks or all-in light bursts, with resurrection and defensive tools that can reverse lost battles outright.

Expertise-gated melee control and damage. Strength-focused brawler who builds a combat resource through stance-dependent actions, unlocking progressively stronger abilities as expertise accumulates, and forcing enemies to attack her through compel abilities that her passives and capstone then punish.

Defensive bonding and companion protection. Strength-focused tank who selects one ally to guard, absorbs their damage, and builds a toolkit of threshold-triggered reactions, block and parry boosts, and attacks that simultaneously damage enemies and benefit the guarded ally.

Form-switching melee fluidity. Dexterity-focused striker who transitions between seven chakra forms that each gate different abilities and open elemental bonuses, with attack outcomes that raise or lower the current form and demand adaptive sequencing every turn.

Influence accumulation and mental control. Intelligence-focused controller who layers influence on individual enemies to scale damage, unlock possession abilities, and generate defensive resources, with feedback damage as a built-in deterrent against careless kill timing.

Soul harvesting and sustained ranged attrition. Wisdom-focused damage dealer who accumulates soul power and soul orbs through dealing damage and killing, spending them on attacks, ongoing buffs, and resurrection while managing the constant drain those sustained abilities impose.

Finite resource alpha strikes and hidden-state exploitation. Dexterity-focused melee striker who spends a limited Advantage pool for exponentially scaling burst damage, regenerates it through hidden status, and decides each turn whether to strike hard now or preserve resources for a bigger moment.

Single-target elemental challenge and imbuement chaining. Strength-focused elemental melee attacker who locks onto one enemy with Challenge and builds an ever-strengthening set of elemental proc conditions against them, while loading imbuement procs onto herself that fire as secondary effects on every swing.

Preparation-dependent ranged versatility. Dexterity-focused technical class who loads twelve types of ammunition as move actions to define what each attack does, with belt abilities that change function depending on cannister state and strong summoning that creates persistent companions and devices.

Malediction spreading and affliction scaling. Intelligence-focused curse spreader who applies malediction to as many enemies as possible so that multi-target abilities scale with the count, uses enemy deaths as mana and healing resources through Graveyard abilities, and stacks affliction-amplifying passives across a deep subclass tree.

Six-element Conflux cycling and elemental versatility. Intelligence-focused elemental caster who builds attunement across all six elements to unlock the most powerful Conflux abilities, with subclasses that specialize each element independently and a passive tree that stacks piercing, power, and adds across every tree she unlocks.

Passives
Ranged damage increases the damage of any ranged ability.
Penetration increases the amount of armor ignored by penetrate abilities. If penetration exceeds 100%, the damage is increased by the left-over percentage.
Accuracy increases the chance for the unit to hit with ranged and melee attacks.
Pinpoint increases the value of pinpoint damage and effects
Alone damage increases the damage of the unit when it is the last unit left alive.
Critical chance increases the chance for attacks of the unit to be critical hits.
Initial accuracy increases the chance to hit for the unit’s first action of each wave.
Distant damage increases the damage of any ability targeting enemies in the back row. Distant abilities gain increased bonus.
Speed increases how often a unit gets to act.
Solitary Power
Area dodge increases the chance for the unit to dodge abilities that target all, rows, and columns.
Alone defense increases the defense of the unit when it is the last unit left alive.
Solitary power increases the damage and healing of single-target abilities used by the unit.
Dexterity mastery increases the adjusted value of dexterity by a percentage amount. Mastery abilities do not affect acquisition of abilities.
Charm Mastery increases the adjusted value of charm by a percentage amount. Mastery abilities do not affect acquisition of abilities.
Combined elemental resistances increase both associated resistances.
Ranged critical chance increases the chance for the unit to deal critical hits with ranged attacks.
Ranged accuracy increases the chance for the unit to hit with ranged attacks.
Disruption power increases the value of any disrupt effect used by the unit.
Ignore counter gives the unit a chance to ignore the effects of any counter attack.
Air adds increases air damage which is added to attacks.

“You look absolutely delicious.”

The cannibal is a non-descript member of the public. She wears the same plain clothes of the village she lives in, and the weapons she carries can easily be explained away. She is muscular, but her clothing disguises this.
“Sometimes to save what we love, we must destroy everything.”
At first, it seems the weapons and armor of the Destroyer are held together by spit and hope, but it quickly becomes clear that they are sturdier than they look.
“I am the lord of all beasts who walk the earth. They bow before me.”

It is hard to find the Beastlord beneath her mountain of furs. Her hair is unkempt, with leaves and bones tangled in it, and the smell is potent. She says it is to help her better fit in with the beasts.

Desperation — Certain Bandit abilities require him to be the last surviving ally. When alone, he gains access to dedicated desperation abilities and advantage generators unavailable while allies are present. Desperation Mana carries no advantage cost, allowing the Bandit to shift into a mana-fueled economy when alone.

Reliability — Certain Acrobat abilities are tagged as reliable. When a reliable ability fails to connect, its resource cost is refunded in full. The Acrobat still requires the resources to attempt the ability, but failed attempts do not drain his economy.

Contracts — The Assassin can sign a contract against a single enemy at any point during battle using a Minor action. Only one contract may be active at a time. While a contract is active, the Assassin gains passive benefits for attacking the contracted target. When the Assassin personally kills the contracted target with an active ability, he receives the contract's fulfillment bonus.

Wagers — Brigand abilities follow a wager-and-pot structure. The Brigand spends advantage or mana as a wager when using certain abilities. If a triggering condition occurs, he collects the pot as a payoff.

A psychological warfare specialist who weaponizes illusion and terror, building illusory damage pools that kill enemies from the inside when they exceed current health. He thrives in Spirit Fugue, his Atmosphere abilities blooming into their full power the deeper into delirium he pushes.

A relentless finisher who specializes in the endgame of a battle — bleeding, poisoning, and dismantling the last enemy standing. Her kit accelerates toward that final isolated target, delivering the killing blow with empowered fury the moment her prey stands alone.

A paranoia-fueled controller who grows stronger the more enemies surround him, whispering commands into possessed minds and drowning the battlefield in retaliation. He turns enemy numbers from a threat into an advantage, feeding on the chaos of a crowded fight.

A dream-state manipulator who puts enemies to sleep and punishes them for it, while voluntarily slipping into incapacitation himself to trigger devastating illusory reprisals. He exists in a liminal space between waking and dreaming, exploiting both states with equal precision.

A dark confessor who consumes the afflictions of allies and enemies alike, converting their suffering into fuel for his own attacks. He turns debuffs into weapons — purging curses from his team and launching them back at enemies amplified and weaponized.

A moon-reading diviner who cycles the world's four elemental moons to deliver rotating team-wide enhancements. He adapts his kit to whichever moon is ascendant, shifting between fire, earth, air, and water buffs while wielding chaos, possession, and conditional kill tools between cycles.

An air-element strangler who degrades enemy action economy through asphyxiation, building Tired and Exhausted to leave foes gasping and unable to retaliate. He rewards pushing into Spirit Fugue for locked abilities and can sustain himself through near-death with Phoenix Soul.

An earth-element controller who buries enemies alive, locking them out of combat while setting up punishing follow-up strikes. His buried targets are temporarily untouchable but utterly helpless — patience and precise sequencing determine when they resurface and how much it costs them.

A cold and efficient finisher who locks onto the weakest enemy and refuses to let them escape. He specializes in culling, conditional kills, and overkill chains, ensuring that no wounded enemy survives long enough to become a threat again.

A water-element Reaper who weaponizes damage afflictions as fuel for conditional kills. He builds bleed, countdown, and hex in a chained cycle, then cashes out their accumulated value in devastating threshold executions — the more damage his curses promise, the deadlier his finishing blow.
Liminal Return — Resurrected allies cannot take direct damage for a brief period following resurrection, as though they have not fully returned from the void. Applies to all resurrection abilities.
Reckoning — Reckoning abilities scale their power based on the current value of a damage affliction on the target, calculating the full potential damage those afflictions represent.
Verdict — Verdict abilities can only target the enemy with the lowest health, representing the Executioner's role as the inevitable end for the weakest foe on the battlefield.

Burial — Burial is a variant of incapacitated that lasts for a fixed duration rather than ending on hit. Buried enemies cannot act, cannot advance their timer, and cannot take direct damage while buried. Burial ends automatically after its duration expires. Follow-up abilities allow the Gravedigger to capitalize on buried enemies through specific interactions.

Asphyxiation — Asphyxiation abilities build the Tired and Exhausted conditions on enemies, degrading their action economy through strangulation and air damage. Tired reduces an enemy's action options to two per turn. Exhausted, the upgraded condition, reduces actions to just one.
Breathless — Tired enemies cannot counter the Hangman.

The Four Moons — The four moons of the world cycle naturally, waxing and waning in intensity. Their benefits are team-wide, peaking when a moon is at its highest and fading as it wanes. Blood Moon enhances fire effects. Harvest Moon enhances earth and healing effects. Strawberry Moon enhances air and enhancement effects. Tidal Moon enhances water and control effects. Spirit Orbs are required to call a specific moon, and Reverse the Skies allows the cycle to be shifted.
Herald's Moon — A moon is active at the beginning of battle without requiring Spirit interaction.
Sin Eating — The Sin Eater purges afflictions from allies and himself, then weaponizes them against enemies. Consuming sin and turning it outward is the core of the Sin Eater's identity.

Oneiromancy — The Sandman applies incapacitation through dream-state manipulation, exploiting incapacitated enemies with follow-up abilities and existing in a liminal state himself. Voluntarily incapacitating himself turns danger into a powerful offensive tool.

Paranoia — Paranoia abilities scale their power based on the number of enemies currently present on the battlefield. The Whisperer grows more powerful when facing larger groups, rewarding engagement with full enemy formations.
Last Rites — Last Rites abilities interact with the final surviving enemy on the battlefield, representing the Mercy Bringer's role as the deliverer of the final mercy to the last standing foe.
Final Mercy — Whenever only one enemy remains on the battlefield, the Mercy Bringer immediately takes a turn with enhanced power.

Delirium — Delirium abilities gain enhanced secondary effects while the Gaslighter is in Spirit Fugue, rewarding the deliberate pursuit of that dangerous state. The Atmosphere suite each provides a baseline effect with a powerful Spirit Fugue bonus. Illusory damage is a stacking pool that kills the target if it ever exceeds their current health, causing a heart attack. Illusory damage can expire or be purged like other conditions.
Sustained Delusion — At the start of the Gaslighter's turn, if he is endangered, all illusory damage on enemies has its duration extended.

The most protective Knight subclass, built around absorbing punishment meant for others. Full Guard shifts all damage to him by chance, and a deep suite of Intercession abilities lets him step in front of specific threats — criticals, deathblows, afflictions, storm attacks — before they reach his guarded ally.

An overkill specialist who grows stronger the harder he hits. Punishment Guard turns damage against his guarded ally into fuel for his own attacks, and every kill feeds Ire abilities that reward excess — healing, shielding, disrupting, and damaging all enemies based on how far past death the target went.

A healer-warrior whose offensive power is tied to his guarded ally's suffering. The Righteous mechanic scales his damage and afflictions based on the health gap between his guarded and their target, making him most dangerous when protecting a wounded ally — and most selfless when the cost of that protection is highest.

A mounted aggressor who rewards speed and positioning. Delay Guard quickens him whenever his guarded is delayed, and his kit emphasizes mount synergy, momentum, and patrol abilities that punish enemies for targeting his guarded ally at all.

A mounted elemental disruptor who turns magic against those who cast it. He reflects elemental afflictions, punishes mana use, and enhances his reflections through magic defense investment — making him the Knight best suited to protecting allies from spellcasters.

A block-stacking endurance specialist whose Continuous Guard abilities grow stronger with every hit he absorbs. The longer he holds the line, the harder he becomes to bypass — though unchecked stacking risks tipping him into immortality territory that needs playtesting scrutiny.

A dual-wielding conquest machine who chains kill effects into team-wide benefits. Parry Guard extends his parry to his guarded ally, and Conquest abilities convert kills into mana, heals, purges, quickens, and in extremis — resurrection — rewarding aggressive play with cascading advantages.

A dark mirror of the Knight archetype who weaponizes corruption. He deliberately accumulates it, benefits from it, and shares its dangers with his guarded ally. Vengeance Guard extends retaliation to his guarded, turning incoming damage into a mutual threat.
Blackguard

A high-ceiling Battalion specialist who demands mastery of turn order to unlock his full potential. He waits, coordinates, and strikes in unison with allies — with rewards that scale based on how long and how many waited together. Most powerful when the player understands the clock.

A battlefield consecrator who sustains active Temple field effects at the cost of his mana. Each Temple reshapes the conditions of combat for everyone on the field, and Sacred Ground rewards commitment to one Temple over time. At Tier 25, he is the Knight at his most commanding — protecting not just one ally, but the entire sacred space around him.
“Only your blood can quench my blade’s thirst.”
“Where is the adventure in sitting at home, waiting for my inheritance?”
“I can make you more powerful than you ever dreamed yourself to be.”
“My god has found your faith lacking.”
“It is my duty to both judge and punish you, for your various failings. There will be no mercy.”
“This totem stands as tribute to the success of our tribe.”
“Just because it isn’t real doesn’t mean it can’t hurt you.”
“Anything you cannot carry off, burn down.”
“Sometimes we don’t like the fate we are dealt. It doesn’t change it.”
“I shall bathe in your blood.”
“The power of the Sleeping God flows through my blade.”
“Who’s to say the immaterial cannot be stolen?”
“They told me not to play with things I don’t understand.”
“I feed off your magic.”
“Do you dare disrupt my work?”
“Such a good deal, for something you’re not using anyway.’”
“Let me see what the cards have store in for you.”
“I can sit with you during your suffering, though there is nothing I can do to ease it. And when your suffering is over, I will revisit it upon he who brought it upon you.”
“You think you can take me? Well, come on. Bring it.”
“I’d prefer to leave this to the luck of the draw.”
“I am connected to something you could never understand.”
“What is it you fear the most? I will make it so.”
“There is nothing that says arcane might is the domain of devils alone.”
“Let me take your wounds upon me.”
“There is magic in the bones. I think yours will fletch quite well.”
“Come. Dance with me.”
“Grandfather, guide my blade.”
“Conventional weapons have failed us. Bring out the arsenal.”
"I've got a tool for every job."
“Dreams can be either the greatest or worst reality we will ever face.”
“What comes from water shall return to water. What comes from death shall return to death.”
“Catch this!”
“Strike first, and hard, so they cannot respond.”
"These shackles won't hold you anymore!"
“You trust too much in sight and too little in thought.”
“We ride in darkness and death.”
“We grow in darkness.”
“The Dark Lord Orcus can provide us devices just as effective as those made by the extinct Teknixians.”
“There is glory to be found in battle. I will sing of it.”
“Anything you can do, I can do better.”
“Wars always come down to tactics.”

Crescendo - The Minstrel tracks the number of buff-type ability actions used by any unit between his turns. Each unique buff action adds one stack of Crescendo, with a maximum cap defined per Crescendo ability. Crescendo resets when a Crescendo ability is used. Because buffs tend to be move and minor actions, building a high Crescendo count means investing smaller actions — creating a genuine trade-off between conventional buffing and setting up a powerful Crescendo payoff.
