Healer's Challenge – Initial Effect: Melee attack that heals all allies. Basic Effect: Melee attack that heals self. Challenge Effect: Melee attack that heals the ally with the lowest health. (Divine Blade)
Healing Smite – Prepared melee attack that eliminates mana gain while prepared to enhance the power of the ability. Heals all allies on attack. (Divine Blade)
Incandescent Smite – Prepared melee attack that eliminates mana gain while prepared to enhance the power of the ability. Grants a light damage add with the attack and after. (Divine Blade)
Inspire Smite – Melee attack that increases the value of any currently prepared smites. (Divine Blade)
Purging Smite – Prepared melee attack that eliminates mana gain while prepared to enhance the power of the ability. Purges all allies on attack. (Divine Blade)
Rampart Slaughter – Melee attack that grants a damage shield based on overkill. (Divine Blade)
Sanction Smite – Prepared melee attack that eliminates mana gain while prepared to enhance the power of the ability. Causes a light hex on the target. (Divine Blade)
Shielding Smite – Prepared melee attack that eliminates mana gain while prepared to enhance the power of the ability. Grants a damage shield to all allies on attack. (Divine Blade)
Shining Strike – Light melee attack that illuminates on critical. (Divine Blade)
Solar Smite – Prepared melee attack that eliminates mana gain while prepared to enhance the power of the ability. Deals light damage to all enemies with the attack. (Divine Blade)
Banal Counter – Increases counter chance until the Fatalist's next turn. Counters also damage mana. Requires Dragon form. (Fatalist)
Double Delusion – Doubles the amount of mana damage a unit has taken this turn. (Fatalist)
Equalize Mana – Equalizes mana between all units. (Fatalist)
Mana Cinders – All enemies take fire damage based on mana lost this turn. (Fatalist)
Mana Wisps – Gains mana based on enchantments lost since the Fatalist's last turn. (Fatalist)
Protected Mind – The Fatalist cannot take mana damage while remaining in his current form. (Fatalist)
Disenchanting Counter – Prepared melee attack in response to an enemy gaining an enchantment, with a chance to disenchant. (Fatalist)
Focused Thought Rune – Enchant rune associated with focus. The target ally gains mana whenever it would lose focus for any reason. (Fatalist)

Ley Line Rune – Timing rune. Generates mana for all units at the beginning of the Fatalist's turns for the next five turns. Can be consumed early to generate mana based on the percentage of its duration remaining at the time of consumption. (Fatalist)
Mana Debt – Causes mana loss to the target for each enchantment it possesses. If the target cannot pay, disenchants it instead. (Fatalist)
Mana Drain Rune – Affliction rune that drains mana from the target on each of its turns. (Fatalist)
Mana Protection – The team cannot take mana damage until the Fatalist's next turn. (Fatalist)
Shared Loss Trap – The next time the target spends mana, all enemies lose the same amount of mana. (Fatalist)
Accursed Strike – Melee attack that prevents the target from proccing on its next turn. (Fatalist)
Banality Smash – Melee attack that causes mana loss. Disenchants on critical. (Fatalist)
Burning Fist Strike – Fire melee attack that deals additional fire damage for each prepared ability and rune. Loses all prepared abilities and runes on use. (Fatalist)
Fatal Banality – Melee attack that deals less damage the more mana the target has. (Fatalist)
Fatal Fortune – Attack with culling. Requires full health. (Fatalist)
Fatal Mysticism – Melee attack that deals more damage the more mana the target has. (Fatalist)
Fuse Rune – Element rune. Magic fire damage with a fire countdown against a single target. (Fatalist)
Just Hindrance – Melee attack that deals mana damage and disenchants based on justice. (Fatalist)
Mana Equality – Melee attack that raises the Fatalist's own mana based on the enemy's mana. Requires Crane or Mantis form. (Fatalist)
Mana Fairness – Melee attack that lowers the enemy's mana based on the Fatalist's own. Requires Tiger or Snake form. (Fatalist)
Scales Rune – Affliction rune. Damages the target based on justice for the next several turns. (Fatalist)
Snake Siphon – Melee attack requiring Snake form. Drains mana and steals an enchantment. Raises form if mana is over a certain threshold after use. (Fatalist)
Cattle Call – Quickens all mounted allies. (Herald)
Drop Standard – Voluntarily drops the standard. Quickens the Herald and his mount. (Herald)
Enchantment Guard – The Herald shares enchantments with his guarded ally. (Herald)
Flat Guard – Takes the next instance of damage meant for an ally and adds the attacking enemy to the audience. Requires preparation. (Herald)
Moving Taunt – Purges movement afflictions and taunts. (Herald)
Riding Purge – Purges the mount of all afflictions. (Herald)
Battle Cry – Enhances the damage of all allies. (Herald)
Compelling Song – Causes the enemy audience to target the Herald with their attacks. (Herald)
Fortress Standard – While raised, grants all allies enhanced defense. On drop, grants all allies a damage shield. (Herald)
Mystic Standard – While raised, enhances magic power and cast speed for all allies. On drop, generates mana for all allies. (Herald)
Restoration Standard – While raised, enhances healing and purge power for all allies. On drop, heals all allies. (Herald)
Song of Shelter – Grants a recurring damage shield to audience members. (Herald)
Speed Standard – While raised, grants all allies haste. On drop, quickens all allies. (Herald)
Threshold Rally – Threshold ability that raises the damage of all allies. (Herald)
Compelling Refrain – Melee attack that compels all enemies in the audience. (Herald)
Generous Charge – Mounted melee attack that shares an enchantment on the Herald with allies on proc. (Herald)
Mounted Inspiration – Mounted attack that heals and quickens the mount. (Herald)
Ocean Block – Water damage with a chance to cause prone on the Herald's next block.
Regeneration Provocation – Melee attack that provides provoke and grants all allies regeneration until the Herald is damaged. (Herald)
Rushing Note – Mounted attack that adds the target to the audience. (Herald)
Serenading Strike – Melee attack that adds a random ally to the audience and enhances their defense. (Herald)
Speed Slash – Melee attack that quickens the guarded ally. (Herald)

Standard Bash – Melee attack that causes the same effect as dropping a standard, without actually dropping it. Requires an active standard. The Herald continues carrying the standard and its ongoing benefit afterward. (Herald)
Synchronized Partnership – Melee attack that causes the Herald and his guarded ally to each share an enchantment with the other. (Herald)
Vigilance Standard – While raised, all enemies have reduced accuracy. On drop, disrupts all enemies. (Herald)
Affliction Accuracy – Tests accuracy versus an enemy and enhances the next affliction's potency and power based on success. (Hexbow)
Exposure Castigation – Castigation. Reserves mana while prepared. Lowers air resistance. (Hexbow)
Hex Castigation – Castigation. Reserves mana while prepared. Triggers all enemy hexes. (Hexbow)
Maximized Critical – The next critical hit is also maximized. (Hexbow)
Mystic Castigation – Castigation. Reserves mana while prepared. Causes mana loss. (Hexbow)
Paimon's Mark – Compels the Hexbow to attack the maledicted enemy with the highest health and enhances critical damage of that attack. Alpha. (Hexbow)
Pazazu's Mark – Compels the Hexbow to attack the maledicted enemy with the lowest health and enhances critical chance of that attack. Alpha. (Hexbow)
Aim Castigation – Castigation. Reserves mana while prepared. Penetrates based on aim and generates aim. (Hexbow)
Malediction Castigation – Castigation. Reserves mana while prepared. Deals air damage against each maledicted enemy. (Hexbow)
Maximized Malediction – The next ranged attack against a maledicted enemy deals maximum damage. (Hexbow)
Mind Screen – Prevents the Hexbow from taking mana damage until his next turn and generates aim. Must be used as the final action of the turn. (Hexbow)
Wave of Disorientation – Afflicts all enemies with accuracy and dodge weakness. (Hexbow)
Critical Hex – Follows a critical attack with afflicting the target with an air hex. (Hexbow)
Aimed Affliction – Ranged attack that lowers affliction resistance based on aim. (Hexbow)
Battering Wind Shot – Ranged air attack that afflicts the target with unlucky accuracy. (Hexbow)
Blood Castigation – Castigation. Reserves mana while prepared. Causes a bleed. Unlike malediction, this bleed can be purged, but otherwise does not expire on its own. (Hexbow)
Cataclysm Castigation – Castigation. Reserves mana while prepared. Causes high damage versus all enemies. (Hexbow)
Choking Arrow – Ranged attack that afflicts the target with an air hex. (Hexbow)
Death Arrow – Ranged attack with culling and heartstrike. Consumes aim. (Hexbow)
Distant Hex – Afflicts a distant target enemy with hex. This hex is purged when the enemy reaches melee range. (Hexbow)
Fitness Snipe – Ranged attack that causes affliction resistance weakness on critical. (Hexbow)
Hexing Vow – Prepared ranged attack that selects its target on preparation. Afflicts the target with an air hex on preparation. (Hexbow)
Malediction Volley – Ranged attack that hits all maledicted enemies with pinpoint accuracy. (Hexbow)
Malefaction Shot – Ranged air attack that afflicts the target with malediction. (Hexbow)
Pinning Shot – Ranged attack that causes dodge weakness on the target. (Hexbow)
Amplify Discipline – Spends mana to gain both the minor and move augmentation on the next discipline ability. (Mentalist)
Breach Resistance – Follows a critical hit. Lowers the target's magic resistance for a period. (Mentalist)
Dream Disenchantment – Disenchants a target incapacitated enemy. (Mentalist)
Regret Action – The target enemy is delayed after its next turn. (Mentalist)
Strong Will – Prevents possession effects until the Mentalist's next turn. Requires not being affected by a mental affliction. (Mentalist)
Subliminal Influence – Detonation that can be triggered to generate influence on the target. (Mentalist)
Absorbing Influence – Drains mana from the target and gains influence on it. (Mentalist)
Disenchanting Influence – Disenchants all enemies based on influence on them. (Mentalist)
Possession Intervention – The next time the Mentalist would be attacked, the target enemy intercedes on the attack instead. (Mentalist)
Psionic Remedies – Purges the target of afflictions, consuming mana for each affliction purged. (Mentalist)
Regretful Impulse – Possesses a target ally, then stuns them. (Mentalist)
Subliminal Sleep – Applies a trap that can be detonated to incapacitate the target. (Mentalist)
Subliminal Suggestion – Applies a trap that can be detonated to possess the target. (Mentalist)
Battle Psychometabolism – Discipline. Melee attack after gaining a damage enhancement. Move augment grants a speed enhancement. Minor augment grants a defense enhancement. (Mentalist)
Brainwash – Target enemy has a chance to be possessed whenever another enemy is possessed. (Mentalist)

Clairsentient Terror – Discipline. Possesses a target enemy, enhanced by the frightened value on the target. Move augment causes the possession to also deal illusory damage. Minor augment causes the possessed attacker to also take damage. (Mentalist)
Ghost Grasp Trap – Creates a trap on the field that possesses the next enemy to attack. (Mentalist)
Imaginary Friend – Summons a companion that can use illusory attacks. (Mentalist)
Metacreative Crystal – Discipline. Summons a companion with enhanced abilities for each extra action available on use. (Mentalist)
Possessive Telepathy – Discipline. Possesses a target ally, with accuracy enhanced by the Mentalist. Move augment causes the attack to drain life. Minor augment quickens the ally. (Mentalist)
Psychokinesis – Discipline. Magic fire attack against a single enemy. Move augment adds piercing. Minor augment adds delay. (Mentalist)

Reactive Portation – Discipline. The Mentalist takes no damage from the next attack against her and gains an immediate turn. Move augment provides momentum and mana gain. Minor augment grants sudden and phasing during the turn. (Mentalist)

Teknos Channel – Consumes all active ammo to use a magic channel attack. Channel duration scales with the amount of ammo consumed, and the per-tick effect is determined by the ammo type consumed. See ammo table. (Mentalist)
Trauma Shot – Ranged attack consuming ammo that repeats its damage as illusory on the target's next turn. (Mentalist)
Mind Control Device – Consumes all ammo to summon a companion with possession abilities (Mentalist)
Darkness Hides – Consumes dark attunement to grant hidden to an ally. (Filch)
Magical Advantage – Consumes advantage to generate mana. (Filch)
Prepare Theft – The next enchantment on the target affects the Filch instead. (Filch)
Shadow Blend – Becomes hidden. Must follow a dark spell. (Filch)
Stolen Discount – Following a successful disrupt, the Filch's next ability costs reduced mana. (Filch)
Attuned Theft – Lowers the target's resistance to the Filch's attuned element and enhances the Filch's own resistance to that element until the end of the target's turn. (Filch)
Corruption Absorption – Reduces corruption until the Filch's next turn. Gains mana and charges dark when targeted by corruption. (Filch)
Distraction Poison – Grants a poison that distracts enemies and has improved disruption. (Filch)
Healing Spelltheft – Disrupts an enemy spell and heals based on the power of that spell. (Filch)
Illusory Absorption – Reduces illusory until the Filch's next turn. Gains mana and charges light when targeted by illusory. (Filch)
Steal Courage – Frightens an enemy and gains enhanced damage. (Filch)
Steal Spell – Disrupts magic. If successful, gains mana. (Filch)
Steal Spell Advantage – Disrupts magic and grants advantage based on the power of the magic disrupted. (Filch)
Acid Backstab – Melee attack against a flanked enemy with additional earth damage. Costs mana. (Filch)
Advantageous Rockfall – Earth magic attack against all enemies with enhanced damage based on advantage. (Filch)
Boulder, Greater – Earth magic attack against a single enemy. (Filch)

Conflux Theft – Affliction on one target consuming conflux. Weakens each elemental resistance and power on the enemy, enhancing the Filch by the same amount. Requires a minimum of 4 elements charged. (Filch)
Earthen Spikes – Magic earth damage against all enemies with piercing. Causes flanked. (Filch)
Leyline Backstab – Melee attack from hidden that deals additional damage based on the target's mana and causes bleed based on the target's mana generation. (Filch)
Mass Lifedrain – Dark magic attack draining life from all enemies. (Filch)
Mystic Backstab – Melee attack consuming advantage and costing mana. Requires hidden. (Filch)
Mystic Fissure – Magic attack. The next attack against the enemy is a critical hit. (Filch)
Steal Thoughts – Attack and disrupt the magic of the target, gaining mana based on the magic disrupted. (Filch)
Stolen Cast – Disrupts the target's prepared ability, then deals damage to all enemies based on the mana that ability had reserved. (Filch)
Vampiric Cantrip – Magic life drain damage. Requires both dark and earth attunement. (Filch)
Aligned Combat – Enhances accuracy if Thanatos aligned. Enhances defense if Eros aligned. (Synergist)
Companion Expertise – Generates expertise if the Synergist currently has a companion. (Synergist)
Endurance Stance – Gains expertise whenever the Fighter is healed or purged. Increases the effect of heals and purges received. (Synergist)
Generous Health – The next heal on the Synergist also affects her companion. Includes area heals, but conveys no other bonuses. (Synergist)
Synergetic Alliance – Toggled. The companion cannot be forced to attack the Synergist. (Synergist)
Synergistic Speed – Quickens self based on the companion's timer. (Synergist)
Aligned Weapon – The unit gains a damage add based on its current alignment. (Synergist)
Arcana Evolution – Enhances companion damage. Considered an arcane ability. (Synergist)
Defense Taunt – Taunts all enemies and gains enhanced defense for a period. (Synergist)
Defensive Synergism – Enhances the defense of self and companion, based on the other's defense. Requires preparation and ends if the companion dies or the Synergist is disrupted. (Synergist)
Offensive Synergism – Enhances the damage of self and companion, based on the other's damage. Requires preparation and ends if the companion dies or the Synergist is disrupted. (Synergist)
Prepared Empowerment – Prepared ability that grants the Synergist elemental empowerment following being attacked by an elemental attack. (Synergist)
Synergetic Shielding – Prepared. Grants the target elemental shielded based on the Synergist's highest elemental resistance. (Synergist)
Alignment Offensive – The unit makes a number of melee attacks based on its distance from balanced alignment. (Synergist)

Alternating Cascade – Melee attack that costs mana and provides the companion an attack on proc, with the companion's attack costing mana and having a proc that grants the Synergist another attack. Continues until a proc fails to trigger or mana runs out. (Synergist)
Arcane Strike – Melee attack with an arcane damage add. (Synergist)
Curing Slash – Melee attack with a chance to proc a self-heal. (Synergist)
Prepared Shielding – Prepared ability that grants the Synergist elemental shielding of the incoming element before an attack would occur. (Synergist)
Readying Slash – Melee attack that causes the companion to attack on critical. (Synergist)
Summon Soulbound Doll – Summons a soulbound doll companion that shares enhancements received by the Synergist. (Synergist)
Synergetic Rush – Melee attack with the companion, if the companion's timer is high enough. (Synergist)
Synergetic Strike – Prepared melee attack with the companion, where the Synergist and companion boost one another. (Synergist)
Synergistic Army – Prepared melee attack that grants any enhancements present on the Synergist to the entire team. (Synergist)
Synergistic Preparation – Attacks alongside the companion on the companion's next turn. (Synergist)
Expert Conservation – Melee attack with mana cost reduced based on current expertise. (Synergist)

Detonate – Fires all detonation queues on all units that have detonations, simultaneously. Each target's queue fires in ascending placement order. Rider effects accumulate per target and clear when that target's queue is exhausted. Does not require ammo. Can be used by any character. (Teknixian)
Electrostatic Explosion – Disenchants self of retaliation to deal related damage to all enemies (Teknixian)

False Detonation – Places a detonation on a chosen enemy that deals no damage and applies no effect. Occupies a position in the placement index — any riders active at its position apply to it and carry forward. Increases chain count for detonations whose power scales with queue length. Pure setup; no direct payoff. (Teknixian)
Health Infusion – Places a healing detonation on a chosen ally. Restores health when the chain fires. (Teknixian)
Mana Infusion – Places a mana restoration detonation on a chosen ally. Restores mana when the chain fires. (Teknixian)
Oncoming Purge – Enchants ally with a purge countdown. (Teknixian)

Precise Detonation – Fires the complete detonation queue on one chosen target. Rider effects accumulate in placement order and clear when the queue is exhausted. Use when you need to chain one target while preserving detonations on others. (Teknixian)
Shield Surge – Grant target with damage shield regeneration for that damage shield for a period. (Teknixian)
Speed Infusion – Places a quicken detonation on a chosen ally. Quickens when the chain fires. (Teknixian)
Temporary Force Field – Grants a chosen target a damage shield that lasts until the beginning of their next turn. Does not consume ammo. Usable on any ally including self. (Teknixian)

Healing Belt – Prepared. Snapshots current ammo quantity. Consumes all active ammo. Provides a number of single-target heals based on ammo consumed, with power based on ammo consumed. Each use targets any ally including self, target can differ between uses. (Teknixian)
Load Air Ammo – Loads or unloads Air Ammo. See Load Abilities above for behavior. Air Ammo: capacity 6, speed 9, range 1.1-1.3, air elemental damage, storm tag interactions. (Teknixian)
Load Delay Ammo – Loads or unloads Delay Ammo. See Load Abilities above for behavior. Delay Ammo: capacity 7, speed 11, range 0.8-1.1, pushes targets back on the CTB clock on hit. (Teknixian)
Load Light Ammo – Loads or unloads Light Ammo. See Load Abilities above for behavior. Light Ammo: capacity 6, speed 11, range 0.7-1.1, two attacks per ammo spent, light elemental damage. (Teknixian)
Restoration Infusion – Grants a target ally a healing hex — an enchantment that restores health at the beginning of each of their turns for a duration. (Teknixian)
Static Electric Field – Grants a chosen ally air retaliation. (Teknixian)
Rudimentary Balm – Places a healing detonation on a chosen ally. When fired, heals the target and injects the Heal rider, all subsequent detonations on that ally also heal them. (Teknixian)
Stun Surge – Countdown that stuns all enemies when it goes off. (Teknixian)
Teknos Armor – Consumes ammo to grant a chosen ally defensive enchantments. Power scales with ammo consumed. The specific enchantments granted depend on the active ammo type. (Teknixian)
Teknos Weapon – Consumes ammo to grant a chosen ally offensive enchantments. Power scales with ammo consumed. The specific enchantments granted depend on the active ammo type. (Teknixian)

Amplifying Shot – Ranged attack that deals increased damage for each consecutive use. Amplification stacks accumulate across uses regardless of target. Resets when the Teknixian reloads ammo. Consumes 1 ammo per use. Element determined by active ammo type. (Teknixian)

Chaos Explosion – Consumes all current ammo to deal chaos damage to all enemies simultaneously. Power scales with ammo consumed at time of firing. High-capacity ammos produce more powerful explosions. (Teknixian)
Crack Shot – Randomly targeting ranged attack that quickens the Teknixian on use. (Teknixian)

Crossbow Turret – Consumes all active ammo to summon a ranged attack companion. Power of attacks and number of turns active scale with ammo consumed. Attack element, damage properties, and special effects are determined by the ammo type at summoning. (Teknixian)
Grenade – Ranged attack versus all enemies. Consumes 1 ammo. Damage and element determined by active ammo type. (Teknixian)

Life Detonation – Places a resurrection detonation on a chosen ally. When the detonation chain fires, raises the target if dead. Can be placed on a living ally as insurance before they fall, or on an already-dead ally — the detonation queue persists on dead units and fires when Detonate is used. The ally is raised when the chain resolves regardless of when it was placed. (Teknixian)

Lightning Belt – Prepared. Snapshots current ammo quantity. Consumes all active ammo. Provides a number of randomly targeting ranged attacks against enemies based on ammo consumed, with power based on ammo consumed. (Teknixian)

Lightning Spire – Consumes all active ammo to summon a companion that makes randomly targeting attacks each turn. Power and number of turns active scale with ammo consumed. Attack element and special effects are determined by the ammo type at summoning. (Teknixian)
Mass Force Field – Applies a damage shield to all allies and self simultaneously. (Teknixian)
Regenerative Shot – Ranged attack that grants the Teknixian regeneration on use regardless of whether the attack hits. (Teknixian)

Restoration Device – Consumes all active ammo to summon a healing companion with its own ability loadout. Power of healing abilities and number of turns active both scale with ammo consumed. (Teknixian)

Rudimentary Blaze – Places a fire magic damage detonation on a chosen enemy. When fired, deals fire damage and injects the Pierce rider, all subsequent detonations in the chain ignore a portion of the target's defenses. (Teknixian)
Rudimentary Chaos – Places a chaos magic damage detonation on a chosen enemy. When fired, deals chaos damage and randomizes subsequent detonation damage by a small percentage. (Teknixian)

Rudimentary Frost – Places a water magic damage detonation on a chosen enemy. When fired, deals water damage and injects the Mana Damage rider, all subsequent detonations also deal mana damage. (Teknixian)
Rudimentary Lightning – Places an air magic damage detonation on a chosen enemy. When fired, deals air damage and injects the Stun rider, all subsequent detonations also stun the target. (Teknixian)

Rudimentary Stone – Places an earth magic damage detonation on a chosen enemy. When fired, deals earth damage and injects the Disrupt rider, all subsequent detonations also disrupt the target's prepared abilities. (Teknixian)
Storm Trap – Creates a trap on the field that causes three random air damage strikes when it triggers. (Teknixian)
Tainted Bullet – Ranged attack with penetration that inflicts wounded on the target, preventing healing for a period. (Teknixian)
Teknos Shot – Ranged attack versus single target. Consumes all remaining ammo regardless of ammo type’s normal consumption behavior. Damage scales with ammo consumed. (Teknixian)

Teknos Detonation – Places a detonation on a chosen enemy. When the detonation chain fires, deals ranged damage to the target. Consumes 1 ammo. Damage and element determined by active ammo type when placed. (Teknixian)
Timebomb – Explosive that can be detonated for damage (Teknixian)
