Chaos Heal – Prepared heal targeting a chosen ally. On preparation, randomly selects one of the six primary elements and displays it. Heals the target and grants them a one-time retaliation of the selected element. (Scavenger)
Mana Potion – Consumes ammo to grant a chosen ally mana. Amount restored scales with ammo consumed. (Scavenger)

Random Detonation – Chance to trigger all detonation queues simultaneously. Detonations that fire this way receive an effect bonus proportional to their type — damaging detonations deal increased damage, healing detonations restore more health, and other effect types are proportionally enhanced. (Scavenger)

Scavenge from Damage Shield – Damages the Scavenger’s own damage shield and restores a damage shield of greater value to a chosen ally. Net positive exchange — sacrifices current shield to generate a stronger one on a target. (Scavenger)

Scavenge the Battlefield – Reaction triggered by killing an enemy, restoring 1 ammo of the current active type up to that type’s maximum capacity. Can stack with Ransack Attack if both trigger on the same kill. (Scavenger)

Scavenged Boost – Prepared. On preparation, randomly selects one of the six primary elements and displays it. Grants the Scavenger a damage add of the selected element applied to her next attack. (Scavenger)

Damage Shield Belt – Prepared. Consumes all active ammo. Provides a number of damage shield uses based on ammo consumed, with shield power based on ammo consumed. Each use targets any ally including self. See belt rules for ammo type interactions. (Scavenger)
Field Stabilizer – Reduces damage dealt by all units until the Scavenger’s next turn. Consumes earth ammo on use. Requires earth ammo to be active. (Scavenger)
Load Earth Ammo – Loads or unloads Earth Ammo. See base Load Ability rules. Earth Ammo: capacity 5, speed 8.5, range 1.2-1.4, earth elemental damage, clobbering on tagged abilities. (Scavenger)
Load Mana Ammo – Loads or unloads Mana Ammo. See base Load Ability rules. Mana Ammo: capacity 5 base, speed 9.5, range 1.1-1.3 base, both scale with current mana. (Scavenger)
Ramshackle Shield – Grants a chosen target a high-value damage shield that absorbs a single attack entirely. The shield expires after blocking one hit regardless of remaining value. (Scavenger)

Scavenged Enchantment – Prepared. On preparation, randomly selects one enchantment from a pool of possible buffs and displays the result. Applies the selected enchantment to a chosen ally when fired. (Scavenger)

Scavenged Remedy – Prepared healing ability. On preparation, randomly selects one of four effects, direct heal, purge, regeneration, or damage shield, and displays the result. Applies the selected effect to a chosen ally when fired. (Scavenger)
Chaos Shot – Ranged chaos damage attack against a single target. Does not consume ammo. Element is always chaos regardless of active ammo type. (Scavenger)

Clockwork Scavenger – Consumes all active ammo to summon a companion that uses resource restoration abilities each turn. Power and number of turns active scale with ammo consumed. Ammo type does not modify the companion’s behavior. The ammo type used cannot be reloaded until the companion expires or dies. Standard companion rules apply. (Scavenger)
Discouraging Shot – Ranged air attack against a single target. Grants the Scavenger herself a one-time air retaliation after dealing damage. (Scavenger)
Ramshackle Shot – Low accuracy ranged attack. On critical hit applies an ammo-type-specific effect. (Scavenger)

Ransack Attack – Ranged attack that restores 2 ammo of the current active type on kill, up to that type’s maximum capacity. Can stack with Scavenge the Battlefield if both trigger on the same kill. Consumes 1 ammo on use. (Scavenger)

Scavenged Bomb – Prepared AoE ranged attack against all enemies. On preparation, randomly selects one of the six primary elements and displays it. Damage element is locked to the selected type when fired. (Scavenger)

Scavenged Lightning – Prepared ranged attack that strikes three times. Each strike targets a random enemy independently. On preparation, randomly selects one of the six primary elements and displays it. All three strikes share the selected element. (Scavenger)

Scavenged Shot – Prepared ranged attack against a single enemy. On preparation, randomly selects one of the six primary elements and displays it. Damage element is locked to the selected type when fired. (Scavenger)

Scavenged Trap – Creates a trap on the battlefield. On preparation, randomly selects one of the six primary elements and displays it. The trap deals damage of the selected element when triggered. Follows standard trap system rules. (Scavenger)

Scavenger Mines – Creates three mines on the battlefield. Element is not determined or displayed at placement. When each mine triggers it independently selects a random element and deals damage of that element to a random enemy. (Scavenger)

Teknos Trap – Consumes ammo to create a column trap. Trap element, damage, and secondary effects are based on the active ammo type at placement. Follows standard column trap rules, only units in the targeted column can trigger it. (Scavenger)
Windblast Explosive – Magic air damage detonation placed on a chosen enemy. On detonation deals air magic damage and applies delay to the target. (Scavenger)

Corrupt Shot Absorption – Prepared minor. When the next corruption attack would deal damage to the Alchemist, absorbs it entirely and converts the prevented corruption into corruption ammo. Ammo gained scales with the potency of the absorbed attack. (Alchemist)
Premade Potion – Heals a chosen ally. Begins battle prepared at no cost. After first use, re-prepares using the standard preparation system with mana cost and can be disrupted. (Alchemist)
Premade Purge – Purges a chosen ally. Begins battle prepared at no cost. After first use, re-prepares using the standard preparation system with mana cost and can be disrupted. (Alchemist)
Premade Reserve – Fills current ammo to full capacity on use. Begins battle prepared at no cost. After first use, consumes ammo to re-prepare using the standard preparation system. (Alchemist)
Teknos Purge – Consumes ammo to purge a chosen ally. Purge power and affliction

Adrenaline Surge – Places a detonation on a chosen ally. When the chain fires, quickens and heals the target. Effect scales with how close the target is to death — low health targets receive significantly stronger healing and a larger quicken. (Alchemist)

Chaos Poison – Applies a weapon poison to a chosen target’s attacks. The poison element is determined randomly when the poison triggers rather than when applied. Each triggering attack has a chance to deal a different random element. (Alchemist)

Load Corruption Ammo – Loads or unloads Corruption Ammo. See base Load Ability rules. Corruption Ammo: capacity 4, speed 8, range 1.0-1.2, corruption damage replaces or adds to attack element, no downside floor. (Alchemist)
Osteotoxin – Applies a weapon poison to the Alchemist that lasts for her next 4 attacks. Each attack within those 4 applies speed weakness with its own duration to the target hit. (Alchemist)

Overheal Detonation – Places a detonation on a chosen ally. When the chain fires, amplifies all healing received by that ally during the remaining detonation sequence, then grants an overheal effect that heals all other allies. (Alchemist)

Overkill Detonation – Places a detonation on a chosen enemy. When the chain fires, increases damage dealt to that target by all following detonations in the sequence, then damages all other enemies. (Alchemist)

Premade Ether – Grants mana to any chosen character including self. Begins battle prepared at no cost. After first use, re-prepares using the standard preparation system with mana cost and can be disrupted. (Alchemist)

Purge Belt – Prepared. Consumes all active ammo. Provides a number of targeted purge uses based on ammo consumed. Guaranteed to purge at least one affliction per use within the active ammo type’s category. Chance to purge unrelated afflictions. See belt rules for full ammo type interactions. (Alchemist)
Purge Detonation – Places a detonation on a chosen ally. When the chain fires, purges one affliction from the target. (Alchemist)

Acid Belt – Prepared. Consumes all active ammo. Provides a number of targeted ranged bleed attacks based on ammo consumed. Bleed power and element based on active ammo type. Each use targets a chosen enemy. See belt rules for full ammo type interactions. (Alchemist)
Acid Flask – Ranged earth attack against a single target. Applies defense weakness on hit. (Alchemist)
Alchemist’s Fire – Ranged fire attack against a single target. Inflicts a fire bleed that is resistant to purging. (Alchemist)

Lazarus Potion – Direct cast resurrection. Consumes all current ammo. Raises a chosen dead ally and grants them a damage shield and barrier. Power of the granted effects scales with ammo consumed. Cannot target a living ally. (Alchemist)
Mass Corrosion – Afflicts all enemies with an earth bleed simultaneously. Does not consume ammo. (Alchemist)

Piercing Bullet – Ranged attack with full penetration against a single target. Consumes penetration ammo. Reduces the target’s elemental resistances based on ammo consumed, the more penetration ammo spent, the greater the resistance reduction across all elements. (Alchemist)

Poison Tower – Consumes all active ammo to summon a companion that applies bleed attacks against enemies and grants poison effects to allies each turn. Power and number of turns active scale with ammo consumed. Standard companion rules apply. (Alchemist)

Premade Acid – Ranged earth damage and earth bleed against a single target. Begins battle prepared at no cost. After first use, re-prepares using the standard preparation system with mana cost and can be disrupted. (Alchemist)

Premade Explosive – Ranged fire damage against all enemies. Begins battle prepared at no cost. After first use, re-prepares using the standard preparation system with mana cost and can be disrupted during preparation. (Alchemist)
Vampire Blood Detonation – Places a life drain detonation on a chosen enemy. When the chain fires, drains health from the target and transfers a portion to the Alchemist. (Alchemist)
Venomous Fog – Consumes ammo to create a persistent field-based bleed. All enemies in the field are afflicted with a bleed for its duration. Element and potency based on active ammo type. (Alchemist)

Allied Detonations – Triggers all detonations currently on allied units simultaneously. Fires each allied unit’s detonation queue in ascending placement order. Does not affect enemy detonation queues. (Artificer)

Enhance Accumulation – Immediately increases the current accumulation value of all active accumulating abilities. Most effective when multiple accumulations are running simultaneously. Does not affect the rate of future accumulation — it is a one-time boost to present values. (Artificer)
Healing Augmentation – Enhances the next heal that targets the chosen character, increasing its value when it fires. Can be applied to any character including self. (Artificer)

Lucky Strike Trap – Places a trap that enchants the next ally to act with blessed, causing their attack to check twice for hit and damage, taking the better result. Follows standard trap system rules. (Artificer)

Recover Detonation – Re-places the exact last detonation that fired on the same target, preserving its original effect values. A well-accumulated or high-value detonation can be immediately replicated after it fires. (Artificer)

Absorb Diffused Force – Damages all enemy damage shields simultaneously. Converts the total value destroyed into a damage shield and ammo for the Artificer. Mana cost increases based on how much ammo is currently missing, using it when nearly empty is more expensive but yields greater resource recovery. (Artificer)

Accumulating Heal – First use: Targets a chosen ally and begins accumulating healing power. Power grows each clock tick. Second use: Delivers the accumulated healing to the target. The longer between first and second use, the more health is restored. (Artificer)

Damage Add Belt – Prepared. Consumes all active ammo. Provides a number of single-use elemental damage adds based on ammo consumed. Each use grants one ally a damage add that applies to their next attack only. Uses can be distributed across different allies. Element and secondary effect determined by ammo type. See belt rules for full ammo type interactions. (Artificer)
Enduring Detonation – Places a detonation on a chosen ally. When the chain fires, grants the target the enduring condition. (Artificer)
Load Water Ammo – Loads or unloads Water Ammo. See base Load Ability rules. Water Ammo: capacity 8, speed 10, range 0.9-1.2, water elemental damage, mana generation on applicable attacks. (Artificer)
Magnetic Disruption – Damages the damage shields of all enemies simultaneously. Does not deal direct damage to health. (Artificer)
Restore Forcefields – Restores all damage shields on all party members simultaneously to their current maximum values. (Artificer)

Teknos Shielding – Consumes ammo to grant a chosen ally an elemental shield matched to the active ammo type, air ammo grants air shielded, earth grants earth shielded, and so on. Non-elemental ammos produce distinct effects: Mana grants a mana shield; Delay grants a speed-protecting barrier; Penetration grants a shield that resists penetrating attacks; Flechette grants a multi-layered shield with high total value; Illusory grants an illusory resistance shield; Corruption grants a corruption-absorbing shield. Power scales with ammo consumed. (Artificer)

Accumulating Detonation – Places a damage detonation on a chosen enemy. Does not consume ammo. Power increases with each clock tick from placement. The longer it sits before detonation, the more damage it deals when the chain fires. (Artificer)

Accumulating Trap – Places a damage trap on the battlefield. Does not consume ammo. Power increases with each clock tick from placement. The longer it sits before triggering, the more damage it deals when an enemy activates it. Follows standard trap system rules. (Artificer)

Beam Accumulator – First use: Consumes all active ammo. Begins accumulating damage based on ammo consumed and active ammo type, which are locked at this moment. Power grows each clock tick. Second use: Expends all accumulated damage in a focused beam attack against an entire column with a stun effect. (Artificer)
Beam Trap – Places a trap that deals air damage to an entire column when the next enemy acts. Follows standard trap system rules. (Artificer)

Burst Accumulator – First use: Consumes all active ammo. Begins accumulating damage based on ammo consumed and active ammo type, which are locked at this moment. Power grows each clock tick. Second use: Expends all accumulated damage in a simultaneous attack against all enemies. (Artificer)
Chaos Artifice – Ranged chaos damage attack against a single target. Also places a detonation on the target. Consumes 1 ammo. (Artificer)

Lightning Artifice – Fires three randomly targeting air attacks that each have a chance to disrupt prepared abilities on their targets. Also places a detonation on the primary target. Consumes ammo. (Artificer)

Recovery Steam – Purges the entire party of one damage affliction per water ammo currently possessed, then consumes all water ammo. Requires water ammo to be active. The more water ammo held at the moment of use, the more afflictions are cleansed across the team. (Artificer)

Restoration Station – Consumes all active ammo to summon a companion that heals all allies simultaneously each turn. Power and number of turns active scale with ammo consumed. Active ammo type modifies secondary effects applied alongside each heal. Standard companion rules apply. See Alchemist entry for full description. (Artificer)
Shock Stun Trap – Places a trap that deals air damage to all enemies and stuns them when the next enemy acts. Follows standard trap system rules. (Artificer)

Storm Accumulator – First use: Consumes all active ammo. Begins accumulating a number of strikes based on ammo consumed and active ammo type, which are locked at this moment. Strike count grows each clock tick. Second use: Expends all accumulated strikes as randomly targeting attacks against enemies, each dealing damage of the locked ammo type. (Artificer)

Thunderbolt Detonation – Places a detonation on a chosen enemy. When the chain fires, deals air damage to the primary target and simultaneously deals distraction damage to a random different enemy. (Artificer)
Battle Modifications – Toggle. While active, the companion gains enhanced damage but reduced accuracy. Affects companion only. Costs a move action to activate and deactivate. (Tinker)
Mono-Bullet – Consumes 1 penetration ammo. Grants the Tinker’s next attack penetration, phasing, and ghost touch simultaneously. (Tinker)
Opportune Boost – Grants the companion a very short duration random damage add on its next attack. (Tinker)
Power Modifications – Toggle. While active, the Tinker’s ability damage increases but her speed decreases. Affects Tinker only. Costs a move action to activate and deactivate. (Tinker)
Protection Modifications – Toggle. While active, the companion gains enhanced dodge but reduced defense. Affects companion only. Costs a move action to activate and deactivate. (Tinker)
Targeting Modifications – Toggle. While active, the Tinker’s area damage increases but single target damage decreases. Affects Tinker only. Costs a move action to activate and deactivate. (Tinker)
Teknos Companion Upgrade – Enhances the companion until the Tinker’s next turn based on active ammo type. Effect and potency vary with ammo type. (Tinker)

Arcing Field Trap – Consumes all mana to create a field trap that deals air damage to enemies that attack the Tinker. Each enemy damaged by this trap also triggers air damage to all other enemies currently damaged by it, creating a chain reaction. Follows standard trap system rules. (Tinker)
Forcefield Detonation – Places a detonation on a chosen ally. When the chain fires, grants the target a damage shield and barrier. (Tinker)

Hard Reboot – Resummons the active companion at full health with all afflictions cleansed. Restores the original summon’s power with no additional ammo cost. Time to use varies by companion type. (Tinker)

Load Penetration Ammo – Loads or unloads Penetration Ammo. See base Load Ability rules. Penetration Ammo: capacity 7, speed 12.5, range 0.6-1.2, every attack penetrates, reduces target defense percentage before damage calculation. (Tinker)
Maximizing Detonation – Places a detonation on a chosen enemy. The next detonation to fire after this one in the chain deals maximized damage to its target. (Tinker)

Modular Chaos – Toggle. While active, each turn the Tinker has a chance to gain a random elemental empowerment or a random elemental damage shield. Affects Tinker only. Costs a move action to activate and deactivate. (Tinker)

Overdrive Modifications – Toggle. While active, the companion gains enhanced speed and increased damage but is afflicted with an untyped bleed that cannot be purged for the duration. Affects companion only. Costs a move action to activate and deactivate. (Tinker)
Soft Reboot – Resets the companion’s turn timer and purges all afflictions from it. No ammo cost. (Tinker)

Ammo Stream – Channeled ranged attack. While channeling, consumes ammo each tick and deals damage per tick based on active ammo type and current ammo quantity. Channeling continues until ammo is exhausted. High-capacity ammo types produce longer channels; high-damage ammo types produce more powerful hits per tick. (Tinker)

Flame Spewer – Consumes all active ammo to summon a companion that uses channeling attacks each turn. Attack element and effects are determined by ammo type at summoning. Power and number of turns active scale with ammo consumed. Subject to active modifications. Standard companion rules apply. (Tinker)

Lightning Tosser – Consumes all active ammo to summon a companion that fires randomly targeting attacks each turn. Attack element and effects are determined by ammo type at summoning. Power and number of turns active scale with ammo consumed. Subject to active modifications. Standard companion rules apply. (Tinker)

Modular Beam – Ranged attack against a chosen column. Deals untyped or air damage at no ammo cost. Behavior changes based on active modifications: Overdrive deals damage to the Tinker herself and applies bleed to all targets hit; Battle increases damage but reduces accuracy; Power makes the beam penetrating but delays the Tinker after use; Protection reduces damage dealt but reduces the damage output of all targets hit; Targeting changes the attack from column to row; Modular Chaos deals random element damage. (Tinker)

Modular Bomb – Places an untyped damage detonation on a chosen enemy. Behavior changes based on active modifications: Overdrive increases ammo cost and increases detonation damage; Battle increases critical damage but reduces critical chance; Power increases damage but delays the Tinker after use; Protection grants the Tinker a small damage shield when the detonation triggers; Targeting causes the detonation to hit all enemies on trigger for reduced damage per target; Modular Chaos changes detonation damage to a random element. (Tinker)

Modular Ray – Single target ranged attack with no ammo cost and no base element. Behavior changes based on active modifications: Overdrive causes the companion to also attack the target; Battle increases damage but reduces accuracy; Power makes the attack penetrating but delays the Tinker after use; Protection delays the target and reduces damage dealt; Targeting increases accuracy but reduces critical chance; Modular Chaos adds a random element damage component. (Tinker)

Modular Trap – Places a field trap with untyped damage and a generic trigger — fires on the next unit to act. Behavior changes based on active modifications: Overdrive causes the companion to attack the triggering enemy when the trap fires; Battle increases trap damage but reduces critical chance; Power increases trap damage and shortens arm time; Protection grants the Tinker a small damage shield when the trap triggers; Targeting changes placement from field to column; Modular Chaos randomizes the trap’s damage element each time it triggers. Follows standard trap system rules. (Tinker)
Numbing Trap – Places a water damage trap. When triggered, slows the triggering enemy. Unaffected by modifications. Follows standard trap system rules. (Tinker)

Rainbow Bolt – Ranged chaos attack against a single target. Consumes ammo. Secondary effect determined by active ammo type, follows the same ammo interaction pattern as other ammo-sensitive abilities. (Tinker)

Activate Assistant – Triggers all active assistant procs on a chosen ally immediately, as if that ally had just attacked. Each proc fires in full, including any ammo costs for ammo-consuming assistants. (Engineer)
Armor Charge – Consumes ammo to grant the companion a retaliation based on active ammo type. The retaliation lasts until the companion’s next turn. (Engineer)

Grease Trap – Places a field trap. When triggered, each enemy has a chance to become prone when taking an action, with the chance scaling based on their momentum. Follows standard trap system rules. (Engineer)

Magnetic Trap – Places a field trap that delays a single enemy and disenchants their damage shield when triggered. Can fire up to three times before expiring. Follows standard trap system rules. (Engineer)
Weapon Charge – Consumes ammo to grant the companion extra air damage on its next attack. Damage bonus scales with ammo consumed. (Engineer)

Defensive Assistant – Assigns the Defensive Assistant to a chosen ally. Whenever that ally attacks, they receive a damage shield. No ammo cost on proc. Persists until reassigned to a different ally. (Engineer)

Load Flechette Ammo – Loads or unloads Flechette Ammo. See base Load Ability rules. Flechette Ammo: capacity 20, speed 10, range 0.8-1.5, consumes 1-6 per shot with damage tightly correlated to consumption; Teknos Shot always consumes the full 20. (Engineer)

Medical Assistant – Assigns the Medical Assistant to a chosen ally. Whenever that ally attacks, a random ally is healed. No ammo cost on proc. Persists until reassigned to a different ally. (Engineer)

Minefield Assistant – Assigns the Minefield Assistant to a chosen ally. Whenever that ally attacks, a new field trap is placed based on the Engineer’s active ammo type. No ammo cost on proc, traps are generated freely each attack. Persists until reassigned to a different ally. (Engineer)

Mitigation Trap – Places a unit trap on a chosen ally. When an enemy targets that ally with an attack, the trap fires first and grants the ally a damage shield. The shield is lost after the attack resolves. Follows standard trap system rules. (Engineer)

Shockbolt Assistant – Assigns the Shockbolt Assistant to a chosen ally. Whenever that ally attacks, they fire an additional ranged attack. Element and effects of the bonus attack determined by the Engineer’s active ammo type at time of proc. Consumes 1 ammo per proc. Persists until reassigned to a different ally. (Engineer)
Speed Assistant – Assigns the Speed Assistant to a chosen ally. Whenever that ally attacks, they are quickened. No ammo cost on proc. Persists until reassigned to a different ally. (Engineer)

Booby Trap Companion – Places a trap on the active companion. When the companion is attacked, the trap fires a ranged damage attack against the attacker. The trap can fire up to four times before expiring. Follows standard trap system rules for trigger and expiration. (Engineer)

Companion Self-Destruct – Sacrifices the active companion to deal air damage to all enemies simultaneously. Companion is destroyed on use. Damage scales with the companion’s remaining power. (Engineer)

Concussion Mine – Places a trap that deals ranged damage and stuns the triggering enemy. Has a chance to prevent the triggering enemy from completing their action. Single use only, expires after firing once. Follows standard trap system rules. (Engineer)
Distant Trap – Places a trap targeting the enemy back row. When triggered, deals ranged damage to all enemies in the back row simultaneously. Follows standard trap system rules. (Engineer)

Elemental Beam Weapon – Ranged attack against a chosen column. Consumes all active ammo. Damage type and special effects determined by active ammo type at time of use. Power scales with ammo consumed. (Engineer)

Flechette Storm – Requires flechette ammo to be active. Consumes all flechette ammo to fire a storm ranged attack that applies stacking bleed to all targets hit. The number of bleed stacks and attack damage both scale with flechette ammo consumed. (Engineer)

Heavy Shot Construct – Consumes all active ammo to summon a companion that fires ranged attacks each turn. Each attack delays the target. Attack element and effects determined by ammo type at summoning. Power and number of turns active scale with ammo consumed. Standard companion rules apply. (Engineer)
Needle Shots – Ranged attack that fires six times in quick succession against a single target. Each hit deals low penetrating damage. (Engineer)
Radiation Blast – Ranged earth attack against a single target that inflicts corrupt bleed. On a critical hit, the corrupt bleed spreads to additional enemies. (Engineer)

Shield Guardian – Summons a Shield Guardian companion. The Guardian generates damage shields for allies each turn using its own fixed behavior, it does not interact with the ammo system. Standard companion rules apply for health and duration. (Engineer)
Sticky Shot – Ranged attack against a single target that slows the target on hit. Consumes 1 ammo. Element determined by active ammo type. (Engineer)

Sturdy Detonations – Places a damage detonation on a chosen enemy. When the chain fires, the detonation has a chance to be conserved rather than consumed, remaining on the target to fire again in the next chain. Consumes ammo. (Engineer)
Thunder Trap – Places a trap that deals ranged air damage and stuns the triggering enemy. Follows standard trap system rules. (Engineer)
Exposure Detonation – Detonates to cause wound, disenchant barrier and damage shield. (Tinker)
Alter Composition – Changes the element of a chosen countdown to a random element and enhances it with chaos power, increasing its damage value. (Bomber)
Compound Suffering – Deals damage to a chosen enemy if that enemy has suffered countdown damage since its last turn. Rewards stacking multiple countdowns on the same target. (Bomber)
Explosion Imminent – Reduces damage taken by all allies for the duration of the current turn. Used to mitigate incoming friendly fire from a bomb ability used on the same turn. (Bomber)

Kinetic Protection – Grants the Bomber a damage shield equal to the damage value of the next countdown currently on her at time of use. A read-ahead defensive play, assess the incoming countdown threat, then pre-shield for that amount. (Bomber)

Transfer Countdown – Transfers all countdown afflictions from a chosen ally to the Bomber. Used to consolidate friendly-fire countdowns onto the Bomber where they can be managed with Accept Explosion, Gift Bomb, and other countdown tools. (Bomber)

Accept Explosion – Triggers a countdown on the Bomber herself early, consuming it. Deals that same countdown’s damage to a chosen enemy target simultaneously. Converts a self-directed threat into a targeted offensive strike. (Bomber)

Accept Mass Explosion – Triggers a countdown on the Bomber herself early, consuming it. Deals that same countdown’s damage to all enemies simultaneously. Mass version of Accept Explosion, redirects one self-countdown into a full AoE strike. (Bomber)
Gift Bomb – Transfers all countdown afflictions currently on the Bomber to a chosen enemy target. (Bomber)

Load Fire Ammo – Loads or unloads Fire Ammo. See base Load Ability rules. Fire Ammo: capacity 4, speed 7.5, range 1.2-1.5, fire elemental damage, chance to deal area damage on applicable attacks. (Bomber)
Minor Explosive – Deals ranged damage to all allies and enemies simultaneously. Damage is lower than major bomb abilities and scales with active ammo type. Does not consume ammo. (Bomber)
Prime Explosive – Increases the damage value of all countdowns currently on a chosen target. (Bomber)

Acid Splash Bomb – Places a detonation on a chosen enemy. When the chain fires, deals ranged earth damage and applies earth bleed to the primary target, then deals a lesser version of the same effect to all other enemies. (Bomber)

Chain Reaction – Afflicts a chosen enemy with a fire countdown. If the countdown deals enough damage to overkill its target, it spreads to a random remaining enemy. This cascade can repeat multiple times if each new target is also overkilled. (Bomber)

Explosive Spire – Consumes all active ammo to summon a companion device. The companion alternates each turn: on odd turns it places a countdown on a random enemy; on even turns it places a countdown on the Bomber herself that deals damage to all enemies when it fires. Damage type determined by ammo type at summoning. Power and number of turns active scale with ammo consumed. Standard companion rules apply. (Bomber)
Explosive Trap – Places a fire damage trap on the battlefield. When triggered, deals fire damage to all enemies simultaneously. Follows standard trap system rules. (Bomber)

Grenade Belt – Prepared. Consumes all active ammo. Provides a number of ranged fire countdown attacks based on ammo consumed, with power based on ammo consumed. Each use targets a chosen enemy and places a countdown on them. See belt rules for ammo type interactions. (Bomber)

High Explosives – Requires fire ammo active. Consumes all fire ammo. Deals high fire damage to all enemies and all allies simultaneously. Damage scales with ammo consumed and is identical for all targets. (Bomber)

Impact Bomb – Consumes all active ammo. Deals damage and applies delay to all enemies and allies simultaneously. Has a chance to knock all targets prone. Damage and delay scale with ammo consumed and are identical for all targets. (Bomber)
Impact Detonation – Places a detonation on a chosen enemy. When the chain fires, deals damage and applies delay to both the primary target and all allies simultaneously. (Bomber)
Powder Keg – Afflicts all enemies simultaneously with a fire countdown. (Bomber)
Teknos Countdown – Consumes ammo to afflict a chosen enemy with a countdown. Element and countdown power based on active ammo type and ammo consumed. (Bomber)
Teknos Explosion – Ranged attack against all enemies simultaneously. Consumes 1 ammo. Element determined by active ammo type. Does not damage allies. (Bomber)
Time Delayed Detonation – Places a detonation on a chosen enemy. When the chain fires, afflicts the target with a powerful fire countdown. (Bomber)
Trigger Shot – Fires a ranged attack against a chosen enemy then immediately detonates the complete detonation queue on that target only. (Bomber)

Withering Bomb – Requires corrupt ammo active. Consumes all corrupt ammo. Deals corrupt damage to all enemies and allies simultaneously and afflicts all targets with damage weakness. Damage and weakness values are identical for all targets and scale with ammo consumed. (Bomber)

Called Shot: Arm – Prepared. Names a target. The first attack ability used against that target on the following turn gains disarm. With Quick Call, can be prepared and applied in the same turn. (Gunslinger)

Called Shot: Head – Prepared. Names a target. The first attack ability used against that target on the following turn gains stun and disrupt. With Quick Call, can be prepared and applied in the same turn. (Gunslinger)

Called Shot: Heart – Prepared. Names a target. The first attack ability used against that target on the following turn deals heartstrike damage. With Quick Call, can be prepared and applied in the same turn. (Gunslinger)

Called Shot: Leg – Prepared. Names a target. The first attack ability used against that target on the following turn applies a slow. With Quick Call, can be prepared and applied in the same turn. (Gunslinger)

Called Shot: Torso – Prepared. Names a target. The first attack ability used against that target on the following turn applies delay. With Quick Call, can be prepared and applied in the same turn. (Gunslinger)
Holster Guns – Reaction. When the Gunslinger kills an enemy, she gains focus and mana. (Gunslinger)

Precision Detonation – Places a detonation on a chosen ally. When the chain fires, grants the ally an accuracy enhancement. Their next attack also gains the unerring modifier, preventing it from missing. (Gunslinger)
Distant Scope – Increases the Gunslinger’s critical chance and critical damage for her next attack against an enemy in the back row. (Gunslinger)

Elemental Called Shot – Prepared. Immediately afflicts a chosen target with an elemental exposure based on the Gunslinger’s active ammo type at time of use. The exposure weakens the target’s resistance to that element, amplifying the next attack of that type against them. (Gunslinger)

Following Bullet – Ranged attack based on the active ammo type that follows immediately after another ammo-consuming ability has been used this turn. Element and properties match the active ammo type. Consumes 1 ammo. (Gunslinger)
High Noon – Places a countdown on the Gunslinger. When the countdown expires, she fires a ranged attack against a chosen enemy. That enemy then immediately counter-attacks. (Gunslinger)

Load Dark Ammo – Loads or unloads Dark Ammo. See base Load Ability rules. Dark Ammo: capacity 3, speed 7, range 1.4-1.9, dark elemental damage, powerful critical hits and culling on low health targets. (Gunslinger)

Storm Opening – Sets up a reaction: the next time a storm attack damages the target, the Gunslinger immediately fires a free ranged attack against it. The power of the free attack scales with the number of enemies currently alive. (Gunslinger)
Take Cover – Grants the Gunslinger scorn and a damage shield until her next turn. Used to absorb the guaranteed counter from Showdown or High Noon. (Gunslinger)
Conservation Shot – Ranged attack against a single target. Has a chance not to consume ammo on use. Element determined by active ammo type. (Gunslinger)
Cover Fire – Low accuracy ranged attack against a single target. On hit, delays the target and reduces their accuracy. (Gunslinger)
Dual Chamber Blast – Fires two ranged attacks against a single target in quick succession. Consumes 2 ammo. Element determined by active ammo type. (Gunslinger)

Full Clip – Consumes all active ammo. Fires a number of randomly targeting ranged attacks equal to ammo consumed. Each subsequent attack in the sequence deals amplified damage. Element determined by active ammo type. (Gunslinger)

Gunner’s Nest – Consumes all active ammo to summon a companion that makes ranged attacks each turn and follows each of the Gunslinger’s own ranged attacks with an additional ranged attack. Attack element and effects determined by ammo type at summoning. Power and number of turns active scale with ammo consumed. Standard companion rules apply. (Gunslinger)
Headshot – Ranged attack against a single target. If the damage dealt exceeds a percentage threshold of the target’s maximum health in a single hit, the target is killed instantly. (Gunslinger)
Longshot – Prepared ranged attack targeting an enemy in the back row with pinpoint accuracy. Cannot miss. Element determined by active ammo type. (Gunslinger)

Oblivion Shot – Requires dark ammo active. Consumes all dark ammo. Fires a single massive dark ranged attack against a chosen target with culling and ruthless modifiers. Power scales significantly with ammo consumed. (Gunslinger)

Showdown – Ranged attack against a chosen target with delay and a culling threshold. If the target survives, they immediately counter-attack the Gunslinger, guaranteed regardless of enemy type. A calculated trade: precision damage setup in exchange for accepting a hit. (Gunslinger)

Sniper’s Nest – Consumes all active ammo to summon a companion that makes distant ranged attacks each turn and follows each of the Gunslinger’s critical hits with an additional ranged attack. Power and number of turns active scale with ammo consumed. Standard companion rules apply. (Gunslinger)
Tracer Bullet – Ranged attack against a chosen target that places a detonation on them. When the detonation chain fires, deals ranged damage to the target. (Gunslinger)
Faraday Cage – Grants the Savant a flat percentage reduction to the storm attack that hit her before her next turn. (Savant)
Forcefield Restoration – Converts the next healing a chosen ally would receive into a damage shield of equivalent value instead. (Savant)

Spectral Detonation – Places a detonation on a chosen ally. Acts as a rider that grants ghost touch to all subsequent detonations fired in the same chain. When the chain resolves, grants the target the intangible condition. (Savant)

Spirit Invention – Grants a chosen ally enhanced affliction resistance and elemental resistance until the Savant’s next turn. Short-duration defensive buff suited to blocking an incoming high-damage attack. (Savant)
Temporary Empowerment – Grants a chosen ally an elemental empowerment based on active ammo type until the Savant’s next turn. Consumes ammo on use. (Savant)
Temporary Shielding – Grants a chosen ally an elemental shield based on active ammo type until the Savant’s next turn. Consumes ammo on use. (Savant)

Blessed Detonation – Places a detonation on a chosen ally. When the chain fires, grants that ally a lucky damage bonus. Also injects a lucky rider into the detonation chain, all subsequent detonations on allied targets in the same chain gain the lucky damage bonus. (Savant)

Cascading Purge – Purges one affliction from a chosen ally. If the purge succeeds, immediately attempts another purge. Continues cascading until a purge attempt fails. Each purge in the chain consumes mana. High purge power and mana investment can clear multiple afflictions in a single action. (Savant)
Faraday Connection – All storm attacks that would hit the Savant before her next turn are redirected to that enemy instead. (Savant)
Faraday Exposure – Applies air exposure to a chosen enemy and deals air magic damage at the start of their next turn. (Savant)
Hologram Defense – Requires illusory ammo active. Consumes 1 illusory ammo. Guarantees a chosen ally dodges the next attack that targets them. (Savant)

Load Illusory Ammo – Loads or unloads Illusory Ammo. See base Load Ability rules. Illusory Ammo: capacity 9, speed 9.8, range 0.8-1.3, replaces damage type on standard attacks, adds illusory damage on abilities. (Savant)

Mana Battery – Summons a companion with no ammo cost. Each turn the companion generates mana and grants it to the Savant. When the companion dies or expires, it explodes dealing damage to all targets based on its accumulated mana. Standard companion health and duration rules apply. (Savant)

Mana Flares – Places a persistent enchantment on a chosen enemy. Whenever that enemy spends mana, they take damage. Persists until the enemy is killed, the enchantment is purged, or it is manually removed. Reserves mana while active. (Savant)
Acid Shot – Ranged earth attack against a single target that applies an earth hex on hit. (Savant)

Ammunition Concoction – Concoction detonation. Placed on a chosen enemy. Ongoing effect: afflicts the target with elemental exposure based on current ammo type, consuming ammo each tick. Discharge effect: fires a number of ranged attacks against the target based on accumulated ammo consumed. Auto-detonates based on ammo used at placement. (Savant)

Cold Iron Concoction – Concoction detonation. Placed on a chosen enemy. Ongoing effect: afflicts the target with wounded and forsaken while consuming ammo each tick. Discharge effect: deals ranged damage based on accumulated ammo consumed. Auto-detonates based on ammo used at placement. (Savant)
Crystalline Spray – Earth magic attack against all enemies. Applies an earth bleed to all targets hit. On a critical hit, also applies illuminated to all targets. (Savant)

Elemental Empowered Shot – Consumes an active elemental empowerment from the Savant to fire a powerful ranged attack of that element. Damage and properties are based on the empowerment consumed. (Savant)
Faraday Pistol – Ranged attack that places a delayed effect dealing air damage at the start of the target's next turn, scaling upward the longer that turn takes to arrive. (Savant)

Ferric Acid Concoction – Concoction detonation. Placed on a chosen enemy. Ongoing effect: afflicts the target with an elemental bleed while consuming ammo each tick. Discharge effect: afflicts the target with defense weakness based on accumulated ammo consumed. Auto-detonates based on ammo used at placement. (Savant)

Piercing Flame Concoction – Concoction detonation. Placed on a chosen enemy. Ongoing effect: afflicts the target with an elemental resistance weakness while consuming ammo each tick. Discharge effect: deals magic damage based on accumulated ammo consumed. Auto-detonates based on ammo used at placement. (Savant)

Storm Call Concoction – Concoction detonation. Placed on a chosen enemy. Ongoing effect: causes a random air strike on target’s turn while consuming ammo each tick. Discharge effect: triggers a lightning storm with a number of random strikes based on accumulated ammo consumed. Auto-detonates based on ammo used at placement. (Savant)

Tangle Concoction – Concoction detonation. Placed on a chosen enemy. Ongoing effect: afflicts the target with speed weakness and an elemental hex while consuming ammo each tick. Discharge effect: applies a slow and deals ranged damage based on accumulated ammo consumed. Auto-detonates based on ammo used at placement. (Savant)

Vulnerability Device – Consumes all active ammo to summon a companion that applies debuffing abilities to enemies each turn. Ammo type determines what debuffs are applied. Power and number of turns active scale with ammo consumed. Standard companion rules apply. (Savant)
Charge Siege Engine – Consumes ammo to grant the active siege companion mana. Amount of mana granted scales with ammo expended. (Machinist)

Fortified Interference – Requires the Siege Engineer to be fortified. Causes the Machinist to intercept and take the next attack that would hit a chosen ally. The fortification reduces the damage she receives from the intercepted hit. (Machinist)

Siege Command – Upgrades the companion’s next ability to a more powerful version automatically. No selection required, whatever the companion would do next is enhanced. Typically increases damage, area, or secondary effect potency of that action. (Machinist)
Siege Engine Purge – Purges all damage afflictions from the active siege companion. (Machinist)
Strengthen Siege Engine – Enhances the damage of the active siege companion for a period. (Machinist)
Unbreakable Position – Grants the active siege companion immunity to delay until the Machinist’s next turn. (Machinist)
Flameshot Detonation – Places a detonation on a chosen ally. When the chain fires, grants that ally a fire damage add on their next attack. (Machinist)
Fortification Detonation – Places a detonation on a chosen ally. When the chain fires, grants that ally fortification. (Machinist)
Fuel Siege Engine – Consumes ammo to grant the active siege companion haste, increasing its speed for a period. More ammo consumed produces longer-lasting or stronger haste. (Machinist)

Operate Siege Engine – Immediately quickens the active siege companion, advancing it forward on the action clock. The primary operation tool, the most direct way to make the siege engine act more frequently. (Machinist)
Siege Modifications – Consumes ammo to grant the active siege companion a damage add based on active ammo type for a period. Element and potency match the ammo type consumed. (Machinist)

Teamwork Operation – Distributes delay across all allies and converts the total accumulated delay into companion clock advancement. The more allies present and the more delay distributed, the further the companion advances. A high-investment operation move that sacrifices party clock position for a major siege engine push. (Machinist)

Amplifying Cannonshot – Ranged attack with amplification. Each consecutive use increases both damage and self-delay applied to the Machinist. When the Machinist accumulates 1000 or more delay resist, amplification stacks reset, clearing the accumulated bonus and penalty and allowing the cycle to begin again. (Machinist)

Ballista – Consumes all active ammo to summon a Ballista companion that makes powerful single-target ranged attacks. Base speed is very low, requires Machinist operation to fire frequently. Power and number of turns active scale with ammo consumed. Ammo type determines attack element and effects. Standard companion rules apply. (Machinist)

Battering Ram – Consumes all active ammo to summon a Battering Ram companion that makes delaying attacks against enemies. Base speed is very low, requires Machinist operation to fire frequently. Power and number of turns active scale with ammo consumed. Ammo type determines attack element and effects. Standard companion rules apply. (Machinist)

Catapult – Consumes all active ammo to summon a Catapult companion that makes area attacks against all enemies. Base speed is very low, requires Machinist operation to fire frequently. Power and number of turns active scale with ammo consumed. Ammo type determines attack element and effects. Standard companion rules apply. (Machinist)

Decimate Defenses – Ranged attack against a single target that applies the decimate modifier, causes defense weakness, and disenchants fortify, barrier, and damage shield from the target simultaneously. (Machinist)

Earth Cannon – Requires earth ammo active. Consumes all earth ammo. Fires a delayed ranged attack that strikes one random column per ammo consumed. More earth ammo produces more column strikes simultaneously. (Machinist)
Exploding Cannonball – Afflicts all enemies with a ranged countdown and applies delay to all targets. When the countdown fires it deals damage to all enemies simultaneously. (Machinist)
Fire All, Major – Fire magic attack against all enemies simultaneously. (Machinist)
Fire Arbalest – Powerful ranged fire attack against a single target. Delays the Machinist after use. (Machinist)

Flaming Oil – Places a trap that deals ranged fire damage to the next enemy to act. On trigger, also applies a fire bleed to the entire battlefield affecting all enemies. Follows standard trap system rules. (Machinist)
Grapeshot Detonation – Places a detonation on a chosen enemy. When the chain fires, deals low accuracy ranged damage to all enemies simultaneously. (Machinist)
Rain of Fire – Amplified fire ranged attack that strikes three random enemies. Each hit has a chance to apply a fire bleed. (Machinist)

Teknos Cannon – Consumes all active ammo. Ranged attack with delay against a chosen column that knocks down all targets hit. Power scales with ammo consumed. Element determined by active ammo type. (Machinist)

Damage Shield Conversion – Disenchants the damage shield on a chosen unit and grants them regeneration based on the shield’s value. Converts defensive staying power into sustained recovery. (Reliquarian)

Instant Deceleration – Afflicts a chosen enemy with full quicken resist. While active, the target cannot be advanced on the action clock. The affliction clears naturally when its duration expires. (Reliquarian)
Mental Stimulant – Consumes ammo to grant the Reliquarian increased cast speed and mana surge for a period. Cast speed and surge duration scale with ammo consumed. (Reliquarian)
Recover Damage Shield – Grants the Reliquarian damage shield regeneration until her next turn, restoring her damage shield over that period. (Reliquarian)

Regeneration Conversion – Disenchants the regeneration on a chosen unit and grants them a damage shield based on the regeneration’s value. Converts sustained recovery into immediate defensive staying power. (Reliquarian)

Amplifying Trap – Places an air damage trap. Each time this trap triggers during the current battle its damage increases. The longer the battle runs, the more powerful each subsequent trigger becomes. Follows standard trap system rules. (Reliquarian)
Flash Bomb – Requires light ammo active. Consumes 1 light ammo. Places a detonation in the chain. When the chain fires, blinds all enemies simultaneously. (Reliquarian)
Mass Barrier – Grants barrier to all allies simultaneously. (Reliquarian)
Relic Heal – Heals a chosen ally. Healing value scales with total ammo currently devoted across all active relics. (Reliquarian)
Scientific Recovery – Prepared heal targeting a chosen ally. Healing scales with how close the target is to death, the lower the target’s remaining health, the more powerful the heal. (Reliquarian)

Shielding Detonation – Places a detonation on a chosen unit. When the chain fires, grants the target an elemental shield matching the last elemental ammo type used by the Reliquarian. Load the desired element before detonating to control which shield is granted. (Reliquarian)

Arachnian Automaton – Relic. Activates at a base power level and summons a companion. Additional ammo devoted to this relic increases the companion’s power and number of turns active. Locked ammo types cannot be reloaded while the relic is active. Cannot be cancelled until max devotion is reached. (Reliquarian)
Blood Accumulator – First use: begins accumulating damage each clock tick. Second use: expends all accumulated damage in a single magic attack against all enemies simultaneously. (Reliquarian)

Deceit of the Oni – Relic. Creates traps on the battlefield that deal damage and disenchant targets when triggered. Additional ammo devoted increases trap power and the number of traps placed. Locked ammo types cannot be reloaded while the relic is active. Cannot be cancelled until max devotion is reached. Follows standard trap system rules. (Reliquarian)
Heartstrike Detonation – Places a detonation on a chosen enemy. When the chain fires, deals heartstrike damage to the target. (Reliquarian)

Impulse Detonation – Places a detonation on a chosen ally. When the chain fires, sets the target’s action clock to 1000, forcing them to act next regardless of their current position. Only one Impulse Detonation can be active at a time. (Reliquarian)

Librum Historia – Relic. Grants all companions and allies mana surge and enhanced magic power. Additional ammo devoted increases the magnitude of these bonuses. Locked ammo types cannot be reloaded while the relic is active. Cannot be cancelled until max devotion is reached. (Reliquarian)

Obelisk of Shaetavar – Relic. At the end of each turn, deals magic damage to all enemies. Additional ammo devoted increases the damage dealt per turn. Locked ammo types cannot be reloaded while the relic is active. Cannot be cancelled until max devotion is reached. (Reliquarian)

Relic Blast – Magic attack against all enemies. Damage scales with total ammo currently devoted across all active relics. The more relics active at higher devotion, the more powerful this attack becomes. (Reliquarian)

Relic Bolt – Magic attack against a single target. Damage scales with total ammo currently devoted across all active relics. Single-target version of Relic Blast, higher concentrated damage at the cost of narrower targeting. (Reliquarian)

Sorcerous Barrage – Requires mana ammo active. Consumes all mana. Fires a number of ranged shots equal to the current mana ammo count. Each shot deals bonus damage based on the total mana consumed. Both shot count and bonus damage scale with mana invested. (Reliquarian)

Sylvan Restoration Relic – Relic. Grants all companions and allies regeneration and a damage shield. Additional ammo devoted increases the value of both effects. Locked ammo types cannot be reloaded while the relic is active. Cannot be cancelled until max devotion is reached. (Reliquarian)
Teknos Web – Slows a chosen enemy and afflicts them with an air hex. (Reliquarian)

Titanic Armaments – Relic. Grants all companions and allies enhanced damage and enhanced defense simultaneously. Additional ammo devoted increases both bonuses. Locked ammo types cannot be reloaded while the relic is active. Cannot be cancelled until max devotion is reached. (Reliquarian)
Wormhole Shot – Ranged attack with phasing against a chosen target. The next attack made against that target also gains the phasing modifier. (Reliquarian)

Blessed Fists – The next melee attack has lucky damage. (Avenger)
Consistent Weakness – Lowers consistency to the average. The enemy's next attack deals reduced damage based on the value lowered. (Avenger)
Focus on Restoration – Consumes focus to enhance the healing power of the next ability. (Avenger)
Prayer for Vengeance – Prayer that enhances counter chance and counter damage based on divinity. (Avenger)
Second Attempt – Reroll the damage of the last ability used this turn. Deals the difference to all enemies and replaces consistency value if higher. (Avenger)
Vengeance Taunt – Taunts enemies. Follows a counterattack. (Avenger)

Water Domain – Domain. Deals ongoing water damage to enemies. Requires minimum divinity to activate and drains divinity each turn. Generates divinity when the Avenger uses a water ability. Lasts as long as divinity remains above the minimum threshold. (Avenger)
Consistent Heal – Single target heal that deals damage equal to consistency value as healing. Lowers consistency on use. Costs less mana on average than comparable heals. (Avenger)
Divine Counters – The Avenger makes counterattacks against a number of attacks based on divinity. (Avenger)
Evasive Recovery – The unit heals on dodge until the Avenger's next turn. (Avenger)
Focused Heal – Heals an ally. Requires focus. Heals more if in Dragon form. (Avenger)
Frozen Consistency – Water magic attack that incapacitates. Requires full consistency. (Avenger)
Avenging Blow – Attack against a single target with damage increased by the last damage the Avenger took. (Avenger)
Consistent Fist – Melee attack that deals damage equal to consistency value. Raises consistency on hit. (Avenger)
Consistent Ice – Prepared water magic attack against a single enemy that deals damage equal to consistency value. Raises consistency on use. (Avenger)
Consistent Tide – Prepared water magic attack against all enemies that deals damage equal to consistency value. Lowers consistency on use. (Avenger)
Double Consistency – Dual-wield melee attack with both hits dealing damage based on consistency value. Lowers consistency on use. (Avenger)
Fist of Fortune – Melee attack with lucky damage. Requires focus. Sets consistency to the value of this attack's damage. (Avenger)
Growing Consistency – Melee attack that deals minimum damage. If the damage roll would have exceeded the consistency average, raises consistency by 1.5 times the amount over that average. (Avenger)
Justice Dodge Strike – Melee attack that must target an enemy with higher health than the Avenger. Always enhances dodge. Damage is enhanced based on justice value. (Avenger)
Mantis Bile – Melee attack requiring Mantis form that deals corrupt damage to all enemies based on open chakras. Raises form on hit, lowers form on miss. (Avenger)
Radiant Fist – Light melee attack that illuminates the target. If the Avenger is at full consistency, illuminates all enemies instead. (Avenger)
Rainbow Serpent Kick – Attacks all enemies with light damage and a chance to blind. Requires Snake form. (Avenger)
Sunshine Rend – Two melee attacks that deal extra light damage based on justice if both hit. (Avenger)
Standard Form – Purges the Avenger at the beginning of each turn. Requires staying in Mantis form. (Avenger)
Ameliorate All – Prepared ability to lower the power of afflictions on all allies. (Juggler)
Ameliorative Purge – Lowers the duration of all afflictions targeting an ally. (Juggler)
Drop Them All – Requires a juggle count of 3 or higher. Ends juggling. The next ability that starts a juggle is used twice. (Juggler)
Song of Certainty – Enhances the accuracy of audience members. (Juggler)
Take a Bow – Follows the end of juggling. Quickens all allies. (Juggler)
Accuracy Refrain – Grants all allies in the audience enhanced accuracy for a period. (Juggler)
Contemplative Purge – Spends aim to reduce the duration of afflictions. (Juggler)
Inspiration Screen – Enhances the accuracy of all allies until the Juggler's next turn and generates aim. Must be used as the final action of the turn. (Juggler)
Pinpoint Toss – Ranged attack with pinpoint accuracy against the target of aim, enhanced by aim. Consumes 1 from the juggle count. (Juggler)
Potion Toss – Weak heal and delay on an ally. (Juggler)
Ring Toss – Stun and delay a random target. (Juggler)
Sudden Toss – Ranged attack with sudden based on the current juggle count. Reduces the juggle count by 1. (Juggler)
Arrow Hex – Ranged untyped hex with penetrate. (Juggler)
Blade Juggle – Ranged attack with damage based on the current juggle count. Does not stop juggling. (Juggler)
Falling Dagger Refrain – Afflicts all members of the audience with untyped hex. (Juggler)
Hex Note – Ranged attack that adds the target to the audience and causes untyped hex. (Juggler)
Inspiring Vow – Prepared ranged attack that selects its target on preparation. Quickens the team on use. (Juggler)
Juggle Axes – Ranged attack that begins or continues juggling, adding to the juggle count. Higher base damage than other juggle builders. No element or rider effect. (Juggler)
Juggle Clubs – Ranged attack with the clobbering modifier that begins or continues juggling, adding to the juggle count. (Juggler)
Juggle Icicles – Ranged water attack that begins or continues juggling, adding to the juggle count. Causes delay. (Juggler)
Juggle Torches – Ranged fire attack that begins or continues juggling, adding to the juggle count. Causes fire bleed on critical. (Juggler)
Juggling Daggers – Three random ranged attacks. Requires a juggle count of at least 3. Lowers the juggle count by 3. (Juggler)
Juggling Storm – Ends juggling to deal storm damage based on the juggle count spent. (Juggler)
Musical Daggers – Two random ranged attacks that add their targets to the audience. Requires a juggle count of at least 2. Lowers the juggle count by 2. (Juggler)
Storm Refrain – Magic air storm attack that strikes enemies in the audience randomly a number of times based on total audience members. (Juggler)
Blood Empowerment – Spends health to gain a random empowerment until the end of the Kaotek's next turn. (Kaotek)
Blood Shielding – Spends health to gain random shielding until the end of the Kaotek's next turn. (Kaotek)
Chaos Interference – Lowers a random elemental power of the target. (Kaotek)
Chaos Upgrade – Consumes 1 ammo to grant the companion a random damage add to its next attack. (Kaotek)
Focused Splash – The next splash ability targets only its primary target with a greatly increased effect, forgoing the adjacent splash. (Kaotek)
Chaos Boost – Grants an ally a random elemental damage add for a period. Consumes spirit power. (Kaotek)
Chaos Burn Aura – Damages all enemies with random elemental damage at the beginning of their turns. Spirit aura that consumes Spirit Orbs on use and spirit power over time. (Kaotek)
Elemental Overload – Magic attack against an enemy. Requires the target to have an elemental empowerment. Damage type is based on that empowerment, enhanced by the enemy's elemental power. (Kaotek)
Retaliation Detonation – Grants a target ally retaliation on detonation based on the last element in the chain, increased by the elemental damage of the chain. (Kaotek)
Teknos Empowerment – Consumes ammo to gain empowerment based on current ammo. (Kaotek)
Amplified Chaos Shot – Ranged attack with random damage that amplifies whenever it deals a different damage type. Resets when all elements have been used. Uses ammo. (Kaotek)
Amplified Chaos Storm – Ranged attack against random enemies that amplifies whenever it deals a different damage type, and makes extra attacks with each amplification. (Kaotek)
Ammo Splash – Consumes ammo to deal damage to the target and adjacent enemies. Attacks a different enemy on miss, without splash. (Kaotek)
Chaos Ray – Chaos damage against a single target that switches initiative with a random enemy. (Kaotek)
Erratic Contraption – Consumes all ammo to summon a companion with chaos abilities. (Kaotek)
Frost Splash – Water elemental damage and slow to the target, water damage and delay to all adjacent enemies. Attacks a different random enemy on miss, without splash. (Kaotek)
Greater Chaos Channel – Channeled chaos magic damage against a single target that changes element occasionally. (Kaotek)
Ichor Trap – Dark magic trap that slows the target. (Kaotek)
Lightning Splash – Air elemental damage and stun to the target, air damage to all adjacent enemies. Attacks a different random enemy on miss, without splash. (Kaotek)
Needle Splash – Physical damage with untyped bleed to the target, physical damage to all adjacent enemies. Attacks a different random enemy on miss, without splash. (Kaotek)
Rainbow Grenade – Ranged attack that deals damage of a random element to each enemy. Consumes ammo. (Kaotek)
Retaliating Shot – Ranged chaos attack that grants the Kaotek retaliation of the same element until his next turn. (Kaotek)
Sapping Splash – Arcane damage with disenchant and disrupt to the target, mana damage to all adjacent enemies. Attacks a different random enemy on miss, without splash. (Kaotek)
Soul Contraption – Summons a companion powered by Spirit Orbs and spirit power. (Kaotek)
Soul Splash – Dark damage with corruption to the target, dark damage to all adjacent enemies. Consumes spirit power. Attacks a different random enemy on miss, without splash. (Kaotek)
Blade Attunement – Grants an elemental proc of the currently attuned element to the next melee attack. (Magus)
Critical Mana Gain – Gains mana. Follows a critical hit. (Magus)
Following Arcana – Prepared. Arcane magic attack following a melee attack. Both must target the challenge. (Magus)
Following Block – Guaranteed block. Requires both a melee attack and a magic attack to have been used this turn. (Magus)
Following Proc Strike – Prepared. Magic attack of the same element that has procced this turn. (Magus)
Following Rime – Prepared. Follows a water elemental ability with a damage shield on self. (Magus)
Attuned Imbuement – Grants an ally an elemental damage proc based on the Magus's current attunement. (Magus)
Follow the Storm – Prepared. Melee attack against each enemy hit by a storm ability. (Magus)
Following Element Strike – Magic attack that uses the same element as the melee attack used this turn. (Magus)
Following Flare – Prepared. Fire magic attack following a melee attack. (Magus)
Following Frost – Prepared. Water magic attack with delay, following a melee attack. (Magus)

Armor Melt – Fire magic attack that causes defense weakness. (Mystic)
Blazing Strike – Fire melee attack. Purges water afflictions and enhances water resistance. (Mystic)

Chaos Challenge – Initial Effect: elemental attack against the target's lowest resistance. Basic Effect: procs random elemental damage. Challenge Effect: procs an area attack of the target's lowest resistance. (Mystic)
Conflux Blade – Six melee attacks, one of each element. Requires a minimum of 2 elements charged.
Double Edged Element – Melee attack that costs mana and alternates between water and fire. (Mystic)
Elemental Defect – Chaos melee attack with a random elemental add that lowers the related elemental resistance. (Mystic)

Flame Wave Block – Grants all allies fire retaliation and counters any blocked attack with fire damage versus all enemies. (Mystic)
Homing Flame – Piercing fire magic that targets the challenge. (Mystic)
Homing Frost – Water magic with incapacitate that targets the challenge. (Mystic)
Volcanic Assault – Prepared fire melee attack that grants a fire damage add based on overkill. (Mystic)

Companion Advantage – Generates advantage following a companion critical hit. (Silhouette)
Desperate Dodge – Enhances dodge if endangered. (Silhouette)
Hidden in My Shadow – Requires having a companion. Gains hidden. (Silhouette)
Power Silhouette – Causes damage weakness on self and a damage enhancement on an ally. (Silhouette)

Necrosis Slash – Melee attack that causes corruption and wounded. (Silhouette)

Affliction Satiation – Enhances resistance of the last affliction type taken. (Spelleater)

Raging Corruption – Generates anguish based on corruption on self. (Spelleater)

Berserk Corruption – Corrupt dark magic attack with backbiting. Requires berserk. (Spelleater)
Berserk Malediction – Magic attack that damages all maledicted enemies. Requires berserk. (Spelleater)

Guide the Blade – Consumes focus to grant an ally a bonus to accuracy and critical chance based on influence. (Sybarite)
Influence Counter – The next counterattack generates influence on the attacker. (Sybarite)
Ironmind Stance – Gains expertise whenever the Fighter is subject to a duration affliction. Increases resistance against afflictions. (Sybarite)

Short Drive – Must be used before a Drive ability this turn. The next Drive lasts for three turns. (Sybarite)

Aspect of Time – Any enemy that attacks the Sybarite before her next turn is slowed. (Sybarite)

Preternatural Speed – Gains mana, then quickens self based on mana. (Sybarite)

Stun Drive – Drive ability. Melee attack with stun against the most damaged enemy. (Sybarite)
Dove Rune – Defense rune. The target deals light damage when attacked. (Warder)

Masochistic Speed – Grants an ally haste and deals the ally damage. (Scourge)
