Mystic Might – Enhances melee damage based on the number of attuned elements. (Primalist)
Primal Resistance – Enhances the target's elemental resistance based on total mana. (Primalist)
Primal Weapon – Grants an ally an earth damage add to their next attack based on total mana. (Primalist)
Stone Syllable – Magic earth attack. Requires berserk. (Primalist)
Ancient Memory – Earth magic damage versus all enemies based on mana spent during the last turn. (Primalist)
Cavern Shaker – Melee attack that has a chance to proc earth damage versus all enemies. (Primalist)
Clobbering Storm – Earth magic storm attack with clobbering. Makes extra attacks based on total mana. (Primalist)
Devolution Blow – Melee attack that disenchants the target of enhancements. (Primalist)
Mystic Slaughter – Melee attack that generates mana based on overkill. (Primalist)
Primal Bolt – Magic attack with improved damage based on total mana. (Primalist)
Primal Cantrip – Backbiting chaos magic attack. Requires air and dark attunements. (Primalist)
Primal Chaos – Random targeting chaos magic attack that deals more damage based on total mana. (Primalist)
Primal Conflux – Magic attack with six effects based on element, enhanced with backbiting. Requires a minimum of 4 elements charged. (Primalist)
Primal Strike – Melee attack with improved damage based on total mana. (Primalist)
Primal Winter – Water magic attack versus all enemies with backbiting. Requires berserk. (Primalist)
Sacrificial Earth – Magic earth attack versus all enemies that causes bleed and has backbiting. (Primalist)
Vicious Storm – Four random air attacks with backbiting. (Primalist)
Activated Mana – Whenever a proc triggers before the Rune Warrior's next turn, she gains mana. (Rune Warrior)
Critical Edge – Enhances the critical chance of the Rune Warrior. Increases the power of critical procs. (Rune Warrior)
Runic Edge – Increases the power of rune procs. (Rune Warrior)
Runic Stance – Increases proc effects. Gains expertise when runes trigger. (Rune Warrior)
Strike Edge – Enhances the proc chance of the Rune Warrior. Increases the power of hit procs. (Rune Warrior)
Temporary Fire Empowerment – Grants a target ally fire empowerment until the Rune Warrior's next turn. (Rune Warrior)
Burning Parries – Deals fire damage to the attacker on parry for a period. This damages all enemies if the parried attack was a critical. (Rune Warrior)
Extended Glamor – A target ally gains the Rune Warrior's current attack procs until the Rune Warrior's next turn. (Rune Warrior)
Expert Activation – Increases proc chance based on expertise for a period. (Rune Warrior)
Infernal Army – Grants all allies a fire damage add for a period. (Rune Warrior)
Shield Cleaver Rune – Attacks of the target lower defense. (Rune Warrior)
Stone Army – Grants all allies an earth damage add for a period. (Rune Warrior)
Blast Shatter – Fire melee attack with shattering that deals fire damage to all enemies based on the shattering value. (Rune Warrior)
Burning Sword Glamor – Melee attack with fire bleed proc. Attacks gain fire bleed proc until a new Glamor is used. (Rune Warrior)
Burnt Offering Rune – Element rune. Magic fire attack that causes wound. (Rune Warrior)
Elemental Rune Strike – Melee attack that deals additional damage based on the elemental rune. (Rune Warrior)
Expert Spellslash – Prepared melee attack that costs expertise and mana. Gains increased damage from prepared abilities. (Rune Warrior)
Expert Sword Spirit – Melee attack with enhanced proc chance. Requires expertise. (Rune Warrior)
Exploding Sword Glamor – Melee attack with fire damage all proc. Attacks gain fire damage all proc until a new Glamor is used. (Rune Warrior)
Flaming Retaliation Strike – Fire melee attack that grants fire retaliation. Has a chance to proc fire damage against all enemies. (Rune Warrior)
Fortifying Sword Glamor – Melee attack with fortify and earth damage proc. Attacks gain this proc until a new Glamor is used. (Rune Warrior)
Ice Comet Glamor – Melee attack with a water countdown proc against a single target. Attacks gain this proc until a new Glamor is used. (Rune Warrior)
Inferno Sword Glamor – Melee attack with high fire damage proc. Attacks gain high fire damage proc until a new Glamor is used. (Rune Warrior)
Shattering Earth Strike – Earth melee attack with shattering. Has a chance to critical proc earth damage against all enemies. (Rune Warrior)
Wind Blast Glamor – Air melee attack with a delay all proc. Attacks gain delay all proc until a new Glamor is used. (Rune Warrior)
Affliction Blocking – Block does not apply to damage until the Warden's next turn. Instead it prevents afflictions. This also protects the guarded ally. (Warden)
Enchantment Blocking – Block does not apply to damage until the Warden's next turn. Instead it prevents enemy enchantments. (Warden)
Lightning Guard – The Warden is targeted by any random targeting ability that could hit the guarded ally. (Warden)
Mordant Disruption – Disrupts all abilities prepared by the Warden and restores mana based on the mana reserved by those abilities. (Warden)
Mordant Pause – Prepared ability that delays all enemies. If disrupted, disrupts all enemies instead. (Warden)
Restoration Blocking – Block does not apply to damage until the Warden's next turn. Instead it prevents enemy healing. (Warden)
Cursed Threshold – Threshold ability that applies malediction. (Warden)
Entangling Roots – Slows all enemies. Delays all enemies if disrupted. (Warden)
Guard the Witch – Compels all maledicted enemies. (Warden)
Hex Protection – Hexes the next enemy to attack the guarded ally. (Warden)
Maledictor's Spite – Maledicted enemies that attack the unit take damage. (Warden)
Protect Spellcasting – Prevents the next disruption from affecting the target. (Warden)
Affliction Partnership – Prepared melee attack from the Warden with earth hex from the guarded ally. (Warden)
Compelling Malefaction – Melee attack that causes malediction with an extended compel on the target. (Warden)
Entangling Slash – Earth melee attack that afflicts the target with slow. (Warden)
Fitness Breaker – Melee attack that lowers the target's affliction resistance. (Warden)
Jagged Meadows – Field based effect that can be sustained. Causes untyped damage and delay after enemies act. (Warden)
Malefaction Riposte – Melee attack against a maledicted enemy. If disrupted, attacks and maledicts the disrupting enemy. (Warden)
Malediction Roots – Earth magic attack and slow versus all enemies with malediction. (Warden)
Mordant Blade – Prepared earth magic ability with piercing. Grants all allies an earth damage add on disruption. (Warden)
Mordant Crash – Prepared earth melee attack with delay. Causes prone on disruption against the attacker. (Warden)
Mordant Earth – Prepared earth magic attack. Causes earth bleed on disruption against the attacker. (Warden)
Mordant Mount – Prepared melee attack versus a column. Triggers a melee attack from the mount if disrupted. (Warden)
Revenant Earth – Earth magic attack targeting all enemies that reserves high mana. Casts an even more powerful version if the Warden dies while it is prepared. (Warden)
Risk the Storm – Prepared magic storm attack with five strikes. Deals damage on disruption against the attacker. (Warden)
Ancestral Protection – Prevents death effects until the Ancestral Blade's next turn. (Ancestral Blade)
Berserk Fortification – Gains fortification if berserk. (Ancestral Blade)
Earthen Weapon – Grants an earth damage add to the next attack. (Ancestral Blade)
Enduring Moment – Gains enduring until the end of the turn. (Ancestral Blade)
Provocation Anguish – Provokes all enemies and gains anguish. (Ancestral Blade)
Solitary Fortification – Gains fortify if alone. (Ancestral Blade)
Bloody Warcry – Magic damage against all enemies and self. Backbiting. Increases the value of backbiting until the end of the turn. (Ancestral Blade)
Compelling Warcry – Chance to compel all enemies and enhance the defense of the Ancestral Blade until her next turn based on total enemy rank sum. (Ancestral Blade)
Crushing Warcry – Delays all enemies and enhances the damage of the Ancestral Blade until her next turn based on total enemy rank sum. (Ancestral Blade)
Final Defense – Enhances defense and grants enduring. Requires being alone. (Ancestral Blade)
Maximum Imbuement – Grants the target a proc that maximizes damage. (Ancestral Blade)
Mystic Warcry – Generates mana for the team and enhances the next damage against the challenge based on total enemy rank sum. (Ancestral Blade)
Quickening Warcry – Quickens all allies based on total enemy rank sum and attacks twice with the next attack. (Ancestral Blade)
Raging Warcry – Enhances the damage of all allies, generates anguish, and grants a chance to maximize the next damage based on total enemy rank sum. (Ancestral Blade)
Ancestral Challenge – Initial Effect: knocks the target prone. Basic Effect: stuns the challenge. Challenge Effect: chance to maximize damage. (Ancestral Blade)
Ancestral Hex – Melee attack with clobber that causes hex based on the clobber value. (Ancestral Blade)
Attack with Ancestor – Melee attack following the death of an ally. The dead ally also makes an attack using their stats at the time of death. (Ancestral Blade)
Critical Comeback – Melee attack with a guaranteed critical against an enemy that scored a critical against the unit since the last turn. (Ancestral Blade)
Dueling Death – Melee attack against the challenge with backbiting. (Ancestral Blade)
Exact Boulder Strike – Earth elemental melee attack targeting the challenge. (Ancestral Blade)
Final Victory – Melee attack against the challenge. Requires alone. (Ancestral Blade)
Flaming Warcry – Fire damage versus all enemies and gains fire retaliation until the Ancestral Blade's next turn based on total enemy rank sum. (Ancestral Blade)
Great Earth Strike – Earth melee attack requiring a two-handed weapon that procs earth damage against all enemies. (Ancestral Blade)
Anguish Blade – Melee attack with maximum damage enhanced based on anguish. (Ancestral Blade)
Suffering Earth Strike – Melee attack with backbiting and an earth damage add. (Ancestral Blade)
Cleanse Soul – Consumes spirit power to reduce corruption. (Necrologist)
Companion's Aura – Aura that grants all companions enhanced damage while consuming spirit power. (Necrologist)
Ephemeral Heart – Takes reduced corruption damage while above a Thanatos threshold. (Necrologist)
Eternal Heart – Prevents life drain damage from enemies while above the Eros threshold. (Necrologist)
Mystic Offering – Sacrifices the companion to restore mana. (Necrologist)
Necrological Sacrifice – Sacrifices the companion to gain a Spirit Orb. (Necrologist)
Arrest Healing – Converts the dark damage of the previous attack to corruption. (Necrologist)
Decaying Evolution – The companion's attacks cause dark bleed to the target. (Necrologist)
Fall to Corruption – Afflicts a target enemy with a bleed based on their current corruption. (Necrologist)
Life Exchange – Sacrifices self to raise a target ally. (Necrologist)
Restorative Offering – Sacrifices the companion to heal and purge self based on the companion's health. (Necrologist)
Soul Motivation – Quickens the companion and gains spirit power. (Necrologist)
Speed Offering – Sacrifices the companion to quicken all allies. (Necrologist)
Corrupt Amplification – Converts a percentage of all damage on the target to corruption. Does not deal extra damage. (Necrologist)
Corrupt Blood – Causes corrupt bleed on the target. (Necrologist)
Corrupt Offering – Sacrifices the companion to deal corrupt damage to all enemies based on the companion's health. (Necrologist)
Corrupted Resurrection – Raises a target ally and afflicts it with corruption. (Necrologist)
Dark Void – Dark magic attack versus all enemies. Consumes spirit power but generates an extra Spirit Orb on kill. (Necrologist)
Ephemeral Blood – Ranged attack that causes untyped bleed and generates Thanatos. (Necrologist)
Final Offering – Sacrifices the companion to have it make a significantly more powerful attack before dying. (Necrologist)
Lich Transformation – Ongoing buff requiring Thanatos. Causes corruption on self, grants fortified and a corrupt damage add. (Necrologist)
Necrotic Shot – Ranged attack that deals corrupt bleed to the target. (Necrologist)
Spread the Rot – Targets a single corrupted enemy and deals damage to all non-corrupted enemies based on the corruption on the target. (Necrologist)
Summon Nightgaunt – Summons a nightgaunt companion. (Necrologist)
Wraith Touch – Ranged attack that deals phasing corrupt damage to the target and turns the Necrologist intangible. Requires Thanatos. (Necrologist)
Aim at the Decrepit – Spots an enemy with fragile to gain aim. (Sapper)
Breaching Spot – The next enemy critically hit before the Sapper's next turn gains fragile. (Sapper)
Brief Opening – The target gains fragile until the end of the turn. (Sapper)
Earthen Neglect – Afflicts a fragile target enemy with earth exposure. (Sapper)
Extend Decrepitude – Extends the duration of fragile on the target. (Sapper)
Increase Decrepitude – Enhances the value of fragility on the target. (Sapper)
Fragility Detonation – Detonation that afflicts the target with fragile for a period. Duration increases for each detonation in sequence. (Sapper)
Hologram Generation – Consumes Illusion Ammo to afflict the target with illusory damage and flanked. (Sapper)
Shelter Screen – Immunity to damage from countdowns until the Sapper's next turn. Generates aim. Must be used as the last action of the turn. (Sapper)
Splinter Shot – Ranged attack with shatter that can only target a fragile enemy. (Sapper)
Wreck Consciousness – Afflicts a fragile target with incapacitate. (Sapper)
Wreck Mind – Lowers the mana of a fragile target and afflicts it with magic power weakness. (Sapper)
Armor Shredding Shrapnel – Area attack that causes fragile. (Sapper)
Brittle Shot – Prepared ranged attack that causes brittle to the target. (Sapper)
Capitalize on Fragility – Ranged attack with defense weakness and a guaranteed critical against a fragile enemy. Consumes aim. (Sapper)
Deafening Detonation – Untyped countdown that causes fragile and distracted when it triggers. (Sapper)
Decrepit Heart – Ranged attack with heartstrike against a fragile target. (Sapper)
Decrepit Shattering – Ranged attack with shattering enhanced by the target's fragility value. (Sapper)
Drill Bot – Summons a drill bot companion that can cause fragile. Consumes all ammo. (Sapper)
Fragility Shot – Ranged attack that afflicts the target with fragile. Requires aim. (Sapper)
Momentary Breach – Ranged shatter ability that consumes ammo to cause a powerful, short-term fragile and defense weakness. (Sapper)
Shattering Shot – Ranged attack with shattering that consumes ammo. (Sapper)
Shockwave Shot – Ranged attack that stuns the target and delays all other enemies. Consumes all ammo. (Sapper)
Spellcrack – Ranged shattering attack that disenchants. (Sapper)
Thwarting Explosion – Area attack that causes defense weakness and disenchant. (Sapper)
Armor Alteration – Changes the elemental damage of defense procs to match the current attunement. (Scholar)
Chaos Mastery – The next chaos ability uses the same element as the last elemental ability used. (Scholar)
Critical Remembrance – The next prepared ability stays prepared if it critically hits. (Scholar)
Scroll Skip – Advances every active scroll by one step without triggering any effects. (Scholar)
Temporary Chaos Empowerment – Grants a target ally random elemental empowerment until the end of their next turn. (Scholar)
Temporary Chaos Vulnerability – Afflicts the target with a random elemental vulnerability until their next turn. (Scholar)
Weapon Alteration – Changes the elemental damage of damage procs to match the current attunement. (Scholar)
Cycling Vulnerability – Afflicts the target with an elemental vulnerability that changes element each turn. (Scholar)
Elemental Insight – All elemental resistances of the target become equal to the target's lowest elemental resistance. (Scholar)
Flaming Heart Rune – Defense rune. The target gains mana whenever it is attacked. (Scholar)
Rasp – Afflicts the target with mana burn and grants the Scholar mana surge. Mana surge is lost when the target loses mana burn. (Scholar)

Scroll of Protection – 5-step scroll. Step 1: grants all allies a damage shield. Step 2: grants all allies enhanced defense. Step 3: grants all allies enduring until their next turn. Step 4: purges all allies of afflictions. Step 5: grants all allies regeneration. (Scholar)

Scroll of Wizardry – Move action. 6-step scroll. Each step requires the matching attunement; if unavailable, that step cannot be used until the attunement is gained. Step 1: fire magic attack. Requires fire attunement. Step 2: water magic attack with shorter-term incapacitate. Requires water attunement. Step 3: air magic attack that grants retaliation. Requires air attunement. Step 4: earth magic attack that grants fortification. Requires earth attunement. Step 5: light magic attack that enhances all ally accuracy. Requires light attunement. Step 6: dark corrupt magic attack versus target. Requires dark attunement. (Scholar)
Attuned Countdown – Afflicts a target enemy with a countdown based on the currently attuned element. (Scholar)
Attuned Trap – Creates a trap on the battlefield that deals damage of the element attuned at the moment of use. (Scholar)

Chaos Scroll – 6-step scroll. Order is randomized on preparation. Advances one step at the start of each of the Scholar's turns regardless of use. Step 1: water attack that causes brittle. Step 2: fire attack with piercing. Step 3: air magic single target with stun. Step 4: earth magic attack with bleed. Step 5: light magic with justice. Step 6: dark magic with bloodlust. (Scholar)

Conflux Trap – Creates a trap that deals elemental damage. When that trap triggers, the next elemental trap is immediately created and armed. Continues through all six elements in sequence. Requires a minimum of 4 elements charged. (Scholar)

Cycle Trap – Creates a trap on the field dealing damage of the current element. The element sequence is determined randomly at the start of battle and proceeds through a fixed order thereafter. Each use arms one trap of the current element, then advances to the next. (Scholar)
Octopus Tentacles Rune – Element rune. Magic water damage and delay versus all enemies. (Scholar)
Open Eye Rune – Element rune. Magic light damage and illuminate versus one enemy. (Scholar)
Scroll of Control – 4-step scroll. Step 1: possesses a target enemy. Step 2: incapacitates a target enemy. Step 3: stuns all enemies. Step 4: disrupts all enemies. (Scholar)

Scroll of Runes – 4-step scroll. Step 1: power rune triggers its attack and grants its bonus to all following effects within this scroll only. Step 2: affliction rune causes its affliction to all enemies. Step 3: enchantment rune grants its enchantment to all allies. Step 4: elemental rune deals its elemental damage to all enemies. If the required rune type is not prepared when the scroll reaches that step, the scroll cannot advance until it is. (Scholar)

Scroll of the Afflictions – 5-step scroll. Step 1: afflicts target with fragile. Step 2: afflicts target with slow. Step 3: afflicts target with wound. Step 4: afflicts target with blind. Step 5: afflicts target with cursed. (Scholar)

Scroll of the Elements – 6-step scroll. Step 1: fire countdown versus target. Step 2: water magic attack against column. Step 3: air storm attack with 4 strikes. Step 4: earth magic attack versus row. Step 5: light magic attack versus all. Step 6: single target dark magic attack. (Scholar)
Trap Cantrip – Creates a magic trap on the battlefield. Requires air, dark, and earth attunements. (Scholar)
Growth Spurt – Enhances the maximum health of an ally with regeneration. (Songhealer)
Healer's Song – Enhances the healing power and healing received of the allied audience. (Songhealer)
Healing Spurt – Heals a target ally with regeneration. (Songhealer)
Improve Regeneration – Enhances the value of regeneration present on the target. (Songhealer)
Mana Spurt – Grants mana to a target ally with regeneration. (Songhealer)

Music Domain – Domain. Increases the effects of enhancements. Requires minimum divinity to activate and drains divinity each turn. Generates divinity whenever an ally is brought to full health from regeneration. Lasts as long as divinity remains above the minimum threshold. (Songhealer)
Root Whip – Sacrifices regeneration to delay all enemies and gain an earth damage add for a period. (Songhealer)
Aloe Bloom – Bloom. Grants an ally regeneration. When regeneration restores the ally to full health, purges the ally based on health regenerated. (Songhealer)
Dandelion Bloom – Bloom. Grants an ally regeneration. When regeneration restores the ally to full health, grants the ally intangible based on health regenerated. (Songhealer)
Deteriorating Song – Reduces the healing power and healing received of the enemy audience. (Songhealer)
Purging Spurt – Purges a target ally with regeneration. (Songhealer)
Quickening Spurt – Quickens all allies with regeneration. (Songhealer)
Rosethorn Bloom – Bloom. Grants an ally regeneration. When regeneration restores the ally to full health, grants the ally untyped retaliation based on health regenerated. (Songhealer)
Sunflower Bloom – Bloom. Grants an ally regeneration. When regeneration restores the ally to full health, heals all other allies based on health regenerated. (Songhealer)
Blunting Cold – Single target water magic attack that blunts the target's next attack. (Songhealer)
Call for Mercy – All enemy damage is minimized until the Songhealer's next turn. (Songhealer)
Divine Frost – Magic water attack that delays and incapacitates the target. Enhanced by divinity and consumes all divinity. (Songhealer)
Fertile Earth – Field effect. Grants regeneration to all allies and enhances heal effects. Can be sustained. (Songhealer)
Hemlock Bloom – Bloom. Grants an ally regeneration. When regeneration restores the ally to full health, causes untyped bleed on all enemies based on health regenerated. (Songhealer)
Ivy Vines – Earth bleed and delay versus all enemies. (Songhealer)
Raindrop Refrain – Grants the allied audience a water damage add with a weak heal. (Songhealer)
Regeneration Blast – Grants all allies regeneration. If an ally is already regenerating, heals them instead. (Songhealer)
Sunbeam Refrain – Grants the allied audience a light damage add with a weak purge. (Songhealer)
Vine Grasp – Earth magic attack with bleed against a single target based on the Songhealer's own regeneration. (Songhealer)
Water Lily Bloom – Bloom. Grants an ally regeneration. When regeneration restores the ally to full health, causes water damage to all enemies based on health regenerated. (Songhealer)
Affliction Anchor – Channeled ability that prevents afflictions from being purged during its duration. (Spellweaver)
Bewitching Pause – Stuns and applies malediction to a single enemy. (Spellweaver)
Cloud Mind – All enemies with illusory damage are flanked. (Spellweaver)
Duration Preparation – The next affliction used by the Spellweaver has increased duration. (Spellweaver)
Influential Pause – Stuns and generates influence on a target enemy. (Spellweaver)
Separation from Faith – Prevents a single target from using healing abilities. (Spellweaver)
Strengthen Curse – Raises the potency of all afflictions on the target. (Spellweaver)
Converged Stun – Stuns the target. If focus is expended, stuns all enemies. (Spellweaver)
Investment of Influence – Gains focus and mana based on total influence. (Spellweaver)
Open to Terror – Causes the target to take extra damage from illusory effects. (Spellweaver)
Return to Sleep – Incapacitates a target enemy that lost incapacitate since the Spellweaver's last turn. (Spellweaver)
Steal Composure – Confuses an influenced target and gains mana. (Spellweaver)
Web of Life – Shares heals with all allies. (Spellweaver)
Bewildering Bolt – Arcane magic attack that deals increased damage versus stunned. Stuns or extends stun if focus is expended. (Spellweaver)
Charmed Possession – Possesses all charmed enemies. These enemies deal increased damage based on influence. (Spellweaver)
Converged Arcana – Arcane magic attack. Deals increased damage if focus is expended. (Spellweaver)
Converged Channel – Channeled arcane magic attack that deals extra damage and cannot be disrupted if focus is consumed on cast. (Spellweaver)
Converged Inferno – Fire magic attack versus all enemies. Wounds enemies if focus is expended. (Spellweaver)
Converged Possession – Possesses an influenced target to attack a random enemy. If focus is expended, this attack is a guaranteed critical. (Spellweaver)
Hideous Charm – Charms all maledicted enemies. (Spellweaver)
Hypochondria – The target enemy takes additional illusory damage whenever it is damaged. (Spellweaver)
Mana Sink – Damages all enemies. Gains mana based on total damage dealt. (Spellweaver)
Ribbons of Slumber – Incapacitates three random enemies. (Spellweaver)
Spider's Sleep – Incapacitates the target. Causes illusory damage if focus is expended. (Spellweaver)
Web of Malediction – Slows and stuns all maledicted enemies. (Spellweaver)
Block the Hammer – Enhances block based on the clobber value of the attack used this turn. (Weapon Master)
Counter Guard – Grants the Weapon Master a chance to counter when the guarded ally is attacked. (Weapon Master)
Dodge the Blade – Enhances dodge based on the penetrate value of the attack used this turn. (Weapon Master)
Shuffle Provocation – Provokes all enemies and enhances dodge until the Weapon Master's next turn. Delays the Weapon Master. (Weapon Master)
Specialized Strategy – Enhances the values of shattering, clobbering, and penetrate on the next attack. (Weapon Master)
Versatility Stance – Gains expertise when using penetrate, clobber, or shatter. Increases the values of these modifiers. (Weapon Master)
Weather the Axe – Enhances defense based on the shatter value of the attack used this turn. (Weapon Master)
Armed Provocation – Provokes the target enemy and enhances parry chance until that enemy attacks. (Weapon Master)
Compelling Rebuke – Melee attack against an enemy that attacked the Weapon Master since her last turn. Compels the target. If the target is already compelled, deals extra damage. (Weapon Master)
Counter Prevention – The guarded ally cannot be countered until the Weapon Master's next turn. (Weapon Master)
Defensive Knowledge – Prevents a target ally from being affected by enemy clobber, penetrate, and shatter until the Weapon Master's next turn. (Weapon Master)
Expert Parries – Enhances the parry chance of the target, increased by expertise. (Weapon Master)
Specialized Arms – Gains bleed on the next attack based on penetrate, disrupt based on shatter, and stun based on clobber. (Weapon Master)
Dense and Sharp – Melee attack with low critical chance that shatters and penetrates. (Weapon Master)
Expert Interception – Takes damage for the next attack against a target ally and intercedes. Requires expertise. (Weapon Master)
Faith Ender – Prepared melee attack with shatter that disenchants the target. Stays prepared on disenchant. (Weapon Master)

Flexible Blows – Melee attack with amplification that costs mana. Cycles between clobber, penetrate, and shatter with each use. Amplification increases with consecutive uses and resets if not used for a turn. (Weapon Master)
Heavy and Dense – Inaccurate melee attack with clobber and shatter. (Weapon Master)
Knight Queller – Prepared melee attack with penetrate that prevents active defenses until the Weapon Master's next turn. Stays prepared if the enemy uses an active defense against it. (Weapon Master)
Mage Basher – Prepared melee attack with clobber that disrupts the target. Stays prepared if it successfully disrupts. (Weapon Master)
Panoply Onslaught – Prepared. Three melee attacks against a single target, one with clobber, one with penetrate, and one with shatter. (Weapon Master)
Panoply Storm – Three melee attacks with distance against a single target, one with shattering, one with clobbering, and one with penetrate. (Weapon Master)
Sharp and Heavy – Slow melee attack with clobber and penetrate. (Weapon Master)
Teamwork Threshold – Melee attack requiring threshold that also possesses the guarded ally to attack. (Weapon Master)
Weapon Partnership – Prepared melee attack that grants the guarded ally a free attack, sharing penetrate, shatter, and clobbering values. (Weapon Master)
Cat Flank – Flanks and delays the target. Requires Leopard or Tiger form. Lowers form to Snake. (Wildcat)
Catscratch Fighting – Enhances counter chance and dodge while the Wildcat remains in Leopard or Tiger form. (Wildcat)
Endeavor for Revenge – Enhances the counter chance of the Wildcat and weakens speed. (Wildcat)
Focused Advantage – Gains advantage if focused. (Wildcat)
Leopard Hide – Gains hidden if in Leopard form. (Wildcat)
Vicious Counter – Gains enhanced counter damage until the Wildcat's next turn. (Wildcat)
Attack Unaware – Prepared ability that causes the Wildcat to flank and attack on dodge. (Wildcat)
Catscratch Counter – Prepared reaction to the next attack with bleed and wound. (Wildcat)
Catscratch Fever – Applies a wounding poison to attacks. (Wildcat)
Dirty Trick – Causes a random effect on the target: prone, disarm, blind, or flanked. (Wildcat)
Nine Lives – The Wildcat gains lucky dodge. (Wildcat)
Ready to Pounce – Quickens on counter attacks until the Wildcat's next turn. (Wildcat)
Venomous Dodge – Prepared reaction on dodge that attacks the enemy with poisonous. (Wildcat)
Advantageous Trip – Melee attack versus a flanked enemy with a chance for prone. If the enemy is made prone, generates advantage. (Wildcat)
Bobcat Rend – Dual-wield melee attack that causes extra damage on the target's turn if both attacks hit. (Wildcat)
Careful Scratch – Melee attack with a high chance to conserve poison. Requires Leopard form. (Wildcat)
Dodge Flurry – Makes a melee attack for each attack dodged since the Wildcat's last turn. (Wildcat)
Flanking Claws – Two melee attacks that quicken on hit against a flanked enemy. Consumes advantage. (Wildcat)

Leopard Combo – Dual-wield melee attack requiring Leopard form. Poisonous. Enhances dodge based on open chakras. Raises form toward Crane on the next dodge, lowers form toward Snake on the next hit. (Wildcat)
Maximum Rend – Dual-wield melee attack that deals maximum damage if both attacks hit. (Wildcat)
Pouncing Dodge – Prepared reaction on dodge that attacks the enemy with a chance to knock prone. (Wildcat)
Powerful Pounce – Melee attack which can knock the target prone, performed after dodging a ranged attack. (Wildcat)
Raking Claws – Melee attack that causes untyped bleed after a dodge. (Wildcat)
Sudden Pounce – Dual attack with sudden. Delays the Wildcat afterward. (Wildcat)
Unfair Advantage – Melee attack versus a blind enemy. Generates advantage. (Wildcat)
Arsenal Expertise – Spends expertise to increase the companion's next damage. (Arsenalist)
Companion Aversion – The companion's next attack averts the target. (Arsenalist)
Companion Stance – Enhances the companion and generates expertise whenever the companion acts. (Arsenalist)
Protect Device – Enhances the defense and disruption resistance of the companion. (Arsenalist)
Protect the Armaments – Heals the companion and provokes the enemy. Requires the companion to have been attacked. (Arsenalist)
Targeting Beacon – Affliction placed on the target consuming ammo that causes the companion to attack them on detonation. (Arsenalist)
Companion Interception – The unit takes the next damage that would be dealt to the companion. (Arsenalist)

Defense Arsenal – Arsenal ability. If an Arsenal companion is present, commands it to grant all allies a damage shield and defense enhancement. If no Arsenal is present, summons a less powerful companion that naturally uses defensive abilities. (Arsenalist)
Dynamic Forcefield – Grants a damage shield with increased effect based on the number of enemies present. (Arsenalist)
Expert Companion – Consumes expertise to grant the companion a damage buff. (Arsenalist)
Fortify Device – Grants fortification to the companion. (Arsenalist)
Provocation Beacon – Provokes the target to attack the Arsenalist on each of her turns. Duration is determined by ammo consumed. (Arsenalist)

Speed Arsenal – Arsenal ability. If an Arsenal companion is present, commands it to quicken all allies. If no Arsenal is present, summons a less powerful companion that naturally quickens single targets. (Arsenalist)
Armament Opening – Melee attack that procs a companion attack. (Arsenalist)
Armament Traps – Trap that damages any enemy attacking the Arsenalist's companion. (Arsenalist)
Blade Detonation – Afflicts the target with a trap that deals damage based on the user's melee damage on detonation. (Arsenalist)

Fire Arsenal – Arsenal ability. If an Arsenal companion is present, commands it to use a powerful area fire attack. If no Arsenal is present, summons a companion that naturally uses less powerful area fire attacks. (Arsenalist)
Fire Rocket – Ranged slow fire attack that is prepared and enhanced by expertise. (Arsenalist)
Flame Thrower – Ranged channeled fire attack versus a target column. Channel duration is determined by remaining ammo. (Arsenalist)

Frost Arsenal – Arsenal ability. If an Arsenal companion is present, commands it to use an area water attack with slow. If no Arsenal is present, summons a companion that naturally uses less powerful delaying water attacks. (Arsenalist)
Heavy Fire – Ranged attack versus all enemies with delay. Consumes all ammo. (Arsenalist)

Iron Spike Arsenal – Arsenal ability. If an Arsenal companion is present, commands it to use an area penetrating attack with untyped bleed. If no Arsenal is present, summons a companion that naturally uses less powerful physical attacks and grants the Arsenalist untyped retaliation. (Arsenalist)
Tectonic Explosion – Earth countdown against a single target that delays all enemies on trigger. (Arsenalist)

Teknos Arsenal – Arsenal ability. If an Arsenal companion is present, commands it to use an attack based on current ammo. If no Arsenal is present, summons a companion that naturally consumes ammo to make related attacks. If no ammo is loaded, this summon does nothing on its turn. (Arsenalist)

Thunder Arsenal – Arsenal ability. If an Arsenal companion is present, commands it to use an area air attack with a secondary air countdown. If no Arsenal is present, summons a companion that naturally uses less powerful air countdown attacks. (Arsenalist)
Abandoned Malediction – Disenchants a maledicted target of any enhancements. (Blasphemer)
Blasphemous Power – Disenchants self of all enchantments and gains mana and magic power for each enchantment lost. Then becomes forsaken. (Blasphemer)
Blasphemous Purge – Purges self. Requires the Blasphemer to be unenchanted. (Blasphemer)
Fallow Flesh – Disenchants regeneration from all units in battle. (Blasphemer)
Song of Susceptibility – Dischord that causes affliction resistance weakness. (Blasphemer)
Blasphemous Words – Whenever an enemy uses a heal or enchant before the Blasphemer's next turn, it takes damage. (Blasphemer)
Dark Healing – Heals the target based on afflictions on it. (Blasphemer)
Extension Refrain – Extends the duration of all afflictions on the enemy audience. (Blasphemer)
False Positive, Ally – The next enchant used by an enemy also targets this ally. (Blasphemer)
Godless Healing – Heal that can only be used if both the Blasphemer and the target are unenchanted. (Blasphemer)
Life Siphon – Afflicts the target enemy with heal siphon. (Blasphemer)
Separate from the Source – Mana damage and lowers magic power versus the target. Requires preparation. (Blasphemer)
Separation from Grace – Affliction against all maledicted enemies that lowers healing power, healing received, and causes mana loss. (Blasphemer)
Blasphemous Hex – Disenchants the target and afflicts it with water hex. (Blasphemer)
Complete Blasphemy – Magic attack versus all enemies. Disenchants all of the Blasphemer's own enchantments and causes forsaken on him. Deals more damage for each enchantment lost. (Blasphemer)
Crisis of Faith – Disenchants the enemy and afflicts it with untyped hex. (Blasphemer)
Cruel Turn of Fate – Magic attack that deals increased damage for each enchantment on the target, then disenchants them. (Blasphemer)
Disenchanting Malefaction – Magic attack that causes malediction and disenchants the target. (Blasphemer)
Forsaken Frost – Water magic attack and forsaken. (Blasphemer)
Forsaken Hex – Water magic hex. Requires the Blasphemer to be unenchanted. (Blasphemer)
Forsaken Note – Affliction that adds the target to the audience and causes forsaken. (Blasphemer)
Forsaken Shot – Dark ranged attack. Requires the Blasphemer to be unenchanted. (Blasphemer)
Invert Healing – The next heal used by an enemy deals damage instead. (Blasphemer)
Vampiric Blasphemy – The Blasphemer loses a random enchantment and drains life from the target. (Blasphemer)
Wounding Note – Affliction that adds the target to the audience, causes wound, and refreshes afflictions on the target. Costs mana scaled to the number of afflictions refreshed. (Blasphemer)
Follow to Dreamland – Spots an incapacitated enemy to gain intangible. (Dreamstalker)
Influence Dream – Gains high influence on an incapacitated target. (Dreamstalker)
Nightmare Critical – The next attack versus an incapacitated target is a guaranteed critical. (Dreamstalker)
Siphon Dream – Spots an incapacitated enemy to gain spirit power based on the frightened value. (Dreamstalker)
Sleep of the Dead – The target cannot be woken by the next damage. (Dreamstalker)
Slumber Mist – Spirit aura that grants a chance to incapacitate all enemies at the end of their turns. Drains spirit power constantly. Requires Spirit Fugue. (Dreamstalker)
Cloak of Dreams – Enemies that attack the unit have a chance to become incapacitated. (Dreamstalker)
Deepen Sleep – Increases the potency and duration of incapacitated on the target. (Dreamstalker)
Dominate Dream – Possesses an incapacitated enemy. (Dreamstalker)
Infiltrate Dream – Drains mana from an incapacitated target. (Dreamstalker)
Sleep Beckoning – Causes incapacitate on a single target, enhanced by influence. (Dreamstalker)
Slumber Dust – Spirit affliction that incapacitates a single target. Hard to remove but drains spirit power while active. (Dreamstalker)
Arcane Nightmare – Arcane magic damage versus an incapacitated enemy. (Dreamstalker)
Dream Army – Possesses all incapacitated enemies. (Dreamstalker)
Dream Eater – Magic attack against an incapacitated enemy that drains life and mana. (Dreamstalker)
Dream Haunt – Arcane magic attack that afflicts the target with untyped hex. Costs spirit power. (Dreamstalker)
Dream Hunter – The Dreamstalker becomes incapacitated and intangible. Hexes all enemies while incapacitated. (Dreamstalker)
Dream Storm – Afflicts random enemies with illusory damage and incapacitate based on the number of Spirit Orbs. (Dreamstalker)
Dream Strike – Ranged attack against an incapacitated enemy that is a guaranteed critical, but deals all damage as illusory. (Dreamstalker)
Influential Illusions – Deals illusory arcane damage to all targets based on influence on them. (Dreamstalker)
Magic Vampirism – Ranged attack that causes mana loss and generates spirit power based on mana lost. (Dreamstalker)
Nightmare Abduction – Insidious, culling ranged attack against an incapacitated target. (Dreamstalker)
Nightmare Pulse – Magic attack that deals insidious damage to all incapacitated enemies. (Dreamstalker)
Psychic Shot – Ranged attack with damage enhanced by influence. (Dreamstalker)
Recurring Nightmares – Afflicts an incapacitated target with illusory hex. (Dreamstalker)
Purging Trap – Creates a trap on the field that purges the next ally to act. (Gothi)
Runic Purge – Purges an affliction from a target ally based on the affliction rune. (Gothi)
Shielding Purge – Purges elemental afflictions from a target ally based on their elemental shielding. (Gothi)

Symbol Domain – Domain. Increases the chance for procs to activate. Requires minimum divinity to activate and drains divinity each turn. Generates divinity whenever a trap triggers. Lasts as long as divinity remains above the minimum threshold. (Gothi)
Temporary Water Shielding – Grants a target ally water shielding until the Gothi's next turn. (Gothi)
Curative Shackle Rune – Enchant rune. Heals the Gothi whenever the unit attacks. (Gothi)
Devastating Brand – The next attack against the target after this activates deals additional damage. (Gothi)
Divine Exposure – Consumes one divinity to afflict the target with water exposure. (Gothi)
Divine Extension – Consumes all divinity to extend the duration and increase the power of all enchantments on allies based on divinity. (Gothi)
Healing Trap – Creates a trap on the field that heals all allies the next time an enemy makes an attack. (Gothi)
Mending Trap – Creates a trap on an ally that heals them the next time an enemy acts. (Gothi)
Rime Trap – The next enemy to act is slowed after its turn. (Gothi)
Rune of Healing – Enhance rune. Increases healing power and healing received for the next several times the unit is healed or uses healing. (Gothi)
Seaweed Rune – Defense rune. Enemies that attack the target take water damage. (Gothi)
Dead Fish Rune – Element rune. Magic water damage and tired against a single target. (Gothi)
Divine Brand – Afflicts the target with a light damage hex that lowers light resistance on activation. Duration and power are based on divinity. (Gothi)
Divinity Trap – Creates a light damage trap that targets all enemies. Damage and number of uses are based on divinity. (Gothi)
Flame Brand – Afflicts the target with a fire damage hex that damages all enemies when it activates. (Gothi)
Frost Brand – Afflicts the target with a water damage hex that has a chance to incapacitate the target when it activates. (Gothi)
Frostflood Trap – Creates a field-based trap that activates when enemies deal a threshold amount of damage, causing all enemies to take water damage and slowing them. (Gothi)
Holy Trap – Creates a field-based trap that damages the next enemy to attack with light damage and light hex. (Gothi)
Lightning Brand – Afflicts the target with an air damage hex that also makes two random air attacks when it activates. (Gothi)
Mass Water Shielding – Grants water shielding to all allies. (Gothi)
Rune of Restoration – Enchant rune. Causes the target to heal at the beginning of its next several turns. (Gothi)
Runic Brand – Afflicts the target with an elemental hex of the element matching the Gothi's current elemental rune. (Gothi)
Arcing Boomerang – Ranged attack that repeats after a set number of ticks. (Hurler)
Arcing Throw – Ranged attack that gains bonuses from melee-specific passives such as melee accuracy and melee damage enhancements. (Hurler)
Bouncing Boulder Throw – Ranged earth attack that deals ranged earth damage to two random enemies. (Hurler)
Clobber Goliath – Ranged attack that deals clobbering based on the enemy's maximum health. (Hurler)
Clobbering Bounce – Ranged attack with clobbering. If it hits, attacks a random enemy with clobber. (Hurler)
Decimation Aim – Ranged attack with decimation that consumes aim. (Hurler)
Decimation Cleave – Ranged attack that consumes anguish and attacks the target and one adjacent enemy with decimation. (Hurler)
Decimation Ricochet – Ranged attack with decimation that also strikes a second random target with decimation. (Hurler)
Equalizing Throw – Ranged attack with justice that deals extra damage based on the target's health above the Hurler's health. (Hurler)
Fell Giant – Ranged attack that delays the target and causes prone on critical. Damages other enemies based on the target's maximum health, with increased damage if the target becomes prone. (Hurler)
Goliath Stunner – Ranged attack that stuns the enemy on hit based on the enemy's maximum health. If it misses, damages all other enemies instead. (Hurler)
Heavy Boomerang – Ranged attack against a row that delays. (Hurler)
Hurl Bolas – Slows the target. Causes prone on critical. (Hurler)
Giant Growth – Increases the Hurler's maximum health based on the target's maximum health. (Hurler)
Irritated Defense – Follows a glancing hit. Enhances defense and quickens the Hurler. (Hurler)
Irritated Follow Up – Melee attack following glancing damage. Higher damage. Consumes anguish. (Hurler)
Irritated Rage – Follows glancing damage. Enhances damage and generates anguish. (Hurler)
Unbreakable Screen – Prevents glancing damage until the Hurler's next turn and generates aim. Must be used as the last action of the turn. (Hurler)
Wide Throw – Delays all enemies and taunts. (Hurler)
Catch the Return – Quickens self after missing with a ranged attack. (Hurler)
Delay Goliath – Delays an enemy based on the target's maximum health. (Hurler)
Healthy Rage – Gains anguish. Requires being at full health. (Hurler)
Large Target – Taunts enemies. Requires full health. (Hurler)
Stun Echo – Stuns each target that was damaged during the Hurler's turn. (Hurler)
Stunning Windup – Gains stunning with the next attack based on momentum. (Hurler)
Blastback Slash – Melee attack with decimate that delays the enemy based on the decimate value. (Kensai)
Fatal Strike – Melee attack that wounds the target until the end of its next turn. (Kensai)
Fell by Fortune – Melee attack against the challenge with blessed accuracy and damage. (Kensai)
Fluctuating Offense – Melee attack with reduced accuracy that grants lucky dodge on miss. (Kensai)
Focused Blade Blast – Melee attack versus all enemies that consumes focus. (Kensai)
Guiding Strike – Melee attack that enhances all allies' accuracy based on the initial accuracy bonus. (Kensai)

Iaijutsu Challenge – Initial Effect: high damage melee attack, can only be used as the first action. Basic Effect: quickens and compels the Kensai to attack the challenge. Challenge Effect: high damage melee attack that sheathes the weapon afterward. (Kensai)
Iaijutsu Decimation – Melee attack requiring initial turn. Decimates the enemy and delays based on the decimation value. (Kensai)
Iaijutsu Slash – High damage melee attack with sudden. Requires initial turn. Prevents counters from the Kensai and grants initial bonuses until her next turn. Sheathes weapon after use. (Kensai)
Iaijutsu Wave – Melee attack against all enemies. Requires being the initial attack. (Kensai)
Kensai's Stroke – Prepared melee attack with blessed accuracy and damage. (Kensai)
Sheathing Attack – Powerful melee attack that sheathes the weapon after it completes. Omega. (Kensai)

Challenge Revenge – Counters the challenge if it attacks before the Kensai's next turn. This counter is an exception to the sheathed restriction and can trigger even while the weapon is sheathed. (Kensai)
Deadly Iaijutsu – Enhances critical chance and accuracy. Requires initial turn. (Kensai)
Decimation Imbuement – Grants the target a decimate proc. (Kensai)
Iaijutsu Focus – Grants the Kensai focus and enhances damage. Requires initial turn. (Kensai)
Iaijutsu Fortune – Grants the Kensai lucky and quickens. Requires initial turn. (Kensai)
Iaijutsu Guard – Enhances parry and counter chance until the Kensai's next turn. Requires initial turn. (Kensai)
Springing Leopard – The next counter has sudden. Counter damage is enhanced by the period this ability has been prepared. (Kensai)
Dodging Provocation – Enhances dodge and provokes the target. Requires Crane form. (Kensai)
Fortunate Challenge – Toggled. Gains lucky accuracy and damage against the challenge, and unlucky accuracy and damage against all other enemies. Delays the Kensai on use. (Kensai)
Fortunate Loneliness – Gains lucky accuracy. Requires being alone. (Kensai)
Reclaim Dodge – Gains the initial dodge bonuses until the Kensai's next turn. (Kensai)
Sheathe Weapon – Prevents counters until the Kensai's next turn and treats the next turn as the initial turn. Quickens by initiative. Omega. (Kensai)
Sudden Preparation – The next melee attack this turn cannot be countered. (Kensai)
Distressed Rush – Melee attack with damage and quicken enhanced by distress. (Liberator)
Distressed Strike – Melee attack with damage enhanced by distress. (Liberator)
Double Strike Threshold – Two melee attacks. Requires dual wield and threshold. (Liberator)
Endangered Justice – Ranged attack requiring endangered. Quickens self and all endangered allies based on justice. (Liberator)
Hidden Intervention – Prepared reaction to an enemy attacking the guarded ally. Requires hidden. The attack is redirected to the Liberator, who responds with a high damage melee attack. (Liberator)
Hidden Justice – Ranged attack requiring hidden that afflicts the target with bleed based on justice. (Liberator)
Justice Rush – Melee attack with justice that also quickens allies based on justice. (Liberator)
Liberating Shot – Prepared ranged attack that triggers when the Liberator is stunned or incapacitated. Purges the respective condition. (Liberator)
Pincer Partnership – Prepared. Melee attack against a flanked enemy with an attack from the guarded ally. (Liberator)
Shackle Breaker – Purges movement afflictions from all allies, then makes a melee attack with a bonus for each affliction purged. (Liberator)
Speed Advantage Strike – Melee attack that quickens all allies based on advantage. Consumes one advantage. (Liberator)
Speed of Justice – Melee attack with justice that grants the guarded ally haste based on justice. (Liberator)
Vengeful Guarding – Melee attack with high critical chance and damage. Follows the guarded ally being attacked. (Liberator)
Act on Impulse – All compelled allies immediately attack. (Liberator)
Freedom of Movement – The Liberator is immune to movement afflictions until his next turn and quickens. (Liberator)
Freewill Backlash – Purges the compelled status from the Liberator and damages the enemy that compelled him. (Liberator)
Liberation Front – Purges movement effects from all allies and quickens each ally purged. (Liberator)
Seize the Advantage – Gains advantage each time an ally criticals before the Liberator's next turn. Enhances critical chance and delays the Liberator. (Liberator)
Advantage from the Ground – Spots a prone ally to gain advantage. (Liberator)
Back to Back – Removes flanked from an ally and enhances the dodge of self and that ally. (Liberator)
Flee into Darkness – Threshold ability. Grants haste and hidden. (Liberator)
Guardian's Advantage – Compels an enemy and gains advantage if the enemy misses. (Liberator)
Quick Clarity – Purges stunned from all allies. (Liberator)
Shield Dodge – Enhances the unit's dodge based on shield. (Liberator)
Switch Shackles – Steals haste from the target and transfers slow to the target. (Liberator)
Conflux Elemental – Summons a conflux elemental companion. Requires all 6 elements charged. (Sha'ir)
Corrupt Wish – Corrupt magic attack against a single enemy dealing damage of the companion's element. Delays the companion. (Sha'ir)
Desert Wind – Air magic attack that causes blind. (Sha'ir)
Desiccation – Corrupt air magic attack that causes tired. (Sha'ir)
Haboob – Air magic attack versus all enemies that lowers accuracy. Has amplification. (Sha'ir)
Hands of Wind – Consumes air attunement to deal air damage to a single target and gain enhanced cast speed for a period. (Sha'ir)
Sand Cantrip – Sudden, untyped magic attack with piercing. Requires air and earth attunements. (Sha'ir)
Sand Slash – Piercing air magic attack versus a column. Causes slow on critical. (Sha'ir)
Sandstorm – Air magic attack versus all enemies that causes blind. (Sha'ir)
Storm Djinni – Summons a storm djinni companion. (Sha'ir)
Tornado Wish – Magic attack against all enemies dealing damage of the companion's element. Delays the companion. (Sha'ir)
Wind or Rock – If Eros aligned, deals piercing damage to a single target. If Thanatos aligned, deals earth damage with delay to a single target. (Sha'ir)
Allied Mirage – Prepared. The next attack versus the target is a guaranteed miss. (Sha'ir)
Companion Sandstrike – The companion gains intangible until its next turn. When it attacks, it deals additional air damage. (Sha'ir)
Conjure Dust Devil – Summons a dust devil companion with air and earth elements that lasts until the beginning of the Sha'ir's next turn. Attacks when summoned and before it disappears. (Sha'ir)
Elemental Alignment – Grants the companion retaliation if Eros aligned or a damage add if Thanatos aligned, based on the companion's element. Quickens the companion. (Sha'ir)
Forge Wish – Grants a damage add to all allies based on the companion's element. Delays the companion. (Sha'ir)
Reflection Wish – Prepared. Reflects elemental attacks of the companion's element until the Sha'ir's next turn. Delays the companion. (Sha'ir)
Retaliation Wish – The team gains elemental retaliation of the companion's element until the Sha'ir's next turn. Delays the companion. (Sha'ir)
Sand Shroud – The Sha'ir gains enhanced dodge and earth retaliation. (Sha'ir)
Attunement Wish – The Sha'ir gains mana and elemental attunement based on the companion. Delays the companion. (Sha'ir)
Destruction of Ephemera – Lowers the elemental resistance of a target enemy based on the companion's element. Requires Thanatos. (Sha'ir)
Energy Retort – Uses the attuned element to deal magic damage to the next enemy who attacks the Sha'ir. (Sha'ir)
Protection of Eternal – Raises the elemental resistance of a target ally based on the companion's element. Requires Eros. (Sha'ir)
Wind Provocation – The companion provokes a target enemy and gains air retaliation against the next attack. (Sha'ir)
Blind Arrow Countdown – Chance to afflict each enemy with blind and an untyped countdown. (Blind Archer)
Blind Arrow Illusion – Three random ranged attacks that deal illusory damage on miss. Requires the Blind Archer to be blind. (Blind Archer)
Blind Arrow Killer – Four ranged attacks against a single enemy. Requires the Blind Archer to be blind. Each hit increases the damage of the following attacks. (Blind Archer)
Blind Arrow Squall – Four random ranged attacks. Requires the Blind Archer to be blind. Hits delay and disrupt targets. (Blind Archer)
Blind Arrow Storm – Random targeting ranged storm attack that applies blind to each target hit. (Blind Archer)
Blind Arrow Surge – Attacks all blinded enemies. Possesses on critical. (Blind Archer)
Blind Vow – Prepared ranged attack that selects its target on preparation. If it misses, hits a different random enemy instead. (Blind Archer)
Close Shave – Ranged attack with lower accuracy and reaping. Quickens the Blind Archer. (Blind Archer)
Fortune's Arrow – Ranged attack that generates aim on miss. If the Blind Archer is blind, generates double aim on miss. (Blind Archer)
Influence Shot – Ranged attack with penetration based on influence on the target. (Blind Archer)
Mistake Response – Prepared ranged attack versus all enemies that triggers on miss. (Blind Archer)
Reaping Blast – Ranged attack that deals reaping damage versus all enemies. (Blind Archer)
Taste Madness – Ranged attack with pinpoint and increased accuracy based on the target's illusory damage. (Blind Archer)
Feel the Ethers – Increased chance to dodge spells until the Blind Archer's next turn. Gains mana on spell dodge. (Blind Archer)
One Perfect Shot – The next attack is a guaranteed critical, but the Blind Archer cannot make a critical attack for a period after. (Blind Archer)
Psychic Awareness – Lowers the dodge of all enemies based on their influence. (Blind Archer)
Read the Winds – Enhances dodge following a miss. (Blind Archer)
Rely on Hearing – Enhances dodge while blind. (Blind Archer)
Sightless Screen – Prevents the aimed target from becoming hidden until the Blind Archer's next turn and generates aim. Must be used as the last action of the turn. (Blind Archer)
Blind Aim – Generates aim if blind. (Blind Archer)
Blind Consideration – Gains influence on any enemy missed this turn. (Blind Archer)
Hidden Sight – Can target hidden enemies this turn without penalty and with increased accuracy. (Blind Archer)
Strange Sight – Lowers accuracy to increase critical chance. (Blind Archer)
Surprise Blindness – Blinds an enemy in reaction to it missing with an attack. (Blind Archer)
Trust in Blindness – Blinds self to gain lucky accuracy and damage. Can be used if already blind. (Blind Archer)
Blessed Strike – Light melee attack with blessed damage. Causes light hex on critical. (Chaplain)
Divine Soldier – Compels all enemies to attack the Chaplain, granting self a damage shield and retaliation. Consumes all divinity. Durations and conditions enhanced by divinity. (Chaplain)
Group Heal, Major – Prepared. Heals the entire team for a high amount. (Chaplain)
Holy Justice Sigil – Sigil. Grants the target a light damage aura in inverse relation to their health. Ongoing, reserves mana, transferable. (Chaplain)
Holy Slash – Light damage melee attack. Requires expertise. (Chaplain)
Prudence Slash – Melee attack boosted by wisdom. (Chaplain)
Regenerative Blow – Melee attack that grants the Chaplain regeneration based on damage dealt until her next turn. (Chaplain)
Restoration Attack – Melee attack that enhances healing power and gains mana. Requires expertise. (Chaplain)
Resurrection Sigil – Sigil. Resurrects the target ally the next time they fall in battle. Ongoing, reserves mana, transferable. (Chaplain)
Stunning Clash – Prepared reaction. Stuns all enemies and deals melee damage on block. (Chaplain)
Wall Blow – Melee attack that grants the Chaplain a damage shield. (Chaplain)
Divine Sigil – Sigil. Enchants an ally with a light damage add based on divinity. Ongoing, reserves mana, transferable. (Chaplain)
Expert Healing – Enhances the healing power of the target, increased by expertise. (Chaplain)
Fortifying Sigil – Sigil. Enchants an ally with fortification. Ongoing, reserves mana, transferable. (Chaplain)
Fortune Sigil – Sigil. Enchants an ally with lucky damage. Ongoing, reserves mana, transferable. (Chaplain)
Healing Block – Prepared ability that heals all allies on the next block. (Chaplain)
Radiant Sigil – Sigil. Enchants an ally with illuminate on their attacks. Ongoing, reserves mana, transferable. (Chaplain)
Shielding Symbol – Prevents the damage of the next attack against the target based on current divinity. Consumes divinity. (Chaplain)

Lightning Domain – Domain. Grants all allies air retaliation. Requires minimum divinity to activate and drains divinity each turn. Generates divinity whenever any hero blocks an attack. Lasts as long as divinity remains above the minimum threshold. (Chaplain)
Might Sigil – Sigil. Enhances an ally with increased damage. Ongoing, reserves mana, transferable. (Chaplain)
Rampart Heal – Heal used following a block. (Chaplain)
Rampart Purge – Purge used following a block. (Chaplain)
Recovery Stance – Gains expertise whenever the Fighter heals an ally. Increases the effect of heals the Fighter uses. (Chaplain)
Sigil Spread – Disenchants the target of a sigil and grants all units the benefit of that sigil until the end of their next turn. (Chaplain)
Thorns Sigil – Sigil. Enchants an ally with untyped retaliation. Ongoing, reserves mana, transferable. (Chaplain)
Death Charge – Mounted melee attack with ruthless damage enhanced by the mount's timer. (Ghostrider)
Finishing Charge – Melee attack against the column containing the enemy with the lowest health. (Ghostrider)
Ghost Onslaught – Melee attack requiring mounted that damages all intangible enemies. (Ghostrider)
Ghost Slayer – Melee attack that targets an intangible enemy. (Ghostrider)
Ghost Steed – Summons a ghost steed companion. (Ghostrider)
Ghost Wind – Air damage versus all enemies with momentum. Requires mounted. (Ghostrider)
Ghostly Charge – Melee attack with phasing and ghost touch against a column. Requires threshold. (Ghostrider)
Ghostly Partnership – Prepared melee attack with an ally that deals heartstrike damage. (Ghostrider)
Heartstrike Momentum – Melee attack that deals heartstrike damage. Requires momentum. (Ghostrider)
Illusion Momentum – Melee attack that deals illusory damage to all enemies based on momentum. (Ghostrider)
Overwhelming Charge – Melee attack dealing extra damage based on the mount's timer. (Ghostrider)
Spectral Cavalry – Mounted melee attack that also damages all enemies based on the mount's timer. (Ghostrider)
Spirit Momentum – Phasing melee attack with momentum. Requires intangible. (Ghostrider)
Ghostride – Grants intangible to the Ghost Rider and his mount. Requires mounted. (Ghostrider)
Ghostly Follow-up – Phasing melee attack versus the last target attacked by the mount. (Ghostrider)
Glance Guard – Reduces glancing damage to a target ally to 0 until the Ghost Rider's next turn. (Ghostrider)
Spirit of Defense – Spirit Buff. Grants the Ghost Rider enhanced defense while consuming spirit power. This enhancement is improved while the Ghost Rider is in Spirit Fugue. (Ghostrider)
Spirit Threshold – Threshold ability that grants the Ghost Rider a Spirit Orb. (Ghostrider)

Fizzle Device – Consumes ammo to lower the resistance and power of an element based on ammo type. Air: lowers air resistance and air power. Earth: lowers earth resistance and earth power. Fire: lowers fire resistance and fire power. Water: lowers water resistance and water power. Light: lowers light resistance and light power. Dark: lowers dark resistance and dark power. Mana: reduces mana generation. Delay: lowers speed. Penetration: lowers defense. Flechette: lowers resistance based on a random element. Illusory: lowers illusory resistance and increases illusory damage taken. Corruption: lowers corruption resistance and increases corruption damage taken. (Heretic)

Stellar Shot – Prepared ranged attack with damage enhanced whenever a countdown triggers. (Stargazer)
Companion Aim – Enhances the accuracy of the companion and quickens it based on current aim. (Stargazer)
Critical Alignment – Enhances critical damage if Thanatos aligned or critical chance if Eros aligned. (Stargazer)
Lightshow Production – Grants the Stargazer light damage adds and lucky accuracy. (Stargazer)
Lucky Tendency – Guarantees the next critical hit if Thanatos aligned. Guarantees the next dodge if Eros aligned. (Stargazer)
Star Screen – Enhances the elemental resistance of the Stargazer until her next turn and generates aim. Must be used as the last action of the turn. (Stargazer)
Stellar Mana – Gains mana based on the total number of active countdowns. (Stargazer)
Brighter Star – Increases the duration of a countdown and increases its value. (Stargazer)
Ephemeral Star – Purges countdowns from allies. Requires Eros. (Stargazer)
Stellar Aim – Afflicts the target with a countdown. When it expires, it transfers to a random enemy and generates aim for the Stargazer. (Stargazer)
Restored Luck – Purges unlucky from the target. (Stargazer)
Starstruck – The next enemy damaged by a countdown is stunned. (Stargazer)
Aggressive Fire Bolt – Prepared fire magic attack versus a single target. While prepared, enhances the Tactician's damage. (Tactician)
Arcane Threshold – Arcane magic attack versus all enemies. Requires threshold. (Tactician)
Buttressing Blow – Melee attack that enhances the defense of the team. (Tactician)
Defended Light Blast – Prepared light magic attack versus all enemies. While prepared, enhances the unit's defense. (Tactician)
Final Enhancement Slash – Melee attack that deals bonus damage for each ability currently prepared by the Tactician. (Tactician)
Genius Slash – Melee attack boosted by intelligence. (Tactician)
Incapacitation Tactic – The Tactician attacks and the guarded ally provokes. When the guarded ally is attacked, incapacitates the attacker. (Tactician)
Mana Share Strike – Melee attack that grants the guarded ally mana. (Tactician)
Shadow Cantrip – Magic attack targeting the lower of light or dark resistance. Requires both light and dark attunements. (Tactician)

Spell Partnership – Prepared ability. When used, the Tactician makes a melee attack combined with a magic attack from the guarded ally. While prepared, the guarded ally has improved magic power. (Tactician)
Mystic Wind Blast – Prepared magic air attack against all enemies with disrupt and delay. While prepared, the Tactician has increased mana generation. (Tactician)
Turn Around Tactic – The guarded ally provokes the target. When attacked, damage that would be dealt to the guarded ally is dealt to the attacker instead. (Tactician)
Attuned Guard – Consumes an attuned element to prevent the next damage from that element. (Tactician)
Tactical Aggression – Prepared ability. When used, possesses the target ally to make a melee attack. While prepared, that ally has improved damage. (Tactician)
Tactical Defense – Prepared ability. When used, intercedes on the next attack against the target ally. While prepared, that ally has increased heals received. (Tactician)
Tactical Dispel – Prepared ability. When used, disenchants a target enemy. While prepared, the Tactician has improved magic resistance. (Tactician)
Tactical Magic – Prepared ability. When used, grants the Tactician mana. While prepared, the Tactician has improved magic power. (Tactician)
Threshold Mana – Gains mana. Requires threshold. (Tactician)
Battle Spell Sacrifice – Gains an arcane damage add to the next prepared ability used. (Tactician)
Brilliant Recovery – Melee attack against the previous target. Follows a miss. Consumes mana. (Tactician)
Conflux Power – Enhances elemental power for each element charged, consuming Conflux. Requires a minimum of 3 elements charged. (Tactician)
Conflux Protection – Enhances elemental resistance for each element charged, consuming Conflux. Requires a minimum of 3 elements charged. (Tactician)
Ley Line Threshold – Threshold ability that makes the next spell have instant cast speed. (Tactician)
Mana Surge Threshold – Threshold ability that grants mana surge. (Tactician)
Tactical Movement – Prepared ability. When used, quickens a target ally. While prepared, the Tactician has improved dodge. (Tactician)

Air Reiteration Rune – Trigger rune. Deals air damage against a single target. Causes the next air attacks to deal storm damage to a number of random targets based on a lower number of uses remaining. (Valkyrie)
Lightning Conduction – Taunts the enemy and converts its damage to air. Reflects the next air damage from the target to all enemies. (Valkyrie)
Lightning Crash Momentum – Air countdown versus a single target with duration and damage dependent on momentum. (Valkyrie)
Lightning Skewer – Air melee attack with ranged 1. (Valkyrie)
Mount Runic Hanoverian – Summons a Runic Hanoverian mount. (Valkyrie)
Reiterating Slash – Melee attack that repeats three times after a period. Each repetition is less powerful and targets randomly. (Valkyrie)
Reiterating Thunder Blade – Air melee attack that repeats three times after a period. Each repetition is less powerful and targets randomly. (Valkyrie)
Reiterating Winds – Air magic attack with delay that repeats three times after a period. Each repetition is less powerful and targets randomly. (Valkyrie)

Runic Challenge – Initial Effect: refreshes the current damage rune and increases the number of procs. Basic Effect: also affects the challenge with the rune effect at lower power. Challenge Effect: affects the challenge with higher power and a chance to conserve the rune. (Valkyrie)
Storm Charge – Melee attack against a column that makes a random attack against an enemy in each row. (Valkyrie)
Thundercall Blow – Melee attack that also afflicts the target with an air countdown. (Valkyrie)
Valkyrie Ride – Air melee attack against a column of enemies. Requires mounted. Also attacks two random enemies with magic air. (Valkyrie)
Wind Tunnel Rune – Element rune. Magic air damage and hex against a single target. Delays and stuns on hex activation. (Valkyrie)
Challenge Bolt – Lesser magic air attack and compel versus the challenged. (Valkyrie)
Imbue with Disruption – Grants the target a disruption proc. (Valkyrie)
Lightning Arc Rune – Defense rune. A random enemy takes air damage when the target is attacked. (Valkyrie)
Lightning Exposure – Follows a storm attack. The target struck is afflicted with air exposure. (Valkyrie)
Refresh Reiteration – Restores all active reiterating abilities to their maximum number of uses. (Valkyrie)
Reiterating Command – Single target compel that repeats three times after a period. Each repetition is less powerful and targets randomly. (Valkyrie)
Storm Absorption – Gains mana and quickens self when next hit by a storm ability. (Valkyrie)
Lightning Calling – The challenge takes air damage the next time a random targeting attack is used. (Valkyrie)
Lightning Speed – Grants an air damage add to the next attack. Requires momentum. (Valkyrie)
Lightning Strikes Twice – The next storm ability hits the same target with two of its attacks. (Valkyrie)
Share the Storm – Until the Valkyrie's next turn, all storm abilities that hit the Valkyrie also hit her challenge. (Valkyrie)
Storming Blow – Gains an air damage add to the next attack after taking damage from a storm ability. (Valkyrie)
